Chest Drainage Alivia Percutaneous Drainage Kit The Alivia is a versatile drainage catheter for air and fluid removal in a range of clinical applications, including emergency drainage, superficial drainage, abdominal and pelvic ascites, pneumothorax, and thoracentesis. The 12 cm straight catheter is available in 7Fr, 9Fr, and 12Fr sizes to suit different drainage requirements. Designed for percutaneous use, it supports both gravity and suction-assisted drainage when connected to a collection system. The luer lock handle provides a secure, leak-free connection. An integrated one-way valve enables controlled drainage, prevents backflow, and helps reduce infection risk. The 90° configuration improves handling and eliminates the need for a three-way stopcock. The Veress needle features a green proximal indicator for visual confirmation of correct positioning during insertion, supporting safety and accuracy. 12cm straight catheter available in three sizes: 7Fr, 9Fr and 12Fr. A 90° one-way valve that is continuously active. Verres needle with integrated indicator. Integrated fixing system to minimise dislocation. Streamlined kit includes catheter with one-way valve, Veress needle with indicator, 2000ml drainage bag, mini scalpel and 30ml luer lock syringe.

The expert umbilical catheter is the only umbilical catheter with integrated antimicrobial Agion® technology, to fight against CRBSI in NICUs. Ag+ is bacteriostatic that inhibits the cell reproduction. Ag+ combine with bacterial proteins located in the cell wall and cytoplasm which interferes with their normal functioning. These proteins are vital for the healthy functioning of the cell therefore loss of the proteins results in the death of the bacteria. Clinical performances “A reduction in catheter-related bloodstream infections in preterm infants found from using catheters with the Agion® antimicrobial system.”(11) “Preterms with an expert umbilical venous catheter had shorter hospital stays and a lower case fatality rate.”(11) “There was no case of intolerance to the Agion® catheters and none of these catheters had to be removed due to a local skin infection. In addition, none of the patients in the Agion® catheter group showed signs of silver toxicity.”(11)

Perfusafe 2 is a safety infusion device with Huber bevel for implantable ports which can be used for intermittent injections, continuous infusions of drugs or solutions, blood sampling. As vascular access experts, we know how important it is for patients and clinicians, that the combination of implantable ports and Huber needles maximise treatment effectiveness and minimise risks. Key qualities in the design of our Huber needles include safety features to protect against needlestick injuries and to minimise the risk of occlusion after the needle is withdrawn. Other benefits include ease of use with single hand activation and a simple, straight-forward withdrawal process. In addition to the comprehensive benefits in our poly perf safe Huber needle, the Vygon range features needles with special features to address particular clinical needs. They are: PPS flow + – single-handed removal plus automatic positive pressure helps to reduce catheter occlusion PPS CT – power injection compatible Huber needle for use with contrast agents Pefu saf e2 – a low profile design ideal for paediatric patients and oncology and haematology patients requiring extended treatment. Safe and secure Our poly film securement dressing is specially designed to ensure the Huber needles remain in place. They feature an adhesive central window to ensure easy removal without displacing the needle.

detail.description: Neohelp™ is a polyethylene occlusive bag/suit to prevent hypothermia of newborns. This is a sterile bag/suit in which the baby is placed immediately after birth without drying (before being admitted to the ICU). Heat loss due to environmental factors (evaporation, convection, conduction and radiation) is considerably reduced. Neohelp™ consists of: – a double layer of polyethylene (external layer: 50 microns, internal layer: 30 microns) which creates a greenhouse effect and protects from drafts. The heat loss through radiation, convection and evaporation is reduced. – a hood which limits the dispersion of heat by the head. Fully adjustable to the babies head, it does not let the air in. – a pre-formed foam pad which may help to maintain an open airway by raising the shoulders (1) and provides a barrier against heat loss by conduction. Neohelp™ is an ingenious pouch completely transparent, to monitor the color of the newborn’s skin and breath movements, and easy to use with direct access to the baby through the open / closed central opening. Neohelp™ is suitable for all situations (delivery room, place of resuscitation, emergency, operating room, transport …) and all users. It is recommended not to use Neohelp™ for more than 24 hours.

The Ready-Set range is a range of modular I.V. accessories specially designed for neonates and infants. It allows the practitioner to select the most suitable I.V. administration system for these patients. Benefits of the device: – Removes the need for additional 3-way taps, ramps and extension lines therefore reducing the risks associated with multiple connections such as air embolism, blood loss… – Allows the filtration of the infusions thus reducing particules contamination resulting from the mixing of drugs, solutions etc … – The closed-system needleless connectors (Bionector) fitted on some of the lines allow to reduce the risk of infection. – Non-return valves avoid backtracking of the infusions in the other lines.

Before catheter placement Flush the catheter at the proximal end with either a saline solution or a diluted lipid solution using a 10mL syringe. 2. During catheter placement Flush the catheter again with the solution of your choice. Do not bend or kink the catheter with the stylet in place. The exterior portion of the catheter should be kept in a straight line. 3. During stylet retrieval Remove the stylet slowly, ensuring you keep even tension. If difficulty is experienced removing the stylet stop, and let vein rest for a minute and then try removal again very slowly. Gentle flushing of the catheter with diluted lipid solution (preferred) or saline assists in stylet removal. Do not use syringes smaller than 10mL Small volume syringes (1mL – 5mL) will result in excessive pressure being exerted and may result in damage to the longline. Qimono the complete closed system for safe delivery of cytotoxic drugs Stay safe with Qimono It is widely documented that exposure to Systemic Anti-Cancer Therapy (SACT), can pose a significant health risk to patients during treatment as well as healthcare workers involved in the preparation and administration of the drugs . Many SACT agents are known to be carcinogenic, teratogenic and mutagenic. Exposure may be through skin contact, skin absorption, inhalation of aerosols and drug particles as well as ingestion and needlestick injuries. This can occur at various points of the treatment process: during the preparation of the medication, whilst the drugs are administered and after therapy . Adverse health effects reported by chemotherapy nurses include headaches, dizziness, nausea and hair loss. Description of the device Female Luer-lock to female Luer-lock connector, with Qimo Female on both ends of the connector. The main indication of this device is the transfer of drugs from syringe to syringe. Qimo Female is a multi-purpose, closed, needle-free, I.V. connection device. See the corresponding technical file code 7210.02. Priming volume: 0.27 ml

Suitability and Use : Used for invasive continuous arterial pressure measurement or to allow for repeated arterial blood sampling. Suitable for short-term therapy up to 30 days when clinically necessary. Common insertion sites are the radial, brachial and femoral arteries. Less frequently used insertion sites include the ulnar, axillary, posterior tibial and dorsal pedis arteries. Using the classic Seldinger technique makes arterial puncture easier particularly in hypotensive patients, or those with weak peripheral pulse, or when arteries are narrowed (atherosclerosis). Rotating chamber – allows clinicians to reposition the needle bevel so the visualisation chamber does not affect line of sight. Contraindications to arterial catheterisation: Active Raynaud’s syndrome, Thromboangitis obliterans, Abnormalities in vessel anatomy at the puncture site. I.V. extension tube in flexible, transparent polyurethane tubing with Vadsite and flat clamp. Octopus with Vadsite is a multi-purpose catheter accessory, a single lumen or multi-lumen I.V. extension tube with needleless connector(s), enabling intermittent injections or continuous infusions of fluids or medications and blood sampling depending on device variant. The variants with anti-reflux valves negate the risk of backtracking (retrogate flow) of infusate and thus the risk of overmedication (drug overdose). It is not possible to withdraw blood/fluid via an octopus where the lumen features an anti-reflux valve. Use with peripheral short IV cannulae, Octopus 1 and Octopus 2 have the following advantages: – Eliminates the risk of access-associated needle-stick injury – Reduces the risk of cannula movement in the vein causing mechanical vein irritation – Negates the need to use the cannula injection port (non disinfectable), Vadsite is disinfectable – Eliminates the need to use a 3-way tap to run simultaneous compatible solutions – Provides closed system (avoiding blood reflux) when accessing the catheter – PUR material (no PVC, DEHP-free), no leaching of plasticizers. Octopus 3, 4 and 5 are mostly recommended for use with central venous catheters. In this application, they have the following advantages: – Provide closed, neelde-free access during drug bolusing and continuous administration of I.V. fluids – Eliminate the need to use a 3-way tap to run 2 or more simultaneous compatible solutions – Eliminate the risk of blood spillage – Eliminate the risk of air embolism – PUR material (no PVC, no DEHP), no leaching of plasticizers.

Bionector TKO® is a patented “To Keep Open” valve, with 100% bi-directional fluid control and a straight fluid pathway. Bionector TKO has been specifically designed to reduce catheter occlusion, and works by controlling the bi-directional flow of fluid, infusate and catheter tip blood reflux. Occlusions can be commonplace in patients with vascular access lines, which both costs you money and affects your patients.This is accepted as normal, with occlusions and their consequences being dealt with as a matter of routine.The most common are: thrombotic occlusion when blood or clotting agents accumulate inside the catheter and persistent withdrawal occlusion when fibrin is aspirated into the catheter. This is where Bionector TKO can benefit you, it is clinically shown to reduce; catheter occlusions by 88% (50.4 to 5.8 per 1,000 catheter days)*, loss of IV catheter by 91% (9% to 0.8%)* and tissue plasminogen activator (tPA) usage by 85%*. *references available on request.

Bionector is an established market-leading needle-free device which meets the full range of global opinion leaders’ recommendations for reducing CRBSIs. It has been proven to provide an effective barrier against microbial ingress and help standardise practice by combining a fixed, straight fluid pathway with innovative neutral displacement technology. And it is the only neutral displacement needle-free device in the UK to combine a split-septum with a fixed straight, fluid pathway. Benefits: Bionector leads the way with a neutral fluid displacement. This means a specific post-flushing clamping sequence is not required, which in turn helps prevent blood reflux and reduce catheter occlusions. It is also backed up by a robust library of clinical studies, Bionector is proven to be easy to clean and clear. Its smooth split-septum fits tightly into the device housing ensuring it is free from any gaps. The straight, fixed fluid pathway has been proven ‘easy to clear’, designed to provide the most direct and least tortuous route with no moving parts (such as mechanical valves), which reduces the surface area available for biofilm formation. Aswell as being proven not to represent any risk to either patients or practitioners during an MRI of up to three Teslas. CT-rated for use with power injectors Bionector has a maximum pressure resistance of 350psi and a maximum flow rate of 10ml/s. Plus, Bionector’s straight fluid pathway is proven ‘flushable’ for macro and microscopic particles such as blood. This is due to a minimal deadspace of just 0.03ml allowing for a low flushing volume (5ml) to clear the device. Clean in accordance with your hospital/department protocol; Bionector can be cleaned with most disinfecting agents (eg 70% alcohol). Avoid antiseptics containing both alcohol and hydrogen peroxide.

What are 3M™ Curos™ Disinfecting Port Protectors? The Curos Disinfecting Cap is a unique disposable passive disinfection device, which protects a port for up to seven days and ensures the device is always clean, removing the need to actively disinfect, with an 87% decline in infection rates*. How Curos™ Disinfecting Port Protectors? Curos Disinfecting Caps work with a simple twist they can be easily attached to the end of an IV needle-free device to both disinfect AND protect. The Benefits of Curos™ Disinfecting Port Protectors: In a high pressure environment when time is of the essence, it is human behaviour to rush through essential steps. epic3 guidelines recommend scrubbing the hub for a minimum of 15 seconds, yet 54% of IV hubs are not cleaned for the recommended time. If decontamination is not performed correctly there is a risk of microbiological contamination when the port is accessed. And with 20% of healthcare associated infections related to catheter-related blood stream infections, Curos Disinfecting Caps are critical in reducing this, as well as saving clinical time and money!

Respiratory assistance device for patients with spontaneous ventilation allowing maintenance in the airways of a pressure greater than atmospheric pressure during the entire respiratory cycle. The CPAP mode of ventilation allows: – to recruit collapsed alveoles – to restore a satisfactory level of functional residual capacity – to improve gas exchange at the level of the alveolocapillary membrane – to decrease pulmonary resistance – to decrease the work of breathing – to redistribute the alveolar liquid to the interstitial space in case of acute pulmonary oedema. The Boussignac CPAP and its manometer connector is a device for connection to a face mask with its 22 mm male connector, the crenellated upper part remaining open to the air. This device comprises 2 lateral ports: – the upper port is preconnected to an extension tube (length 200 cm) for connection to an air or oxygen source – the bottom port (colourless translucent) allows: . controlling pressure (use manometer code 527.01), . an additional oxygen supply if the gas administered to the patient via the upper port is air, . CO2 monitoring How it works: The gases administered to the patient (air, air-oxygen mixture or pure oxygen) pass through the extension tube and arrive in a circular chamber where the gases can only escape into the central zone passing through 4 micro-channels. At that moment, the injection speed of the gases is greatly increased. Deflectors at the exit site of the micro-channels eject the gases arriving at high speed towards the opposite wall. The collision of gas molecules between themselves generates a turbulence which creates a virtual valve and simultaneously the speed of gases is transformed in pressure. This pressure depends directly on the flowrate: if the flowrate (the amount of gas injected) is increased, the pressure will increase; if the flowrate is decreased, the pressure will decrease. N.B. It is possible to connect the Boussignac CPAP to an endotracheal tube or to a tracheosto

The connecting tube is supplied in the packaging containing the VYGON-BOUSSIGNAC CPAP code 5570.13. The manometer must be connected to the colourless translucent port on the CPAP device. It indicates each centimetre of H2O from 0 to 25cm. The manometer is encased in a protective polyurethane housing and is supplied with a manometer attachment cord (code 7.254.15.03).
Flowmeter measuring the flow of air up to 30l/min, while the flowmeters available in the hospital generally only measure flow rates of air up to 15l/min

This product allows to change the FiO2 in emergency conditions when air is not available (pre-hospital care). Introducing neurafit™ Our solution to preventing spinal misconnections The problem When used for neuraxial and regional anaesthesia, universal Luer connections have led to administrative errors 1 , which in some cases has proven fatal 2 . Problems occurred when intravenous (IV) medicines were administered by the spinal route and vice versa; when anaesthetics were delivered through IV lines 3 . The solution It is widely recognised that the use of a non-luer connection can limit these errors 4 which has generated an increasing need for better connections 5 . The result is the ISO 80369-6 standard named NRFit 6 . In line with these new standards specifying small-bore connectors for neuraxial and regional anesthesia, Vygon has developed neurafit. NRFit compliant Featuring NRFit standard small-bore connectors, the benefits of neurafit include: Avoids any connection to luer devices A one-piece reversed design, and a smaller diameter, to minimise dead space No misconnection.

detail.description: ENDO-LEAK™ Tester Endoscope leak tester to identify microscopic damage in flexible endoscopes Compact design takes up minimal space on the counter or wall Compatible with major endoscope brands including OLYMPUS ® , PENTAX ® , FUJIFILM ® , ACMI™, Wolf ® and Storz ® REQUEST A QUOTE Shop Now Product Overview The ENDO-LEAK Tester from STERIS is a mechanical wet leak tester used during the manual cleaning step, after visual inspection, when reprocessing flexible endoscopes in healthcare facilities. Leak testing helps to check for microscopic holes (leaks) in flexible endoscopes, helping to identify hidden damage that could prevent proper reprocessing. A leak in an endoscope can also cause water damage and further costly repairs. How the ENDO-LEAK Tester Works Leak testing is a vital step in the endoscope reprocessing workflow. Performing this test correctly not only helps to support compliance with each scope Instructions for Use (IFU), but it also helps technicians detect hidden damage that may not be visible to the naked eye. Endoscope leak testing with the ENDO-LEAK Tester is performed using wet leak testing (submerging in water while the scope is pressurized) or manual leak testing

How often should endoscope leak testing be performed? Always follow the manufacturer's instructions for use on the frequency and process for performing leak testing on endoscopes. Typically, every endoscope should be tested for leaks after each use, during the manual cleaning process. Additionally, a leak test should be performed after any event that could cause damage to the endoscope.

How do you perform a leak test on a flexible endoscope? Always follow the device and endoscope manufacturer's instructions for use (IFU) when performing a leak test. The general steps to perform endoscope leak testing include: Mechanical Wet Leak Test Using the ENDO-LEAK Tester Connect the unit and press RUN to clear the air
Attach the adapter, pressurize, and wait 30 seconds
Submerge the scope in water, flex controls, and look for bubbles
Remove the scope from the water
Press STOP , wait 10 seconds, then disconnect

Creating a safe hospital environment benefits patients, staff, and the entire healthcare system. By installing a well-calibrated environmental monitoring system, we can ensure the necessary monitoring is effectively regulated to maintain a high standard of safety in the hospital setting.

Proper airflow in the surgical suite promotes air quality and minimizes airborne contamination, helping reduce surgical site infections. An air exchange rate of 20 air changes per hour has been recommended. 1

The OR should have a positive pressure gradient relative to all surrounding areas, including supply storage areas that are directly accessible to the OR. Pressure differentials prevent the backflow of air from contaminated areas within the suite or facility. 1

The healthcare organization should create and implement a systematic process for monitoring HVAC system equipment and establish a mechanism for reporting and resolving unintentional variances. In addition, the frequency of filter changes and a mechanism for maintaining the system should be established. 1

Regulatory bodies provide guidelines for OR environmental requirements. For example, ASHRAE Standard 170 is used for ventilation requirements for healthcare facilities. What is the difference between traditional OR ceiling panels and Plascore Honeycomb Ceiling Panels? Traditional drywall is cut to fit on-site. Plascore Honeycomb Ceiling Panels are cut to size at the factory for quicker installation. Panels can also be field-modified as required.

What is the difference between CLEANSUITE ® Operating Room Ceiling System and Plascore Honeycomb Ceiling Panels? CLEANSUITE is a prefabricated laminar flow ceiling system that provides a higher level of quality control than on-site construction, as defined in the FGI guidelines. CLEANSUITE includes air delivery plenum, ductwork, lighting, equipment mounts for surgical lights, booms, C-arms, monitor carriers, etc. Plascore Honeycomb Ceiling Panels fill the ceiling gap between CLEANSUITE and the walls within the OR space. Use of a modular or prefabricated laminar (or controlled) flow ceiling system shall be permitted in operating rooms and Class 3 imaging rooms/hybrid operating rooms in place of monolithic ceiling construction where the following conditions are met: A2.1-7.2.3.3 (3)(b) Modular laminar flow ceiling systems. These complex assemblies are built in a factory setting, providing higher quality control than on-site construction. Systems and equipment such as ductwork and other air delivery systems, sprinklers, lighting, boom mounts, and ceilings are engineered and fabricated off-site, minimizing late changes (and related design inadequacies) due to field conditions and miscoordination. Benefits include concurrent construction, less risk, less waste, faster installation, control of quality, and a support structure that is integral to the design of the assembly.

How do Plascore Honeycomb Ceiling Panels support infection prevention? Plascore Honeycomb Ceiling Panels feature a white, room-side, Unplasticized Polyvinyl Chloride (uPVC) finish that can be easily cleaned with traditional healthcare detergents and disinfectants without damaging the materials. The panels are installed without the dust and sanding debris associated with traditional gypsum board (drywall) ceilings.

Are Plascore Honeycomb Ceiling Panels only compatible with STERIS equipment? No. Plascore Honeycomb Ceiling Panels can be installed anywhere in a facility, with or without STERIS or any other manufacturer’s equipment.

What are the benefits of a honeycomb ceiling panel structure? Plascore Honeycomb Ceiling Panels feature an aluminum core with galvanized steel above the ceiling and white uPVC facing the room-side. The high-strength panels deliver a walkable ceiling surface.

features: What is a loaner tray? Loaned instruments, or loaner trays, are any devices not owned and stored by the healthcare facility. Instead, they are usually loaned by the device manufacturer to hospitals for use in specific procedures. Once received, the hospital is responsible for cleaning, decontaminating, and sterilizing the devices and must follow all facility policies and procedures as if they were a hospital-owned device coming into decontamination.

What is a loaner order? A loaner order allows you to document the ordering and receipt of loaned instruments. Each loaner order is tied to the unique CASE ID the loaner trays are required for and the vendor and vendor rep who will be providing the loaner trays.

What is a loaner management system? A loaner management system is an electronic method for tracking loaned instrumentation alongside needed and consigned trays. A loaner management system coordinates upstream communication between the scheduling team and vendor while providing status updates to all stakeholders as loaned instruments are requested, received, used, and ready for return.

What are Hydroxyls and how do they work? Hydroxyls are a naturally occurring and essential sanitizing agent in the outdoor environment. Hydroxyls decompose natural and man-made pollutants, killing pathogens and keeping the air safe to breathe. However, Hydroxyls do not exist naturally indoors, as they are consumed within milliseconds when produced by sunlight. PYURE Technology ® can produce the same concentrations of hydroxyls and natural oxidants found in nature to purify and sanitize indoor areas. PYURE produces concentrations of Hydroxyls and organic oxidants like those naturally generated outdoors 1 , recreating the sun's cleansing action for indoor spaces.

What is the efficacy of using Hydroxyls in air and surface sanitization? PYURE Technology kill rates for airborne pathogens offer a greater than 99% reduction within 30 minutes and a detection efficacy rate of 100% after 1 to 2 hours, depending on the type of pathogen. This includes COVID-19 virus, Staphylococcus E., and black mold. Performance against surface pathogens varies based on the specific pathogen and type of surface but ranges from a 94% to 99.99% reduction of viruses and bacteria.

How effective are Hydroxyls compared to cleaning with UV Light and other methods? PYURE Technology effectively treats air and surfaces by recreating the natural cleansing action of the sun indoors, delivering safe and powerful performance. Hydroxyls also work 24/7 compared to traditional line-of-sight UV, an event-based treatment.

Is PYURE meant to work in tandem with CLEANSUITE or as another option for laminar airflow? Although the PYURE In-Duct Unit (IDU) can be used as standalone equipment, it is ideally suited as an extra level of purification in addition to the CLEANSUITE System for those seeking unsurpassed levels of purification in the OR environment. The PYURE Air and Surface Sanitization system can protect large areas, including entire buildings.

detail.description: Accessories for Spine Surgery Spinal surgery accessories are vital to patient safety and positioning in these delicate procedures. Medical conditions affecting the spine can cause severe back pain and immobility for patients and can radiate to other parts of the body. The most common types of back surgery include spinal fusion, laminectomy, and discectomy. Each of these procedures require the surgeon to position the patient differently on the operating table. Common positions for spine surgery include prone and face down, depending on which are of the vertebrae the surgeon will be working. Spinal surgical table accessories accommodate each of the positions for knee-chest, jackknife and kneeling. How VERIFY STEAM Integrating Indicators Work When exposed to a steam sterilization cycle, steam penetrates the clear film cover and lowers the melting point of the specially formulated pellet. detail.description: Bariatric Accessories for Surgery Bariatric surgery is a specialty aimed at helping patients lose weight by making changes to their digestive system. The most common bariatric surgical procedures are gastric bypass, laparoscopic sleeve and adjustable gastric banding. During these procedures, one of the most common patient positions in the surgical table is lithotomy with reverse Trendelenburg. In order to help ensure both patient safety and surgeon accessibility during procedures, bariatric surgical table accessories are used to maintain proper patient positioning. Split leg positioners are often used as they provide mid-line access to the patient with independent controls for full abduction/adduction as well as high and low lithotomy positioning. Other common bariatric table accessories include a fluid collection system, foot extension, table extenders and knee restraint straps. detail.description: VERIFY™ STEAM Integrating Indicator Type 5 Integrating Indicator Cycles: Various gravity, prevacuum, and immediate use steam sterilization (IUSS) cycles Features: Moving-front ink technology provides a clear interpretation of pass/fail REQUEST A QUOTE Shop Now PRODUCT OVERVIEW The VERIFY STEAM Integrating Indicator verifies that critical steam sterilization parameters were met. Available in two sizes, the 2-inch Type 5 Integrating Indicator fits where other chemical indicators do not, and both sizes meet stringent performance requirements of the ANSI/AAMI/ISO chemical indicator standard 11140-1. How VERIFY STEAM Integrating Indicators Work When exposed to a steam sterilization cycle, steam penetrates the clear film cover and lowers the melting point of the specially formulated pellet. As the pellet melts, it soaks into the wicking paper and a bar travels along the strip. The rate at which the bar moves has been correlated to a biological indicator's kill time. When the bar has traveled the length of the strip and enters the "ACCEPT (OK)" area, this serves as confirmation that all critical steam sterilization parameters have been met. How VERIFY Bowie-Dick Indicator Strips Work The indicator strip is placed within the VERIFY All-In-One STEAM Reusable Test Pack. When exposed to air removal test cycle, air is removed from the test pack and steam penetrates the chamber. The steam penetrates the polypropylene cover of the indicator strip contacting the steam sensitive chemistry within. Supporting Clinicians with a Versatile Transport Monitor Mindray Offers: Grab-and-Go Wireless Adaptability The ability to preserve continuous patient monitoring during transport affects patient outcomes, clinician confidence, and workflow efficiency. This makes adding a transport monitor to your clinical fleet an essential strategic investment. Enhanced Clinical Workflows With a grab-and-go feature, clinicians can detach the Mindray Transport Monitor from a bedside monitor, transforming it into a wireless solution without managing cables or changing settings. This transition preserves monitoring data, simplifying patient transportation.

Continued Patient Safety Data Continuity Our monitor supports data continuity residing on the BeneVision Distributed Monitoring System (DMS) throughout transport. This enables clinical teams to monitor heart rate, non-invasive blood pressure, and other parameters, remotely using DMS workstations or mobile applications. With the BeneVision N1’s data storage capability of up to 48 hours of full disclosure and defibrillator synchronization, you can achieve the same level of monitoring during transport as at the bedside.

Streamlined Integration and Security Dock and Transfer Data Seamlessly Prioritizing integration, our transport monitor can dock into your BeneVision N-Series Patient Monitors and transfer data while maintaining information integrity.

Reduced Total Cost of Ownership High Quality A high-quality, water-resistant construction, combined with proven resistance to degradation from over 20 of the harshest cleaners and disinfectants enables a resilient transport monitor, helping minimize repair costs over time.

Intra-hospital transfers: The Mindray Transport Monitor supports patient movement between hospital departments, from the Emergency Department (ED) to the Operating Room (OR) or from the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) to the Radiology exam room. It maintains continuous, gap-free monitoring, enabling clinical teams to preserve patient safety

Abdominal and General Imaging

For essential general imaging needs, such as abdominal and aorta exams, our systems feature ergonomic designs and streamlined workflows.

  • Perform a comprehensive abdominal survey or an aorta/IVC scan to screen for aneurysms
  • Curved array transducers provide a wide field of view and clear penetration for deep abdominal structures

  • Phased array transducers are specifically designed for navigating the acoustic windows of the rib cage to visualize the heart

  • Assess for DVT or examine joints and soft tissues for injury
  • Linear array transducers offer superior resolution for visualizing muscles and tendons

Request Your Quote Today The Evolution: Acoustic Intelligence Technology (AIT) One of the latest advances in ultrasound technology is Mindray’s Acoustic Intelligence Technology™ (AIT), which builds directly on the ZONE Sonography® Technology + (ZST + ) architecture, extending its capabilities through hyper-parallel computing and next-generation AFM matrix transducers. AIT combines advanced acquisition with significantly increased processing power, enabling more efficient signal transmission and reception, improved penetration in difficult-to-image patients, enhanced spatial and contrast resolution, and greater extraction of clinically relevant information from each acquisition. AIT amplifies the strengths of ZST + , transforming it into a more intelligent, adaptive ultrasound imaging technology. Why This Matters Clinically Together, ZST+ and AIT shift ultrasound from a hardware-limited modality to a data-rich, software-defined medical imaging platform. This evolution enables clinicians to maintain diagnostic confidence across a wide range of patient types, visualize subtle anatomical structures with greater clarity, reduce variability caused by tissue differences, and perform ultrasound examinations more efficiently without sacrificing image quality. The BC-3600 Hematology Analyzer features closed tube sampling via a single push button. A built-in large 10.4 inch color touchscreen allows maximum visibility. Hemoglobin analysis is performed using cyanide-free reagent. The analyzer processes up to 60 samples per hour and stores up to 40,000 results with histograms. The barcode reader and optional LIS connectivity enable seamless sample data transmission. Nearly all scheduled maintenance procedures are automated by touch buttons. The intuitive software enhances workflow efficiency and provides operators with a pleasant user experience.

The BC-5390 is a five-part differential hematology analyzer with built-in autoloader and a single closed tube sample mode. The hemoglobin analysis is performed using cyanide-free reagent. The analyzer processes up to 60 samples per hour and stores up to 100,000 results with histograms and scattergram. The barcode reader and optional LIS connectivity enable seamless sample data transmission. Nearly all scheduled maintenance procedures are automated by touch buttons. The intuitive software enhances workflow efficiency and provides operators with a pleasant user experience.

detail.description: Canon’s new AI image processing option uses an algorithm based on deep-learning to read and eliminate noise on clinical images. Intelligent NR was developed using machine learning and an existing clinical image database to create a neural network for deep-learning. By identifying the characteristics of noise and applying the pre-learned neural network, a noise-reduced image is created. The software decreases the graininess of DR images by increasing the signal to noise ratio without loss of anatomical data, therefore, improving diagnostic value. It complies with the ALARA principle by allowing for a possible reduction in radiation dose and improvement of diagnostic image quality.

Trauma DR Plus The Trauma DR Plus is a dedicated and unique digital radiography solution for trauma departments and emergency rooms. The system can be manoeuvred around the patient quickly and easily without any need to move the patient, especially important in critical trauma situations including spinal injuries. This system comprises a U-arm and the X-ray beam always remains centered to the image receptor so you never have to worry about misalignment. A wireless portable Canon Flat Panel Detector (FPD) provides instantaneous imaging and benefits from the integrated Automatic Exposure Control (AEC). This provides the highest possible image quality and ensures accurate and repeatable exposures with the lowest patient X-ray dose. Advanced Trauma and Life Support (ATLS) The Trauma DR Plus lends itself exceptionally well to the X-ray examination of trauma patients. The patient remains secure, typically on a spine board whilst the only movement is from the X-ray tube support overhead and the detector underneath, or to the side in lateral projections. The Advanced Trauma and Life Support Protocol (ATLS) specifies that the patient must remain very stable and secure. Operations Trauma DR

3rd Harmonic Imaging AI-enabled innovation for more detail and depth 3rd Harmonic Imaging (3-HI) is a technology that utilizes the frequency components of the ultrasound beam at three times the transmitted frequency. Developmentally, to extract the 3rd harmonic components from the huge quantity of received signals, an AI filter for 3rd harmonic was designed using deep learning that allows the effective extraction and utilization of the 3rd harmonic signal. Using the 3rd harmonic sharpens the received beam, reduces multiple reflections and sidelobes, and achieves B-mode images with less noise in the vessel lumen and clearer tissue structures around the vessel. Deep Learning The deep learning methods of the Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) are able to process enormous amounts of data through an network of decision making nodes, or neurons, and are well regarded for their excellent performance in image recognition-based applications. Deep Learning Reconstruction (DLR) AiCE was trained on vast amounts of high-SNR MRI images reconstructed with an advanced algorithm that is too computationally intensive for clinical use. This training taught AiCE to distinguish true signal from noise. The results were validated by a team of radiologists, medical physicists, AI scientists, and clinical researchers, producing a fast, fully-trained reconstruction algorithm ready for clinical use. The DCNN learns which methods are best applied to maintain the spatial resolution and low-noise properties contained in high SNR MR images. The more variations of data supplied during training, the better the final algorithm will perform in terms of image quality and processing speeds. Bivona FlexTend TTS Tracheostomy Tubes are designed for neonatal and paediatric patients who require intermittent or temporary cuff use. A cuff, when inflated, helps create a seal between the tube’s outer wall and the trachea to direct airflow through the inner lumen, protecting against aspiration and optimising respiration in ventilated patients and patients performing lung expansion therapies. detail.description: Normoflo ™ Irrigation Fluid Warmer Normoflo ™ Irrigation Fluid Warmer The Normoflo irrigation fluid warmer delivers large volumes of warmed irrigating fluids at optimum flow rates. The device helps you maintain your patient’s core temperature during the entire length of the procedure, helping to prevent unintended perioperative hypothermia (UPH). UPH (core body temperature below 36°C) is a common yet preventable consequence of surgery under general anesthesia. Adverse outcomes of UPH include cardiac morbidity, intraoperative blood loss, thermal discomfort, increased wound infection rates, prolonged recovery times, and extended hospital stays. ¹ Research shows that using room-temperature fluids may contribute to perioperative hypothermia. ² That’s why the Association of periOperative Registered Nurses (AORN) Guidelines for Prevention of Hypothermia recommends warm irrigation fluids, an active method to help maintain patient normothermia and improve recovery outcomes. ³ ICU Medical offers two irrigation options. The H1100 is intended for gravity flow procedures, while the H-1129 offers the same features plus pressurized fluid delivery via integrated pressure chambers as well as 3-lit
features: Delivers large volumes of warmed irrigation fluid at flow rates of > 2,000 mL/min.
Both irrigation models allow quick and easy bag changes with the electrical IV pole that can automatically lift up to four 3-liter bags of fluid.
Includes mechanisms to remove air after warming and prior to patient irrigation, resulting in a clear, bubble-free field of vision.

detail.description: Level 1 ™ Convective Warmer Device Level 1 ™ Convective Warmer Device The Level 1 Convective Warming System consists of a high-flow convective warmer with hose-end temperature control, a convective warming blanket, and accessories. The convective warmer draws ambient-temperature air through a HEPA air filter. The filtered air is warmed to a selected temperature. The warmed air enters the convective warming blanket through the hose and is distributed through delivery channels. Perforations on the patient side of the blanket gently disperse warm air over the patient. The safety circuit provides an independent means to discontinue power to the heater. This design prevents exposing the patient to excessive temperatures, while continuously monitoring over and under temperature alarms for each setting. The new SurgiVet VitaLink and VitaLink Mini monitors give you accurate visibility and precise data. Both with the same great features, but available in two sizes designed to fit easily into any practice. With reliable respiratory monitoring, advanced ECG and arrhythmia detection, patients can get back to where they belong. Accuracy you can count on from every angle. Even sideways. Whether it’s day one or day 1,000, SurgiVet VitaLink monitors are designed to remain as unflappable as you. From the precision of our sensors to the durability of every connection, our monitors remain accurate, reliable and ready to help you predict the right call even with the most unpredictable patients. Equipped with a double basin and tap, it simplifies carers’ tasks by eliminating the need to carry water to the bedside. No installation is required.

The ceiling IV stand enables the attachment of medical infusion bags on a ceiling rail system via a glider or ceiling hook. The stand has six options to cater for different ceiling heights, from 2.5,m to 3.5 m and has simple and ergonomic height adjustment that can be operated with one hand. detail.description: Go longer distances without fatigue, easily ascend ramps, and reduce stress on your shoulders. The eye-catching Empulse R90 powers your push with ease. The V-Lock attachment system secures the R90 to most folding and rigid wheelchairs. The simple Control Box enables easy push-button use and can be ergonomically positioned for easy use. When power assist is not needed, simply push a button to raise the wheel up for zero rolling resistance. The Sunrise Intelligence app allows you to select the performance profile that best suits your environment. Limited hand grasp or dexterity? With the R90’s wireless Control Box, you can start and control your speed with the push of a button. Conveniently attachable to any part of your wheelchair’s frame, it allows you to: Raise or lower the wheel any time. Adjust your speed as needed: lower in crowded rooms, or higher to match your dog’s pace, with a top speed of 5.5 mph. Get moving by pressing the plus (+) button, or propel to the speed you want and press the plus (+) button to maintain it, like cruise control. The Control Box wirelessly connects to the R90 using Bluetooth®, ensuring there’s no cable in your way. It maintains a reliable connection no matter your movement and can be easily detached for transfers or to prevent damage during flights. There’s no learning curve; just faster, slower, wheel up, or GO! The Empulse R90 is compatible with most rigid and folding wheelchairs. The reciever brackets don’t interfere with chair components, and still allow folding chairs to fold.

detail.description: Quickie’s smallest and lightest manual wheelchair pull device ever! When using your wheelchair, every little push forward might not feel like a big deal, but day in, day out, the strain on your shoulders accumulates over time. Pull assist devices can be the superheroes of the wheelchair world, but some are just too bulky and heavy for everyday use – especially for quick jaunts around town or when travelling. The Empulse F35 strikes the perfect balance between size and practicality. This ultra-portable micro-pull device is not just a looker, it’s your ticket to quick and effortless powered mobility in the urban jungle. At 7.5 kg, the F35 is lighter to lift than most wheelchairs! But it’s not just its weight that makes the F35 so easy to handle, it’s the integrated design too. From cabling to the battery, everything is included in its frame tube, so there’s less to lift. Tight on space? The handles also fold down flush to the frame, saving you additional space when you really need it. Places to go? People to see? That’s why we’ve made docking your F35 so easy. Just pull the tube latch and the F35 releases from its sub-frame – how simple is that? The sub-frame can stay on your wheelchair all day too, so re-attaching is a breeze. Just align and push forward to lock back in. And when it’s time to transfer out of your wheelchair, the sub-frame is just as easy to remove too. Flights booked? All that’s left to do is to enjoy your holiday thanks to the F35 and its IATA (International Air Transport Association) approved battery, which is safe for air travel. And if that isn’t enough, the F35 has a variety of options to help further take the worry out of travel too.

detail.description: WheelDrive not only offers extra pushing power when propelling, it is also allows you continously drive without self propelling thanks to the unique double rim system. Further away, difficult slopes, thresholds or maneuvering in a small space? You choose the support you need and you remain active and mobile with your own wheelchair! In addition, the driving characteristics of the WheelDrive are easy to program according to your wishes. The WheelDrive stimulates active movement, while strain on muscles and joints is reduced. With a unique dual hand rims concept the WheelDrive stands apart from other power assist wheels The large hand ring provides additional support while you are propelling. While the small hand ring gives you a continuous drive so when you come to a tricky hill you can reserve your energy. With both rims you can select from three speed settings, each of which can be tailored to your specific requirements! The power assist wheels can be fitted to virtually any lightweight or standard wheelchair without the need for additional parts or modifications to the chair. So you can continue to use your own manual wheelchair, additionally adapted to your specific needs. Of course, you can swap the wheels again at any time and switch to the original manual wheels – without additional tools.

detail.description: Introducing the RAYMEX ® Lift, a portable, personal fall recovery device that also doubles as a better alternative to a rollator walker. Designed to help people maintain their independence and active lifestyle as they age, the RAYMEX ® Lift aids with everyday activities while also always being ready to lift a fallen person from the floor. The RAYMEX ® combines a walker, lifting chair, stand aid, and lowering device in one piece of equipment, helping older adults maintain their independence and mobility. Whether it’s baking a cake, playing with your grandchildren, or simply sitting in your favourite chair, the RAYMEX® Lift helps you keep doing the things you love. Benefits of the RAYMEX ® Multiple use cases in one piece of equipment – The RAYMEX ® Lift is designed to do more than lift. It can double as a walker or stand aid, supporting individuals in standing practice or helping them move short distances safely. The handles adjust in height, and users can even rest or stabilise themselves using the device throughout the day. Can be used independently – The RAYMEX ® Lift allows many older adults to self-recover after a fall, without waiting for assistance. Instead of building it around the person, the individual transfers themselves onto the seat – usually by shuffling backwards – before activating the lift. For those with very limited mobility, a caregiver can still assist as needed. High battery capacity – The RAYMEX ® Lift delivers approximately 33 lifts per charge, which is ample for home use, especially given its multifunctionality.

With an industry-leading 400kg capacity and larger dimensions than the Stride Concealment Trolley , this trolley has been purpose-built for bariatric transfers. Strong but lightweight construction means this concealment trolley is built for the r igour of portering services, both indoors and outdoors. Engineered for stability and comfort on both urban streets and nature trails, the S800 delivers a modern and cool mobility solution. Bike-style handlebar controls Navigate effortlessly with the familiar bike-style handlebar, featuring a thumb throttle, handbrake, and an e-bike full color liquid retina LCD display. The intuitive controls, including cruise control, allow for smooth acceleration and braking, ensuring full control at all times. Additionally, the integrated NFC tag locking technology enhances security while providing a modern user experience. Spacious design with lithium battery The S800 comes standard with a lithium battery offering a 50 km range. The built-in battery heating enables the S800 to be used in freezing temperatures. Smartly positioned underneath the footplate, the design provides extra legroom and ensures an optimal ergonomic seating position. The display shows the remaining battery capacity, so you can ride longer without worrying about recharging. 4 large 18-inch wheels with advanced suspension The four large 18-inch wheels with striking rims not only add style but also enhance stability and comfort on any type of road. Their size helps absorb shocks, providing a smoother ride over bumps and uneven surfaces, whether cruising through the city or exploring nature trails. The trail tyres offer superior grip on muddy and slippery surfaces. Combined with a advanced suspension system, these features ensure a smooth and comfortable ride on all types of roads. Zenit The Zenit is a folding wheelchair but impresses with the look and handling of a rigid frame wheelchair. The patented Easy-Go folding system makes it easy to unfold. When combined with the foldable backrest, this clever folding mechanism ensures a compact and transportable wheelchair. Zenit CLT In addition to its innovative folding system, the Zenit CLT has firmly welded components which enhances driving stability. Key elements such as the centre of gravity, backrest, front wheel connections, brake mounts, and side part fittings are all securely welded, ensuring a stable and reliable performance. Zenit R The Zenit R is the perfect choice if you’re looking for a rigid frame wheelchair. This active wheelchair stands out for it’s lightweight design and rigid frame, ensuring every movement is translated directly into motion for an exceptional driving experience. With numerous adjustment options, the Zenit R can be perfectly tailored for maximum comfort. Zenit R CLT The Zenit R rigid frame wheelchair in the CLT version offers even more stability with its rigid frame and welded components. As with the Zenit CLT, the centre of gravity, back and front wheel connection as well as the brake connection and side panel mount are firmly welded, which enables maximum stability and efficiency when driving. Choose between aluminium or premium carbon frames in a range of Ottobock colours, including durable anodised finishes. Personalise further with vibrant colour accents from the Style Package. Engineered for ease and performance, this lightweight electric wheelchair offers an impressive range of up to 17km on a single 4-hour charge, powered by a 25.55V 15.6Ah lithium battery. Designed for versatility, the XSTO M4 features one-touch folding for simple transport and adjustable height settings for personalised comfort. Its self-adjusting technology and high performance omniwheels ensure a smooth, stable ride on pavements, rough paths, and uneven surfaces. Whether commuting, travelling, or exploring, the XSTO M4 offers the perfect blend of reliability and flexibility for a more independent lifestyle. detail.description: The Rehasense ICON 60 manual wheelchair is available in several pre-set configurations and stocked sizes, and is one of the most adjustable wheelchairs currently available. This latest addition to the Rehasense portfolio which features a lightweight rigid 7000 Series Aluminium Alloy frame and carbon fibre side panels has been designed to enable the user to adjust various elements of the chair to suit their individual needs. The frame length and seat angle are adjustable and for maximum comfort, the backrest – which is foldable to assist with transporting the ICON 60 by car can be adjusted forward by up to 20˚ or backwards by up to 10˚. The seat height can also be easily adjusted with a choice of different heights which in turn changes the centre of gravity to make the chair a more ‘active’ model. As with all Rehasense products, the ICON 60 has been designed to be stylish, user friendly and aesthetically pleasing. With a maximum user capacity of 120kg and a choice of 4 colour finishes and several wheel, tyre and push rim options available, the ICON 60 takes manual wheelchair design to the next level.

The Otolift Modul-Air Smart Stairlift is exceptionally suitable for almost all types of staircase, whether it’s a staircase with one or multiple curves, or a spiral or helical staircase. In most cases, your handrail can remain intact, and your staircase will remain safely walkable. Thanks to the thinnest single rail in the world and our Reverse Drive Technology, this elegant stairlift can even be installed on very narrow staircases. Installation is possible on staircases as narrow as 70 centimeters. Since every situation is different, installing a stairlift is always a custom process. However, thanks to the modular design of the Otolift Modul-Air Smart, the concept of customization has been redefined. The stairlift’s rail is composed of innovative modules, enabling us to quickly and efficiently tailor the Modul-Air Smart to your specific staircase. The Otolift Modul-Air Smart is ideal for installation on the inside of your staircase. This placement ensures that the stairlift takes up minimal space, and in most cases, your handrail can remain intact. The armrests, seat, and footrest are easy and light to fold away. Thanks to the smart Reverse Drive Technology, the chair can move partially or fully backward, ensuring your knees never hit the wall, even on very narrow staircases. Compact, comfortable and stylish design Discreet single rail placed low on the staircase Suitable for steep and narrow stairs, offering maximum knee space Minimal footprint, leaving ample space for other users Battery-powered for continued operation during power outages Lightweight, easy-to-use controls Safety system that stops the lift automatically if obstacles are detected

Fully Adjustable: As well as being compact, practical and highly configurable, the Küschall Champion is fully adjustable. Enhanced Comfort: Küschall Champion offers an extensive selection of options and accessories to support a wide variety of comfort needs and personalities. Ready to Travel: Both Champion models are available with travel bags. The fixed frame option can be transported with the wheels on. detail.description: The Invacare Comet Pro is your perfect mobility scooter for taking trips into town, popping to the local shops, and going on day long trips. Comet Pro is made with powerful outdoor capabilities, combined with advanced safety features and options; this ensures a quick, robust, and reliable drive. Comet Pro features exceptional driving features and modern aesthetics to deliver premium performance and control. The 2 x 75 Ah batteries allow users to enjoy challenging journeys beyond the city’s limits. It also has a large 13” front and rear wheels, combined with a superior suspension system that allows safe negotiation of kerbs and obstacles smoothly and comfortably. More so, the automatic speed reduction will slow you down when driving around corners at high speed for additional stability and safety. The Invacare Comet Pro mobility scooter gives ultimate confidence and reassurance when driving the electric scooter. detail.description: The Karma Blazer is a compact powerchair, making it great for indoor use and manoeuvring in tight spaces. Powerful motors, large front castors and rear suspension make it capable outdoors. It is available in a choice of seats, either an adjustable sling or a comfortable captain seat. The backrest can be folded easily folded flat onto the seat for transport or storage. Excellent Indoor Maneuverability The Blazer’s total width is from just 580 mm, making it one of the most compact power chairs on the market. It is smooth and easy to navigate through doorways, into lifts, or around confined spaces. Great Outdoor Performance Blazer’s excellent performance extends outdoors; independent rear wheel suspension and oversized 9-inch front castors ensure a smooth ride, while an optional LED lighting system adds safety for on-road use. Captain or Sling Seat Blazer Sling not only offers 3 seat width options, it also provides 8° to 28° degree power tilt, which allows the users to easily change their position, thus shifting the pressure away from the hipbones and redistributing it over a larger surface area. The new Blazer Captain Seat (KP-31.2 CPT) offers the ability to manually recline the backrest from 0°-56° or 0°-47°. This allows the user to stretch their hip joints and relax their back muscles. Easy Transfer The flip-back armrests and swing-away footrests make it easy to transfer to and from the seat or move closer to a table. Adjustable The seat depth, back angle, headrest height, headrest angle, armrest height, armpad position, and footrest depth are all adjustable.

Smooth Ride Suspension (SRS) is a superior automotive-grade electric wheelchair power suspension developed after two years of research and consumer feedback. SRS provides a smooth comfortable ride and advanced stability. Smart Traction Control (STC) features upgraded drive performance at higher speeds (up to 6.25 miles per hour) and improved tracking. 4-pole motors Q-Logic 3e or Q-Logic 3 controller Increased speeds up to 6mph LED front and rear fender lights Optional 245 mm of power adjustable safe seat elevation at speeds of up to 3.5 mph

products.name: Alber e-fix E35/E36 Wheelchair Power Assist

detail.description: With the Alber e-fix E35/E36 Wheelchair Power Assist, you can turn your manual wheelchair into a compact electric wheelchair! The drive can be individually programmed and can therefore be adapted perfectly to your personal needs. The electric add-on drive is the simple way to increase your freedom of movement. The e-fix also allows you to cover greater distances and handle slopes effortlessly. The Alber e-fx components are lightweight and compact, and can be quickly removed from the wheelchair without the need for tools. The speed can be set up to 4mph using the easy-grip controller. As a rule, the slower you drive, the swifter the wheelchair reacts. You steer, the e-fix responds! If the situation requires it, the e-fix can also be easily moved by hand: You uncouple the drive wheels with a handle and your wheelchair can be pushed by hand as usual – either using the push rims or by an attendant. The manual wheels can usually still be used too. Gain extra features with the optional Mobility Plus Package including the easyNavi wheelchair route finder, remote control and speed upgrade to 5mph.

products.name: Alber Via Go Wheelchair Power Pack

detail.description: The Alber Via Go Wheelchair Power Pack is a high quality, user-friendly power assist designed to fit most rigid and folding manual wheelchairs. Compact and convenient – its lightweight design and compact dimensions makes this unit very easy to handle and ideal for day-to-day tasks and excursions. It can be removed quickly if required and stowed away to save space. Strong and enduring – even on inclines, ramps and uneven surfaces. the via GO provides the right amount of power assistance just when you need it. Simply press the plus or minus symbol on the control to adjust the speed. Intuitive and flexible – the via GO is so straightforward you can use it immediately. Its large buttons with make control a breeze. With via GO the unit doesn’t need to be removed when folding the wheelchair. It has a range of up to 10 miles, depending on the terrain, and can power up slopes up to 16% gradient with a max speed of 3.4mph. The control unit simply attaches to the push handles of the chair and can be mounted either left or right depending on your preference. The power assist unit neatly attaches via a bracket underneath the wheelchair. Charging the unit is easy and straightforward.

The TurnAid Patient Turning System enables careful in-bed repositioning and turning of clients at the touch of a button. The patient turning system enables nursing staff to reposition and turn the patient in a gentle and dignified manner, using a hands-off approach. In addition, the TurnAid reduces strain on the back for nursing staff and family members during the repositioning of patients weighing up to 350kg. Excessive spinal loading and resultant back pain are significantly minimised. The TurnAid system is easy to install on almost all community-style profiling beds, using appropriate adaptors where necessary. The basic functions of the bed are retained, and the system can be used together with pressure-relieving mattresses for rapid treatment of pressure damage. With the TurnAid, mobilising in and out of bed is much easier for clients, thanks to the solid bars at the sides of the mattress. Here is an overview of the TurnAid’s functions: To find out how the TurnAid patient turning system could help your organisation save money on care packages whilst improving dignity and quality in care, please call us or request a free trial here . detail.description: The Karma VIP2 Tilting & Reclining Wheelchair allows wheelchair users with weak trunk control to travel like everyone else. The tilt-in-space and reclining function provide the optimal pressure relief and positioning settings. And thanks to its foldable and lightweight design, it’s also car transportable. Tilt-in-Space : Allows the wheelchair user to change position throughout the day, which will redistribute and relieves pressure. This feature helps reduce the risk of developing pressure ulcer and prevent discomfort associated with prolonged sitting. The weight shifting system provides a steady smooth recline and a sense of security for the user when reclining. Anti-Sliding Reclining System : Solves the problem of sliding by locating the reclining pivot point of the chair and bringing the user’s hip joint closer to it. This placement synchronises the motion of the body and the chair and minimizes the sliding and the shearing when reclining or sitting upright. Adjustable and Detachable Armrests : Adjust the height of the armrests, with no tools required. Easily removable for transfers and transport. Detachable Swing-away Footrest : Allows for easy transfer, on and off the wheelchair and detaches with no tools required. Tension Adjustable Backrest : Use the adjustable Velcro straps to change the tension and conform according to the wheelchair user. This helps to prevent slouching and the hammock effect. Clean, Comfortable, and Fresh : the removable upholstery is anti-microbial, breathable and washable. Crash Tested : The VIP2 is approved for transportation in accordance with ISO 7176-19. This means it is suitable to be used as a seat in a motor vehicle for transport.

detail.description: The NRS Walk Safe® is a revolutionary lightweight indoor walking frame with a brand-new design that’s proven to be twice as stable when turning, compared to the traditional zimmer frame. Created in partnership with the University of Salford and backed by four years of academic research and development, the Walk Safe® is a game-changer, truly breaking free of the walking frame mould which has barely changed in 70 years. Easy and safe turning The incredible new castor design on the Walk Safe® lets you turn as you walk, without having to lift the whole frame up. You get smoother, more stable turns and a more natural walking movement. With Magnetic Directional Bias, the wheels return to a forward-facing position once you’ve made your turn, giving you much more control when you travel in a straight line. Combined rear pressure brake and glide A combined glide and brake on the rear legs gives you a smooth motion and controlled stopping all in one handy feature. The glide travels smoothly over your home’s surfaces and thresholds, rather than the jerky movement of a traditional rear ferrule. However, if you apply pressure to the frame, the rear brake contacts the floor to bring you to a safe stop. Built-in lower handles This newest zimmer frame on the market also has two lower handles, cleverly designed to give you extra support when you stand up from your chair, sofa, or bed – as well as when you sit back down again. They’re particularly useful if your chair doesn’t have armrests, or if you’re getting up from a bed or sofa. Positioned so that the Walk Safe® won’t tip when you use them correctly to stand or sit, these lower handles are at a much easier height to aid you from a sitting position. More great features: Available in two sizes – each height and width adjustable Large 125mm wheels Lightweight, fully welded frame Cushioned upper handles Heavy duty max. user weight of 230kg (36 stone) Compatible with the Buckingham Caddy 2-year guarantee

detail.description: Removable lead skirts for the ImageFlow Imaging & Fluoroscopy Stretcher . IR(ME)R (Ionising Radiation (Medical Exposure) Regulations) is UK legislation that ensures ionising radiation (e.g. X-rays and fluoroscopy) is used only when justified, optimised and kept as low as reasonably practicable (ALARP) , while still achieving the required clinical outcome. It also places legal responsibilities on employers and duty holders to protect patients, staff and others from unnecessary radiation exposure. How our lead skirts support NHS Trusts: Reduce scatter radiation exposure to staff during fluoroscopy and interventional procedures. Help Trusts meet their obligations to optimise radiation protection and maintain a safe working environment. Contribute to ALARP by providing effective shielding where engineering controls alone are not sufficient. Support staff safety, regulatory compliance and good radiation protection practice as part of a Trust’s overall IR(ME)R and IRR17 radiation safety programme.

detail.description: Meet the most luxurious mobility scooter with a canopy on the market today – introducing the Cabin Car Mk2Plus. Scooterpac have yet again delivered another fantastic mobility innovation, packed full of features. It soon becomes apparent why the word Car is in the title. With the Cabin Car Mk2 Plus’ Luxury Captain Seat, Alloy Wheels and even windscreen washer and wipers, it’s the perfect choice for anyone transitioning from car to scooter or looking for that bold upgrade. Safety and security in the Cabin Car Mk2 Plus have been placed as Scooterpac’s number one priority, with secure Remote Central Locking & Rear Parking Sensors fitted as standard. Considering it’s one of the larger scooters in its class, parking while you are out and about has never been easier, with the reversing camera. The crystal clear display inside the Cabin enables you to see exactly what is behind you when backing up. You will be ready to face whatever the weather throws at you. The Cabin Car Mk2 Plus is comprised of a fully insulated fiberglass shell and with the cosy Interior Heater as standard, warmth and protection from the elements is guaranteed. In the warmer months both windows slide down, enabling that cooling breeze to flow through. The comfortable delta tiller and easy to read digital display along with user friendly controls for the powerful LED lights, indicators, horn and windscreen wiper, makes the Cabin Car Mk2 Plus an absolute joy to drive. Your safety and wellbeing throughout your journey are paramount. There are hazard warning lights and a high/low switch to select the speed modes, 4mph or 8mph. Getting in and out of the scooter is a breeze – the wide doors open in reverse to allow greater access. With the powerful motor and strong suspension system, the Cabin Car Mk2 Plus can handle a variety of terrains. In fact, you may find yourself going places that you have never ventured before on a mobility scooter. This top of the line mobility scooter is fully manufactured in the UK

Explore uncharted territories with the Invader, the ultimate off road mobility vehicle! As the only mobility scooter specifically engineered to overcome the most challenging trails, the Invader draws a crystal clear line in the sand – no surface is off limits. Supporting you to enjoy the outdoors, just as mother nature intended. No driving licence is required to drive this road legal vehicle and is suitable for those with mobility challenges. Grab your leathers and kick start your adventure… All-Wheel Drive The Invader is driven by two formidable independent motors, integrated into the front wheel hub and mounted to the rear axle. Get out of sticky situations with the included rear differential which powers each wheel independently. With a simple touch of a button, take the level of torque to the top floor by switching from Rear-Wheel to All-Wheel Drive mode. Kickstarting the front brushless hub motor increases the Invader’s pulling power guaranteeing the ride of your life. Off The Beaten Track Unshackle your imagination. With impressive off-road capabilities, navigate previously unattainable and hard to reach environments. From farmland, forests, beaches, to snow, dirt and uneven tracks – where will your reality take you. Become limitless. Super Grip Tyres With aggressive tread patterns and an enormous surface area, these tyres provide superb grip for the wheels in off-road environments including gravel, sand and snow. Suspension The Invader features a complete suspension system. Dual inverted forks increase front rigidity, offering great handling and feedback particularly when cornering or braking. Balancing control with comfort, the softly sprung rear shocks absorb bumps and uneven surfaces. Biker Footrests Bring out the cruiser within you with these Harley inspired biker footrests. The Freedom Chair A08L Folding Electric Wheelchair is a travel powerchair, with a larger seat than the A06L , and extra options such as a seat lifter. With airline-friendly lithium batteries, the A08L can be folded in one easy movement, and taken on planes, coaches or transported in the boot of a car. The Freedom Chair A08L Folding Electric Wheelchair can be easily folded in just seconds into a compact trolley that can be wheeled around using the freewheel mode. The compact design makes it very easy to transport by car or plane and storage space needed inside an apartment or cruise ship cabin is minimal. Airline approved lithium-ion batteries make it the perfect travel powerchair, with a battery test certificate available. Use up to 3 rechargeable lithium-ion batteries to give yourself twice the power and range. Each battery has a range of up to 9 miles, so a total of 27 miles may be possible depending on terrain and user weight. An adaptor cable is included for more convenient off-board charging. Electromagnetic brakes automatically hold you on a hill as soon as the joystick is released. Flip-up armrests make it easy to transfer on and off the powerchair from the side and allow you to get closer to a desk or table. A built-in USB charging port under the joystick means you can top up your smartphone on the move. There is also a bright LED light that can be turned on to light your path ahead. A handy under-seat bag and back storage compartment provide plenty of space for carrying personal items. Anti-tippers with shock-absorbers are fitted as standard.

With the Rehasense PAWS Tourer wheelchair handbike, you can embark on your adventures with confidence, even in uncharted territories. This power add-on is specifically designed for off-road use, allowing you to conquer various terrains such as sand, gravel, and cobblestones, among others. The PAWS Tourer boasts the longest wheelbase in its range, providing exceptional stability and a smooth ride while touring. Equipped with large 20in drive wheels, it effortlessly tackles roots and uneven terrain, ensuring a comfortable journey throughout your explorations. Thanks to the innovative (optional) Auto Clamp and Auto Lift functions, PAWS Tourer offers the most user friendly docking and lifting process on the market, including for people with reduced finger and hand functions as well as limited body strength. Optional Tetra Controls enables individuals with missing or limited hand functions to operate power add-ons easily and safely, empowering them to regain independence and freedom. With the ability to adjust the height and depth, there is an extensive range of settings available to ensure you can set the handlebars to the optimum position for comfort. The display is mounted centrally on the handlebar and can be adjusted to the ideal position. Information on view includes your speed, travel distance, battery status and activated assistance systems. PAWS Tourer does not need any frame alteration or additional bracketry to your wheelchair and the range of adjustment in the clamping system allows a wide range of folding and rigid frame chairs to be fitted. products.name: Pride Jazzy Carbon Ultra Lite Powerchair

detail.description: The Pride Jazzy Carbon Ultra Lite folding powerchair makes an ideal travel electric wheelchair, weighing just 14.5kg and with a one-touch folding system. It travels up to 4mph with ease, both indoors and on flat outdoor surfaces like pavements. Equipped with lithium batteries, it’s also safe for air travel. Your comfort and convenience are also considered, with an onboard USB charger so you can keep your devices powered up while on the move. And you can enjoy a tailored driving experience with an adjustable control position, comfortable seat, and supportive armrests and footrest. The footrest folds away to reduce the transport size, and make transfers on and off the powerchair easier. Whether navigating around your home or the office, enjoying lunch at a café, or travelling abroad, the Pride Jazzy carbon fibre powerchair ensures you stay mobile and comfortable.

The 2000 series shower and changing tables has a low start position, to make transfers to the bench easier, and with washable coated canvas for easy cleaning. The flexibility of the shower and changing table provides for optimal working conditions for the carer as well as a high level of comfort and safety for the user. Offering Pressalit’s renowned quality and ergonomic features, the SCT 2000 includes: Integrated gas cylinders enable the table to be folded out of the way when not in use to maximise floor space in front of the unit. Construction in powder-laquered stainless steel, canvas cover in PVC-coated polyester (for extra durability), water collection tray in PVC-U. Foldable safety rail and water collection tray with integrated outlet. The flexible hose attached to the centre mounted outlet of the water collection tray can be connected to either an outlet in the floor or on the all. The stretcher cover can be unzipped for washing or easy replacement.

detail.description: The Kingkraft Eclipse is a entry-level height adjustable bath for disabled persons offering discreet mobility support for assisted bathing needs. Using the hand-held remote control, the Eclipse moves up and down, ensuring that it is perfectly adjusted to the correct height to enable the user to step in, or be transferred in, via a ceiling track hoist. When the user is in position, the bath height can then be adjusted to enable a carer to assist; helping promote safe manual handling practice. This bath is an ideal choice for installation within a care setting where there may be multiple users. Alternatively, it would also be beneficial within a family home environment where it may be used by other family members. The Eclipse is designed and styled to look like a regular bath and not something you may expect from typical bathroom disability equipment. With a contemporary appearance, the Kingkraft Eclipse bath would compliment any modern setting. The functionality of the Eclipse can also be extended with Kingkraft bath cushions and supports, as well as spa options, including LED Sensory Lighting, Whirlpool Spa and Bluetooth Music System. Made in the UK, Kingkraft manufacture the Multibath to the highest quality and safety standards, with internal insulation and RADA anti-scald TMV3 thermostatic mixer taps supplied as standard. Kingkraft offer a 2 Year Guarantee as standard, with optional Gold, Silver & Bronze Warranty & Service Packages for added peace of mind into the future.

The lying surface is made of a non-rip high tension vinyl material, which gives a hammocking effect for added comfort and safety. detail.description: Pressalit’s MSCT1 is a mobile shower change trolley with electric height adjustment. It offers top quality functionality and ergonomics for safe and efficient hygiene. The MSCT1 is supplied with a battery and charger and the height and angle adjustment are operated by a remote control. It’s equipped with central braking and bumpers on all four corners. All contact surfaces are smooth and easy to clean to prevent build up of dirt and bacteria. Intuitive, one hand operated safety rails allows the carer to maintain eye contact as well as physical contact with the user during the whole process, the foldable safety rails also provide easy access from all four sides of the table. The cut-out grips in the safety rails enable users to assist when being turned. A storage drawer enables the carer to store supplies and place what is needed for the shower immediately at hand in advance. The Pressalit MSCT1 has a lowered drainage area, which removes water from the corners and reduces the amount of leftover water for easy drainage and drying. The trolley also tilts to 3 degrees for efficient water discharge and an open drain and enlarged hose ensures easy drainage that even allows human waste to pass through.
