detail.description: The Novus is a portable scooter that can be manually folded in seconds using a large frame release handle. Weighing 19.8kg, it’s much lighter than the auto-fold Vitus scooter so it’s even easier to lift in and out of the car boot. It’s super compact and features a carry handle under the seat base, so it can be easily stored, lifted and stowed. With an extra padded seat and backrest cushions, padded armrests and a height adjustable tiller, the Novus mobility scooter offers a comfortable ride. Your safety is covered well too, with rear anti-tip wheels, electromagnetic braking with anti-rollback function and solid puncture-proof tyres. The Novus is also ready for all types of travel, with an airline-friendly lithium battery and folding design with trolley mode that makes it ideal for cruises and bus trips too. Operating your scooter is simple, with an easy-to-use analogue display and option for on-board and off-board charging.

The STRIDER is a Hospital Stretcher designed to safely transport patients around your hospital. Its stable two-column construction, supported by large wheels and an optional 5th wheel, facilitates easy manoeuvring through a busy hospital. The full-length side rails comply with 60601-2-52 and are tested to withstand a vertical pressure of over 100kg. Ergonomic features designed for the comfort of medical staff, such as folding push handles and a central braking system, allow them to focus on the patient’s needs. The STRIDER is imaging-ready, with a translucent mattress platform and an inbuilt sliding cassette tray that allows imaging of the patient along the entire length of the trolley without any concerns as to cassette entrapment. The STRIDER Stretcher is now available to purchase via a leasing agreement – get in touch here . The STRIDER Stretcher is available to trial and purchase from Felgains – get in touch here .

products.name: Kingkraft Multibath SE Disabled Bath with Seat

detail.description: The Kingkraft Multibath SE is a height adjustable bath for disabled persons with a powered seat, providing additional support for transfers in and out of the bath. The Multibath SE assisted bath features a transfer seat which addresses both the needs of the carer and the bather. The seat not only lowers to a convenient height for wheelchair or hoist transfers, but also rotates automatically to lift the bather into the bath tub. Once the bather is comfortably seated in the bath, the carer can raise the bath height to a safe working height. When finished, the bath tub can be lowered, leaving the bather on the bath chair ready to be dried, before rotating and lowering the bather out of the bath. The Multibath seat is moulded for safe and comfortable bathing, with folding armrests. As with the Multibath, the Multibath SE assisted bath maintains recessed side panels to provide the lowest step-in height available. This innovative feature makes transfers in and out of the bath easy, safe and accessible, while promoting independence for ambulant users. The recessed base also enables carers to position themselves as close as possible to the bather. The versatility of the Multibath SE extends further with optional additional functionality. It can be complemented with Kingkraft bath cushions and supports to provide added comfort and postural support for bathers. A range of spa systems are available, including LED Sensory Lighting, Whirlpool Spa and Bluetooth Music System, adding sensory dynamics to make bathing an even more relaxing experience. All care needs are supported in a robust but contemporary bath tub that fits in to a modern, homely environment. Made in the UK, Kingkraft manufacture the Multibath SE to the highest quality and safety standards, with internal insulation and RADA anti-scald TMV3 thermostatic mixer taps supplied as standard. The Kingkraft Multibath is a height adjustable bath for disabled persons offering excellent versatility to meet a wide range of assisted bathing needs. The Neptune bath lift has an compact design with a fixed back, which maximises legroom in the bath and combines with a low seat height to allow good immersion in the bath. It blends discreetly into your bathroom and is compact and light enough to easily carry and store. Despite its light weight, it offers a maximum user weight of 25 stone. Suitable for most types of bath and simply sits in your bathtub, securely attached with four suction feet. A slimline hand control with large rocker switches makes operating the bath chair easy even if you have limited dexterity. Safely use the Neptune without electricity in the bathroom. The Neptune bath lift is powered by a fully waterproof, rechargeable battery hand control. The battery will indicate when it needs recharging and its Stop Descent feature stops the bath lift lowering you into your bath if the battery is too low. Easily remove the Netpune from your bath at any time to take away or free up bath space for other users. Its simple design with smooth surfaces makes it easy to clean and gives good access for cleaning your bathtub as usual.

products.name: Alber E-Motion M25 Wheelchair Power Assist Wheels

detail.description: Alber’s e-motion M25 power assist wheels can fit onto almost any wheelchair and allow you to move, steer and brake your chair with very little effort. With a support speed of up to 5.2mph and a range of 15 miles, you can reach your destination with ease. Whether it’s longer distances, slopes or carrying a few more kilos in luggage, e-motion can keep you moving while protecting muscles and joints from overwork. Key Features & Benefits Sensors built into e-motion’s push-rims activate the motors as you initiate pushing, measuring your drive movement and providing you with tailored power assistance. The sensitivity can be adjusted and there’s a range of rim styles to suit your needs. The optional ECS remote control enables you to choose assistance levels for indoor and outdoor use and activates a clever hill holder function that prevents your wheelchair rolling on slopes. E-motion’s Mobility App offers a range of driving profiles and allows you to enable the maximum speed of 5.2mph. You can also activate cruise control, an innovative function that maintains a set speed on a single push of the handrims. The e-motion drive wheels are available in 22, 24 and 25 inch diameters and can be easily attached and detached from your wheelchair without the need for tools. Lightweight and compact, you can take e-motion power assist everywhere you go. Book a demo and test drive at: Felgains 33 Knightsdale Road Ipswich , Suffolk IP1 4JJ Phone: 01473 741144 Email: mail@felgains.com

detail.description: The Alber Smoov is a power assist drive unit for active wheelchairs, adding a new level of mobility to your chair by converting it to a power chair with a top speed of 10 km/h. Highly durable and functional, it can be fitted to most folding and rigid wheelchairs and offers consistently high performance, with a 360° swivel drive wheel which maintains speed and manoeuvrability even on uneven terrain. Key Features & Benefits Easy docking and undocking : easily mount or remove your Smoov power assist at any time with the carrying handle that can be accessed while your seated in your wheelchair. Combined with its lightweight construction, this makes it a breeze to transport. Effortless control : enjoy on-demand power with the Bluetooth hand control unit, which can be mounted either side of your chair. Just spin to adjust speed and tap to turn off, keeping track of battery life on the display. Go hands free as you choose. Dynamic power : rely on high performance across a wide variety of even and uneven surfaces – think carpet, grass, gravel – and power up hills and slopes of up to 16%. You can even safely ride tilted over kerbs with the Smoov’s flexible wheel and 360 degree swivel fork. Everyday convenience : it’s even equipped with a handy USB socket, so you can charge your phone on the go. And adjust and extend the power drive’s functions with the SMOOV Mobility App. Book a demo and test drive at: Felgains 33 Knightsdale Road Ipswich IP1 4JJ United Kingdom (UK) Phone: 01473 741144 Email: mail@felgains.com

products.name: Alber V12 Viaplus Wheelchair Power Pack

detail.description: The Alber Viaplus V12 is a power pack which fits the Invacare Azalea and Clematis comfort wheelchairs, relieving carers from the effort of manually pushing the chair. You can simply engage and disengage the drive wheels at the touch of a button, and you’re ready to go. With automatic braking and an intelligent spring system which compensates for bumps and uneven terrain, you’re assured of a safe and comfortable ride. Key Features & Benefits The V12 powerpack can be dismantled without tools for easy storage or transport, or it can be left on the wheelchair without restricting use of any functions, including tilt-in-space All functions are clearly marked on a handy, non-slip grip control knob that can be operated with just one hand – for easiest possible use from the word go. The rechargeable battery of the viaplus is mounted inconspicuously below the seat of the wheelchair and is powerful enough for even long walks. It can be quickly and easily recharged using the battery charger supplied with it

detail.description: The TransitFlow Outdoor Portering Chair has been specifically designed for outdoor patient transfers, with a weatherproof coating on all metal parts and a weatherproof and hard-wearing plastic seat. Fitted with 300mm rear wheels and a central braking system, the TransitFlow makes light work of any uneven and rough surfaces you may have at your site, making your Porter’s job easier and the patient experience more comfortable. A large range of accessories are available, including IV poles, cylinder holders, coin lock systems, and much more. The powered drive system takes the strain of pushing off your staff, reducing the risk of injury and making the patient experience more comfortable. products.name: Alerta Folding Bedside Crash Mat with Wireless Alert

detail.description: The Alertamat Crash Mat with Wireless Nurse Call Alert is designed to be placed next to the bed to minimise injury if the user should fall from bed and activates the nurse call system when a fall occurs. This helps prevent a user remaining on the mat undetected for an unknown length of time after falling, by alerting the caregiver to provide timely assistance. A wireless connect-and-play system, the mat incorporates sensor pads and a Wireless Transmitter within the foam which connects to the Alerta Wall Point Receiver (sold separately). It can be connected to a nurse call system for centralised activation, or used on its own, independent of a nurse call system to give localised alerts through the Alerta Wall Point Receiver only. The volume can be deactivated for silent in-room operation when connected to a nurse call system. The Alertamat Crash Mat is quick and easy to position and benefits from a PU wipe clean surface. When unfolded the mat is 180cm long x 60cm wide x 6cm high. The mat folds in half for easy storage and transportation.

The Robooter E40 Powerchair is a sleek, foldable indoor electric wheelchair that seamlessly combines performance, portability, and style. Designed for easy daily use with comfortable leg space and a small turning radius, it is powered by a robust 20AH lithium-ion battery, covering an impressive 14.3 miles on a single charge. With smooth maneuverability on various floor surfaces, its lightweight design makes it ideal for transportation in cars, airplanes, and more. Perfect for tight spaces, the E40 features a small turning radius of just 450mm (17in), making it ideal for elevators and navigating through compact areas in offices, apartments or bedrooms. With remote control capability, you can take command of your wheelchair from the palm of your hand! Control it remotely using your phone, adding a new level of convenience to your mobility experience. You can also benefit from easy transfers on and off the Robooter E40 powerchair, with flip-up armrests and a flip-up footrest. The Invacare Action Ampla Bariatric Wheelchair is a multi-award winning self-propelled wheelchair especially designed to cater for the needs of bariatric or plus sized individuals, taking into consideration varying body shapes and activity levels. With a durable but lightweight rigid aluminium frame and an active rear wheel position for easier access to the handrims, the Ampla’s clever design enables a more natural position of the upper body allowing optimal energy transfer during propulsion. Inbuilt trolley mode The Ampla wheelchair can also negotiate doorways and passageways effortlessly in most environments with an optional smart transportation system to the rear of the frame. In three simple steps you can stand to tilt the wheelchair onto the transportation system and roll the complete chair on its rear through doorways. Key features Unique backrest design: ensuring free movement of the upper limbs when propelling. The innovative backrest also adjusts to allow for a perfect fit for both plus-size male and female users. Multi-functional transfer levers: support standing transfers, offers a resting position for the forearm and can be adjusted in height giving access up to and under tables or desks. Sleek and minimalist: with its modern appearance, the Ampla wheelchair provides independence and support for a comfortable and active lifestyle. Award winning: Invacare Action Ampla has won a Red Dot Award for Product Design. This award is not only the largest product competition in the world, but also one of the most prestigious design awards. The Action Ampla wheelchair has also won the Italian Platinum A’Design Award and the Gold German Design Award.

From a super lightweight rigid design built with powerful geometry, to a precise fit with even more options, the KSL delivers tailored performance for you. The new hydroformed frame brings a unique and modern styling to the KSL wheelchair. Additionally, the frame profile provides increased rigidity and ergonomic grip to support comfortable repositioning and transfers. Super Lightweight The Kuschall KSL wheelchair is one of the lightest wheelchairs on the market, with a transport weight starting at just 4.3 kg! This makes it more than 15% lighter than the adjustable Kuschall K-Series. Centre of Gravity The KSL with COG (Centre of Gravity) is a new dynamic option giving you more adjustment. Simply choose the right wheel position for you at anytime. Fully Welded The KSL with FW (Fully Welded) gives even better agility and performance in the chair. This option is a complete box frame from the front to the back and features a built-in grab bar for even easier handling. Premium Features as Standard A carbon camber bar and carbon fixed clothesguards are just some of the premium features supplied as standard on the Kuschall KSL, for a truly high-end finish. One Solution Invacare’s One Solution is now available on the Kuschall KSL 2.0 wheelchair, offering even more options and customisations across their portfolio, including Matrx backs.

The Invacare Action 5 Active Wheelchair is designed for the more active individual, looking for an affordable chair with great drive performance and the ability to fold easily for handling, storage and transportation purposes. Key features include a unique folding mechanism with the stability of a rigid chair, in a highly configurable frame with quick step-less adjustability. With it’s two new advanced innovations and lightweight construction, the new Action 5 gives you a wheelchair you can enjoy and rely on. Unique folding mechanism The innovative design of the chair allows the frame to greatly reduce in size and the backrest to fold on top of the seat, making the chair compact. No additional handling is required to fold the chair, making it effortless for storage and transportation. Stability of a rigid wheelchair The ‘H-Shaped’ horizontal folding mechanism provides an improved level of stability compared to other folding wheelchairs on the market. The self-locking function ensures a secure seat position and makes the chair far easier to propel effectively improving drive performance. Adjust the chair whilst you remain seated The Action 5 wheelchair’s clever design allows backrest angle adjustments to be made whilst the person remains in the chair. The step-less adjustability makes it easy to ensure the perfect fit for you, while the built in scale allows for a more accurate backrest angle to be set for postural comfort. It’s also available in a spectrum of seat sizes from paediatric to larger models, making the Action 5 a great solution when accommodating narrower and longer or wider and shorter specifications. Make it personal There are a variety of vibrant colours available to choose from, allowing you to design your wheelchair around your personality. The Action 5 can also be configured based on your individual needs, starting from selecting a more active look with the fixed frame, or the swing away version for even easier folding and transportation. detail.description: The FLARE Operating Table from Famed works seamlessly with a C-arm camera. It is tailored for numerous procedures, including cardiovascular surgery, neurosurgery, urological surgery, orthopaedic surgery, spine pain therapy, and endoscopic procedures. The ergonomic, profiled, and thin TotalClear™ tabletop is completely transparent to X-rays and is made entirely of high-quality carbon fibre, maximally reducing the radiation dose that is passed on to the patient during the procedure. Thanks to this, intraoperative imaging is safer for the patient and staff. Choosing the right table position is easy thanks to a joystick, which allows the precise movement of the tabletop in any direction. The Alerta MoveAssist Standing & Transfer Aid is a transfer assist unit which makes transfer functions of all types quick and easy, requiring minimal caregiver assistance. The Alerta MoveAssist promotes user engagement and enhances mobility. Each unit is equipped with a crossbar which users can grasp and pull themself up into a standing position using their own strength. The padded split seats swing out allowing the user to stand up and board the unit. The caregiver then flips the split seats back into place to form a secure and comfortable seat for the user to sit on for the remainder of the transfer. A user who qualifies to use the Alerta MoveAssist Standing & Transfer Aid must have enough leg and lower body strength to stand up and remain in the standing/sitting position. Adequate arm strength is required if the user must use the crossbar. Users who satisfy these criteria and have difficulty walking or present a potential for falling down will find the Alerta MoveAssist a useful and safe transfer device. For users who lack these requirements, a stand aid hoist is recommended. detail.description: The Komfi Rider Marlin is an extremely lightweight, comfortable, strong and stable mobility scooter that can be easily disassembled for transportation. With a chassis manufactured from ultra-lightweight aircraft-grade aluminium for optimum durability and long-lasting use, the heaviest part weighs less than 12kg! Combined with the ultra-light but high capacity lithium battery, the Marlin offers a great solution if you need a ‘car-transportable’ scooter and want to be able to travel a distance. You can extend the range even further with 34ah batteries, offering a huge amount of power while lightweight and easy to remove for charging and transportation. Lightweight but highly capable, the large 230mm diameter wheels allows the Marlin mobility scooter to easily tackle uneven terrain and thanks to its advanced engineered full front and rear suspension complete with the comfortable and spacious deep foam seat, you can always be sure to have an enjoyable driving experience. You may have sat on other similar sized scooter and felt cramped? You won’t with the Komfi Rider Marlin thanks to its unique ‘patented’ shallow floor plate design that helps provide exceptional legroom, even for the taller user. detail.description: Custom-made to fit the Hillrom HR900 Hospital Bed, the Solace Split Rail bumpers by Felgains are primarily used to prevent impact injuries, but they can also reduce the risk of limb entrapment when securely affixed to the bed rail. The Solace Split Rail Bumpers for the HR900 may also help Trusts to reduce risks associated with side rails and entrapment following the ‘ National Patient Safety Alert: Medical beds, trolleys, bed rails, bed grab handles and lateral turning devices: risk of death from entrapment or falls ( NatPSA /2023/010/MHRA)’, following assessment and appropriate management. When the bumpers are fitted, the side rail controls are deliberately covered to increase patient safety*. If the optional hand control has been left hanging on the side rail, the bumper will still cover this. Access to the CPR lever and side rail release button is unhindered. The Solace Split Rail Bumpers have space to record which ward the bumpers belong to – reducing the risk of them getting lost or mislaid, and handing is clearly denoted with ‘INSIDE’ printed on the patient-facing side. *If required, we can have a cutout to allow controls on the side rail to be used.

detail.description: The OpFlex is a day surgery stretcher manufactured by Famed, built to withstand the daily pressures of day surgery departments. It is manoeuvrable, highly adjustable and available with a wide range of accessories optimised for different procedures. The OpFlex is an operating table and patient transport stretcher all in one – well-suited for High-Volume, Low-Complexity procedures. The design of the OpFlex incorporates an off-centre lifting column and intelligent motor positioning to maximise X-ray compatibility. With a greater range of lateral tilt, headrest adjustment, backrest adjustment and footrest adjustment than any other product in its class, the OpFlex is the natural choice for most common day surgery procedures. The ability to easily program 3 standard positions into the hand control saves time for certain procedures where the same positioning is always adopted. The ferrule has flexible bellows that absorb shock when contact is made with a surface, which minimises discomfort in the arm and upper body. The flexible foot also remains fully in contact all the time, making for a smoother transition with each step and maximising traction. The height adjustable walking stick has been manufactured using lightweight, premium grade aluminium and has superior tooled joints for added strength and stability. These joints enable the stick to be folded into a compact size for storing.

products.name: FlexyFoot Soft Grip Open Cuff Crutches

detail.description: The FlexyFoot Soft Grip Open Cuff Crutches have an open cuff which allows you to easily move your arm in and out, for quicker starts and stops. These crutches are adjustable in two places on the shaft, both above and below the handle. This makes fitting the crutches to both your height and arm length easy. The soft grip handle sits nicely in the palm of the hand for comfort over long periods of use Each foot has the revolutionary FlexyFoot ferrule that absorbs shock on landing, greatly minimises discomfort in your arms and upper body. The flexible foot also remains fully in contact all the time, making for a smoother transition with each step and maximising traction.

The Glida Dining Chair with Skids has a skid base that easily allows you to slide the chair to and from the table. As well as making it easier to move the chair, the skids add strength to the frame of the chair. The solid beech frames are backed by a 5-year guarantee so you can be confident these wooden dining chairs will last for the long term. The Glida wooden dining chair is available in a range of Crib 5 fabric or vinyl upholstery, so it’s an ideal option for care homes, assisted living, or anywhere a waterproof or wipe clean dining chair is needed. Extended wooden handgrips make getting on and off the chair easier Comfortable and supportive upright seat, ideal for dining rooms Made in the UK

The solid hardwood frames are backed by a 5-year guarantee so you can be confident these high seated chairs will last for the long term. The Valu Waterproof High Seat Chair is ideal for care homes or other healthcare environments, being available in a range of Crib 5 vinyl upholsteries. It’s also a great choice as a patient chair after discharge from hospital, or in any domestic setting where a wipe-clean, waterproof lounge chair is needed. detail.description: The Alerta Wireless Floor+ Alertamat is a long-life alert mat with hygiene and ease of use in mind. The light colour is ideal for dementia users who may otherwise try and avoid the mat. The large size also avoids the chance of overstepping the mat. Best placed by the bedside or in a doorway, the Floor Alertamat alerts the carer whenever a service user leaves their safe zone. The volume can be deactivated for silent in-room operation when connected to a nurse call system. No wires means this mat is more versatile and easier to use.

The Wireless Deluxe Alertamat is a robust alert mat, topped with genuine carpet and available in 5 colours meaning it can fit in with any room. This is especially Dementia friendly as it helps prevent users avoiding the mat. The large size also avoids the chance of overstepping the mat. It is well built, with long lasting welded seals and strong wiring. Most effective by a bed or in a doorway, it alerts the caregiver when the user leaves the safe zone. The volume can be deactivated for silent in-room operation when connected to a nurse call system. Available in: Beige, Grey, Rust, Blue or Red Dimensions: 600 x 900 mm / 23.5 x 35.5 inches

The Wireless Chair Alertamat allows a caregiver to monitor if the user is at risk without having to be right in the room all the time Best when concealed under the chair cushion for dignity and to avoid pressure damage risk, the Chair Alertamat automatically resets when the user sits back down on the chair. Dimensions: 250 x 380 mm / 10 x 15 inches

The Wireless Bed Alertamat allows the caregiver to monitor if the user is at risk without having to be right in the room all the time Best when concealed under the mattress for dignity and to avoid pressure damage risk. Automatically resets when the user gets back into bed. Dimensions: 250 x 760 mm / 10 x 30 inches

products.name: Alerta Wireless Alert Nurse Call Button

detail.description: The Alerta Wireless Alert Nurse Call Button gives you peace of mind you can call for help at any time. This wireless personal call button connects to a nurse call system via the Alerta Wall Point Receiver . It comes with a lanyard, and a holder that can be wall mounted. You can easily adjust volume between high, low and silent. It can be mains or battery powered – if using batteries, it requires 1x 12v 23A battery (supplied with product). The Wall Point Receiver can also be either mains or battery powered (1 x 12v 23a supplied). No cables, extra safe and versatile 95m wireless range from transmitter to receiver Low battery alert Please note: the user will need to be assessed for lanyard suitability – due to a potential risk of asphyxiation or restriction to blood flow.

detail.description: The E-Goes Joyrider Folding Electric Wheelchair is an ultra lightweight, compact, foldable and transportable powerchair. It has a minimalist design, folds easily and separates into two parts in a matter of seconds. Before folding, the Joyrider’s motor unit can be removed, keeping the heaviest part just 8.6kg! This makes it much easier to lift into and out of the car boot. The Joyrider Powerchair offers superb manoeuvrability in tight spaces, with the ability to turn on its own axis, and the ergonomic joystick gives you full control over direction and speed. Two brushless electric motors which provide a total of 400 watts which is enough to power the Joyrider up to 10 degree inclines with ease. An electromagnetic braking system ensures that the powerchair stops as soon as the joystick is released, preventing you from rolling forwards or backwards. Anti-tip wheels mounted to the rear give added reassurance on inclines and PU solid tyres both front and rear avoid punctures while out and about. Airline approved batteries make the Joyrider Electric Wheelchair an ideal travel companion and charging is made easy with on-board and off-board options, with a total charging time of 4.5-5.5 hours. Another great feature is the swinging footrest which allows you to get nice and close to the chair before sitting down, making transferring on and off the powerchair much easier!

The Quantum Edge 3 Stretto Electric Wheelchair is a mid-wheel drive powerchair that features an ultra-narrow base width for outstanding manoeuvrability, as well as SRS (Smooth Ride Suspension), making it the perfect indoor/outdoor electric wheelchair. An ultra-narrow base width of just 52cm combined with mid-wheel drive allows the Quantum Edge 3 Stretto Electric Wheelchair to turn on the spot for superb manoeuvrability indoors. Its performance outdoors is also impressive, with optional 6 mph motors and long-range 62 Ah batteries. • SRS (Smooth Ride Suspension) is a superior automotive-grade electric wheelchair power suspension developed after two years of research and consumer feedback. SRS provides a smooth comfortable ride and advanced stability. • LED lights come as standard, mounted to the fender above the drive tyres on each side, ensuring that you can see and be seen. • Choose from a range of control options, from the standard NE+ system to the Q-Logic 3 Advanced Drive Control System, an adaptable control system that includes wireless Bluetooth programming and device access, in-built USB charger and attendant control options. Contoured Seating • A basic Captain’s seating system available in a limited range of sizes, a simple option where special positioning isn’t needed. It features adjustable seat depth, height adjustable arms and a reclining back which folds flat, making it perfect for car boot hoisting. TB Flex Seating • TB Flex is an entry-level prescriptive seating system which is fully adjustable to suit your needs. It provides up to 30° of tilt, 254 mm (10 inches) of lift, can recline 95°-125°, and can tilt/recline up to 125°. TRU-Balance® 3 Power Positioning System • TRU-Balance® 3 Power Positioning System features quick adjustment with minimum fuss. An innovative design that maximises functional independence while providing an appealing look and feel. iLevel® seat lift is the stand-out feature on this seating system, allowing you to drive at 3.5 mph w

The Ottobock Juvo B4 Electric Wheelchair is a compact but super robust and durable powerchair for reliable everyday use. A rear-wheel drive powerchair, the B4 offers enhanced safety and comfortable damping characteristics for outdoor use. It is also compact and manoeuvrable indoors. Permanent drive wheel suspension compensates for uneven surfaces and the electric wheelchair’s small outside dimension makes it easier to drive through narrow doorways and navigate in confined spaces. Like all models in the Juvo product line, the B4 features a modular design and offers a high level of flexibility. The B4’s rear-wheel drive base is robust, durable and requires little maintenance. Driving through narrow doorways and navigating in confined spaces is made easier by a total width of just 59 cm. Smaller wheel sizes are available for indoor use. Permanent drive wheel suspension compensates for uneven surfaces and ensures enhanced safety and comfortable damping. This can be further optimised with an additional front suspension. Integrated anti-tipper rollers ensure enhanced safety and protect against damage when driving backward. External power supply sockets are a new feature on the Ottobock Juvo B4 Electric Wheelchair: 12 V, 24 V and a USB charging receptacle with two inputs. This means you can charge your mobile phone when you’re out and about. Choose your seating The Standard seating package comes in four sizes with an adaptable seat width and seat depth. It has a folding backrest tension adjustable back upholstery, flip-up armrests and choice of three leg support styles. The Vario Adjust Seat (VAS) is highly adjustable to precisely match your body measurements even if your needs change. The Ergo-Joint back angle adjustment largely eliminates shear forces. The seat frame holds a variety of mounting options including lateral supports. The Baxx Line ergonomic rigid backrests can be combined with VAS. detail.description: The Quantum Kozmo Electric Wheelchair is a rear-wheel drive powerchair that offers outstanding manoeuvrability, with a super compact design and an impressive turning circle, making it the perfect choice for confined indoor spaces. While not designed as an outdoor powerchair, it’s equally capable over flat, even surfaces like your local supermarket. Packed with great features such as adjustable seating, it offers more flexibility than the Go-Chair but is just as easy to dismantle for travel and storage. Sharing the same rear-wheel base as the Pride Go Chair, the Kozmo is a very compact electric wheelchair that easily manoeuvres around confined spaces indoors with a turning circle of just 645 mm. The Quantum Kozmo Electric Wheelchair is easy to dismantle into four pieces, with no tools required, so you can transport in your vehicle or store when not in use. The 18 Ah battery can be removed for off-board charging and provides enough power for everyday use. Adjustable seating gives you much more flexibility to achieve the support you need compared to other basic indoor powerchairs. As well as a range of seat sizes, customisation options include centre-mounted footboard or swing-away legrests. With a minimum seat size of 12 x 12 inches, the Kozmo powerchair makes an ideal paediatric electric wheelchair, and has in-built adjustability that means it can grow with your child. Controlled with an easy to use joystick which can be mounted on the left- or right-hand side. Other standard features include solid tyres and anti-tippers, as well as a lap belt and height adjustable armrests. Why we recommend Consider the Kozmo if you’re looking for an electric wheelchair that is simple to use for basic everyday use, but you need more comfort or adjustability than you get with other entry-level indoor electric wheelchair like the Pride Go Chair. It’s super manouevrable for getting around the home, school or shops and with a smart design, it fits well into a modern lifestyle.

detail.description: The VENDLET Disposable Turn Sheet is mounted on the VENDLET system’s two motorized bars, to facilitate the turning operation of the VENDLET. Made from 100 % nonwoven polypropylene. The disposable turning sheet is water-resistant, breathable and has received an anti-static treatment. This sheet is disposable and cannot be washed. The disposable turning sheet is 400 cm wide and can be used for mattresses with a width of up to 110cm. This sheet is suitable for the V5S / Bari models.

The VENDLET Disposable Slide Sheet fits over the mattress to provide a smooth surface for the turn sheet to slide over. This is for situations where the VENDLET is in position for a short time period or if there is a high risk of soiling. It fits over the mattress with elastic straps at each corner and velcro straps that affix to the mattress support platform before a turning sheet is attached to the bars. Made from 100% polyester, the slide sheet has been treated with an anti-bacterial and anti-static treatment. this sheet is disposable and cannot be washed. Compatible with both the V5S and Bari VENDLET Systems.

The VENDLET Cotton Turn Sheet is mounted on the VENDLET system’s two motorized bars, to facilitate the turning operation of the VENDLET. Made from 100% cotton for comfort and high wear resistance. Machine washable at 95°c. Should be changed and washed like a regular sheet. Cotton shrinks when washed – up to 4% shrinkage must be expected. Available in a range of widths to fit different size beds. V5S/Bari 350cm sheet (Velcro) fits an 80-110cm mattress V5S/Bari 400cm sheet (Velcro) fits a 110–130cm mattress

The VENDLET Slide Sheet fits over the mattress to provide a smooth surface for the turn sheet to slide over. It fits over the mattress with elastic straps at each corner and velcro straps that affix to the mattress support platform before a turning sheet is attached to the bars. Made from 100% nylon, the slide sheet has been treated with an anti-bacterial and anti-static treatment. Hand washable at 60°c. Do not iron or use fabric softener. Compatible with both V5S and Bari VENDLET Systems. Available in a range of widths to fit different size mattresses.

The OttoBock Juvo B5/B6 Electric Wheelchair have a modular design that offers almost boundless possibilities for assembling custom configurations for complex requirements. An electric wheelchair for both indoor and outdoor use, the OttoBock Juvo offers front-wheel, mid-wheel and rear-wheel drive, giving you the ability to choose between the specific driving characteristics and motor torques of three drive types across the two frame widths. In cooperation with therapists and users, Ottobock pays special attention to ergonomics, offering improved support for and enhanced functions for all-day use. The B5/B6 models offer solutions aimed at regaining mobility quickly with the unique “Quick Mobile” concept. Excellent serviceability with an appealing design and colour concept complete the image. Choose your drive type Rear wheel drive: designed for outdoor use, it offers excellent directional stability and handles well at high speeds. Mid-wheel drive: the most intuitive to drive with a very small turning radius for the best manoeuvrability. A unique torsion drive system gives you a smoother ride than many other centre wheel electric wheelchairs, with reduced rocking when going up kerbs and when stopping and starting. Front wheel drive: a compact base with good climbing abilities. With a small turning radius and the ability to get closer to furniture, it can be a good indoor option. Choose your seating The Standard seating package comes in four sizes with an adaptable seat width and seat depth. It has a folding backrest tension adjustable back upholstery, flip-up armrests and choice of three leg support styles. The Vario Adjust Seat (VAS) is highly adjustable to precisely match your body measurements even if your needs change. The Ergo-Joint back angle adjustment largely eliminates shear forces. The seat frame holds a variety of mounting options including lateral supports. The Baxx Line ergonomic rigid backrests can be combined with VAS. Offering a high level of stability

The Invacare Aviva RX Electric Wheelchair is the first in a new range of powerchairs from Invacare that promise to redefine rear wheel drive electric wheelchair performance. Combining an innovative method of managing centre of gravity for optimal weight distribution with superior suspension, they deliver unbeatable control, exceptional traction and extreme ride comfort. The AVIVA RX electric wheelchair has been designed to combat the challenges of everyday modern living, and whether at home, at work, or out and about, you’ll be ready to face what the world throws at you. The AVIVA RX is compact, adjustable and offers the most comfortable ride yet. You’ll power up hills, cover bumpy cobbles like they’re a smooth pavement and keep up with the pace of modern life. You’ll see better and be seen, and you can personalise your chair to match your personality. The Aviva family RX20 with Standard Seating RX20 with Modulite Seating RX40 with Standard Seating (larger front castors and bigger batteries) RX40 with Modulite Seating (larger front castors and bigger batteries) RX40 HD with Modulite Seating (635mm chassis width, 160 kg/25st maximum user weight) Suspension What’s special about the Aviva’s base is its patented CTC Suspension. It gives you great control, superior traction and extra comfort. It’s a compact chair that can really go the distance. The suspension can be easily changed between hard and soft to suit you. The technology works a bit like a ball and socket joint, so the base can move in all directions, giving you a smooth drive. LiNX® G-TRAC® technology The digital gyroscopic technology detects and corrects even the smallest deviation from your intended path, so you’ll go exactly where you want to go without having to tweak the control direction. It’s especially handy if you use any alternative control inputs with your chair. Go anywhere, anytime Because all four wheels always stay in contact with the ground, you’ll enjoy a smooth and comfortable drive. Going up

detail.description: The Karma Ergo Lite 2 Transit Wheelchair is an ultra lightweight transit wheelchair that shares the features of the Ergo Lite wheelchair and adds detachable, swing-away footrests for easier transfers on and off the wheelchair. Its low weight and ultra compact dimensions make it a perfect companion for trips to the local shops or taking on holiday! The folding, ultra lightweight aluminium frame makes it very manageable for lifting into a car boot A double cross-brace ensures it remains sturdy and durable An ergonomic S-shaped seat helps redistribute pressure and stops you sliding down the seat Aegis microbe shield protects the upholstery from bacteria and odours Push/pull braking system provides slowing and locking attendant brakes on the push handles Desk armrests allow you to get closer to a desk or table in the wheelchair Solid tyres are included as standard

detail.description: The Raizer Headrest is ergonomically designed to support the fallen person’s head and neck in a comfortable position. The Raizer headrest means that you don’t need to hold the fallen person’s head before, during or after the lift. As a result, you can better concentrate on the task in hand – and you’ll have a free hand to comfort the fallen person as you lift. This headrest has been created in response to feedback from our valuable customers. Many customers find the Raizer a lifechanging piece of equipment, but some struggled with supporting the neck whilst lifting the fallen person. The new Raizer Headrest truly solves this problem. The Raizer Headrest ensures a more comfortable and dignified experience for the fallen person and removes the risk of the fallen person incurring a neck or head injury before, during or after the lift. It also means that the person carrying out the lift has one less thing to worry about, and they can avoid any unnecessary manual handling. The Raizer Headrest’s simple one-piece tough plastic construction means that it is lightweight, strong and easy to wipe clean. And for practicality, the headrest fits into the standard Raizer component carry bag, so no extra storage is needed. It is compatible with all Raizer models – Raizer 1, Raizer 2 and Raizer M . This simple addition can make all the difference to the experience of both the fallen person and the person carrying out the lift. If buying the Raizer M it is cheaper to buy the package including the headrest – please click here . For all other models, the Raizer Headrest will need to be purchased separately.

products.name: Raizer Disposable Hygiene Covers – Pack of 10

detail.description: The Raizer Disposable Hygiene Cover prevents any soiling on your Raizer seat unit, perfect if you are concerned about incontinence. The cover secures around the Raizer seat unit by way of a simple peel-off adhesive strip. For a how-to video and quick guide, please see the tabs below. If you are using the Raizer commercially and it is being used in many different locations, these disposable covers will help you keep your Raizer clean and maintain hygiene. The pack of 10 hygiene covers will fit neatly into your Raizer component carry bag. These hygiene covers are compatible with all Raizer models – Raizer 1, Raizer 2 and Raizer M

The Raizer Wall Bracket Kit is set of two metal plates that mount to the wall to hold your Raizer seat unit and components, and they can be mounted in whatever position is best for you. If you are short on floor space, or you like to keep things tidy in your house, the Wall Bracket Kit means you’ll always know where you Raizer is. The Raizer Wall Bracket Kit is compatible with the Raizer Carry Bag Kit , so you can keep your Raizer looking tidy and smart. If you are looking for a more mobile storage option, why not take a look at the Raizer Trolley

The new Kuschall K-Series 2.0 builds on all the strengths of the original rigid wheelchair model – iconic design with its ultralightweight monotube frame construction – and adds even more style, versatility and performance for a truly dynamic set up that will keep you on the move. Cutting-edge hydroforming technology brings the new design of the Kuschall K-Series Wheelchair to another level. Iconic as ever, with its minimalist, straight edge design reimagined. It also brings unrivalled driving performance with increased rigidity. How? Hydroforming is a process which allows metal to be formed into complex, ergonomically designed pieces, with adjustments to the frame thickness that optimises the weight to resistance ratio and rigidity. Tests show that for the same effort generated, deformation on a hydroformed frame is 60% lower than the rounded tube design and is comparable to carbon performance. The result: hydroforming creates a wheelchair that is stronger than before and effortless to propel. Fully adjustable for a perfect fit, the unique seat module can be effortlessly modified independently from the frame. Adjust and adapt anytime, anywhere for consistently responsive performance. With all adjustments made from the seat module, the frame maintains perfect geometry with the ground. Enjoy easier transfers and lifting with the new ergonomic back brace, positioned lower than before with Matrx backrests in mind. The standard folding backrest locks down and combines with the ergonomic grips built into hydroformed front frame to enable effortless loading into a car. One Solution Invacare’s One Solution is now available on the Kuschall K-Series 2.0 wheelchair, offering even more options and customisations across their portfolio, including Matrx backs.

The Quickie Nitrum Active Wheelchair is the lightest adjustable aluminium wheelchair on the market at just 4.9kg lifting weight! The successor to the Quickie Helium wheelchair, it combines weight rigidity, custom fit and fine tuning to offer the most energy efficient Quickie wheelchair ever produced. The Nitrum is for users who value pushing efficiency and lightweight design. A revolutionary chair that minimises propulsion effort whilst maximising movement. Weight & Rigidity The Quickie Nitrum employs state-of-the-art materials and principles to minimise weight (from 7.5 kg) and maximise strength, so you need less energy to propel. Sculpted from high-strength 7020 Aluminium, the frame is specially heat-treated, so the tubing can be significantly thinner and lighter without any sacrifice to its strength. The Nitrum wheelchair is hand-welded into one-complete frame, so you get a stiffer, lighter ride. The forged aluminium backrest bracket is extremely stiff, so it’s significantly more energy efficient without sacrificing the adjustability of the backrest angle or height. With fewer stress points due to its elongated sides, the Nitrum’s unique oval tubing is stronger than round tubing as it’s less likely to flex under pressure – and it’s lighter! Lifting features Just grab the patented Twist Lock bar with one hand and twist it to release, fold and load the wheelchair into your car. With double-locking, you can also use the same bar to lift it. It’ll also lock without removing your sideguards or low-profile cushion. Optimised for easier car transfers with the underside of the frame being completely open once rear wheels are removed and including ergonomic grab bars on the backrest and cross-tube.

detail.description: The Quickie Argon 2 rigid wheelchair offers active performance with exceptional adjustability. It’s ideal for wheelchair users looking for a mid-range active wheelchair that can adapt as needs change and they build their driving performance. Besides impressive functionality and effortless fine tuning, the Quickie Argon 2 wheelchair had been designed with a modern open-frame design meaning it fits perfectly into an active lifestyle. The Quickie Argon 2 offers full adjustability without compromising on performance. The rear seat height is adjustable in 1cm steps, so the seat angle can be constantly adapted to changing needs. With the infinitely adjustable centre of gravity, you can quickly change your driving settings to a more active or a more stable performance. The backrest angle, height and upholstery tension are also adjustable, so you’ll always find a seating position that best suits you. The innovative Carbotecture castor forks and hydroformed castor housing increases the aluminium’s strength while allowing it to be thinner and lighter. The result is a lighter and stronger front frame that’s easier to manoeuvre. Weighing from an ultra-lightweight 8 kg (6 kg with its quick-release wheels removed), the Argon 2 is ideal for those looking for an active wheelchair that’s easy to lift. Plus, its open-frame design allows easy independent transfers in and out of the car. The Argon 2’s rigid frame optimises your energy efficiency by reducing any unwanted flex in the frame and instead transfers your energy to propulsion. Choose between two different knee angles and frame insets to meet your requirements of a compact wheelchair. Personalise your Quickie Argon 2 with a wide selection colours for the frame, wheel rim, hub castor forks and upholstery trim. The Argon 2 is compatible with a full range of JAY seating to support your postural needs and active lifestyle. Options include the J3 Carbon Back, as strong as aluminium but 60% lighter, offering incredible energy efficie

detail.description: Ottobock Avantgarde DS: the travel companion Besides its low weight, the DS model with fixed leg support stands out for its extremely small folding size of 27 cm. At the same time, it offers a high level of stability for active users. Thanks to its compact design and the integrated leg support the Avantgarde DS features the lowest net weight within the Avantgarde series. Ottobock Avantgarde DV: the variable version The new Ottobock Avantgarde 4 DV impresses with its light weight, but this does not mean it‘s lost any of its proven advantages. Users like the new Avantgarde 4 DV s height-adjustable armrest, but also the option of driving up close to objects such as furniture, the barbeque or bath. The leg supports can be folded in for this purpose. It is also suitable for stroke patients when the leg supports are removed, which is done with a new type of lever. Ottobock Avantgarde CLT package: the lightest version For users who find that lightweight still isn‘t light enough, the additional option of a CLT package offers an ultralight version of the Ottobock Avantgarde 4 wheelchair for active use. More weight is saved here thanks to the single CLT cross brace, permanently welded components like the rear wheel adapter and push handles, lighter seat and back upholstery as well as carbon side panels and Infinity Ultralight rims. At just 8.7 kilogrammes, it’s capable of excelling in any everyday challenge. detail.description: Mesh Siderail Bed Bumpers for providing padding on the side rails of a community profiling bed. The Solace Mesh Siderail Bed Bumpers are designed with a premium grey colour scheme for greater dignity and a less clinical feel in your home. Made with a breathable mesh strip between the rail covers, allowing greater openness and breathability, whilst also maintaining the raise and lower functions of the siderail. This Mesh Siderail Bed Bumper allows the air to flow more freely, providing greater comfort whilst still greatly reducing the risk of injury and entrapment. Easily attached to the bedrail with a zipper. Made with foam inner padding and a phthalate-free antibacterial wipe-clean PU cover for easy hygiene maintenance. Sold in pairs to fit both sides of the bed. Universal fitting: these bumpers will fit all standard community profiling bed siderails.

Full Siderail Bed Bumpers for providing complete padding and protection on the side rails of a community profiling bed. The Solace Full Siderail Bed Bumpers are designed with a premium grey colour scheme for greater dignity and a less clinical feel in your home. This fully padded Siderail Bed Bumper allows for protection from injury and entrapment on the whole height of the siderail. Easily attached to the bedrail with velcro. Made with foam inner padding and a phthalate-free antibacterial wipe-clean PU cover for easy hygiene maintenance. Sold in pairs to fit both sides of the bed. Universal fitting: these bumpers will fit all standard community profiling bed siderails.

products.name: Sensaflex 1000 Castellated Foam Pressure Relieving Mattress

detail.description: The Alerta Sensaflex 1000 is a general-purpose foam pressure relief mattress, suitable for those at high risk of developing pressure ulcers which is designed to replace your existing mattress. The Sensaflex 1000 provides excellent pressure care on a budget, and is made with castellated foam to provide relief to high risk pressure patients. Castellated foam can help reduce shear and friction by allowing the surface to move with the user when transferring or shuffling forward. This type of foam also allows for ventilation and provides pressure reduction, combined with stability and a high level of comfort. The pressure mattress has a polyurethane coat and is easily wipe clean, also offering a vapour-permeable nylon cover with sewn seams and zip closure to three sides.

products.name: Alerta Wireless Detect PIR Motion Sensor

detail.description: The Alerta Detect PIR Motion Sensor uses infrared detection technology to reduce the risk of falls by triggering an alert when body movement is detected within the range of the infrared beam. It is typically mounted on a door or by the bedside. The Alerta PIR Motion Sensor also features: High and low volume alert Choice of chime/no chime Low battery alert

products.name: Sensaflo Hybrid Replacement Pressure Relief Mattress

detail.description: The Sensaflo Hybrid Mattress is a four in one hybrid mattress for users at high/very high risk of developing pressure ulcers. The Sensaflo has a sophisticated mattress design for effective comfort, care and pressure redistribution and relief for patients in nursing and care home environments. The Sensaflo has a high-density foam perimeter around the air cells which makes transfers on and off the bed smoother and easier, and the inbuilt evacuation handles. It also has an adaptable heel zone with removable gel foam pads for ultimate adjustability. The Sensaflo can be used in two ways; either as a high spec foam pressure relief mattress with self-adjusting air cells; or a pump can be added for alternating air pressure relief. The operation of the mattress can be changed between foam and alternating air at the touch of a button with the patient remaining on the bed The Sensaflo pump uses cutting-edge technology to maintain the correct pressures and do the work for you.

products.name: VENDLET Bari Bariatric Patient Turning System

detail.description: Bariatric patients (generally considered as over 25 stone) pose a particularly acute moving and handling risk to carers, due to both their size and their weight. In many cases multiple carers – up to three or four – are required to manually move and position a bariatric client in bed. This is a task with a very high risk of musculoskeletal disorders (MSD’s) for the carers. The VENDLET Bari bariatric patient turning system can reduce this to just a single carer who can operate the system with one hand and guide the client with their other hand. With a much higher safe working load (SWL) of 400 kg / 63 stone, the VENDLET Bari bariatric patient turning system is built to handle the larger and heavier clients for whom the V5S would not be suitable. Please note: The VENDLET Bari system is only compatible with VENDLET™ slide sheets and turn sheets. Use of other sheets may invalidate the warranty and may constitute a risk to patient safety. Please speak to us for further details. Please note: We supply the Vendlet System in the UK only. For enquiries outside the UK, please contact the manufacturer directly.

products.name: Birdie Evo Compact Mobile Patient Hoist

detail.description: The Birdie Compact is a smaller model of the Birdie mobile hoist, for use where space is at a premium. The Birdie remains a popular choice of patient lifter for nursing care thanks to its robust construction, long warranty and budget-friendly pricing.
The Birdie mobile hoist remains a popular choice of patient lifter for nursing care thanks to its robust construction, long warranty and budget-friendly pricing.

The Pearl is an entry level overlay air alternating pressure relieving mattress, with 5 inch (125mm) air cells for effective prevention and treatment of patients at medium risk of developing a pressure ulcer, whether at home or in a nursing or care home environment. Designed to give the user the essentials for pressure care, helping to reduce the risk of pressure ulcers. With simple to use functionality, the Pearl mattress system can be quickly set up and operating at optimal pressure for a specific user with ease using the basic mattress pump. The Pearl air alternating pressure relieving mattress is an overlay mattress – simply place on top of your existing mattress for added comfort and pressure relief – this does not replace your existing mattress.

products.name: Alerta Air Cell Pressure Relief Heel Protector

detail.description: The Alerta Air Cell Pressure Relief Heel Protectors provides effective protection for users by offloading pressure from the heel to minimise the risk of pressure ulceration and injury to the foot, including those assessed as very high risk. If existing pressure related tissue injury is severe then clinical supervision is recommended. Heels are particularly susceptible to injury due to a combination of pressure, friction and shear. This is heightened further in combination with diabetes. Supplied in pairs Designed to relieve pressure on soft tissue areas and provide comfort Helps distribute pressure evenly Easy to clean – just wipe clean with lukewarm water and soap and rinse well. Do not dry clean, tumble dry or iron. Deflate down to a compact size for storage Reuseable Can be used with other dynamic or static support surfaces Reduces impact of pressure, friction and shear

detail.description: The Thermo Mug’s double-sided wall provides a hidden thermal function – helping to keep hot drinks hotter for longer and cold drinks colder for longer. Ideal for slow drinkers. The large ergonomically-designed handle also makes the Thermo Mug easy to grip. Choose from a light yellow glow-in-the-dark colour (Firefly) a cheery Blackberry or a festive Teal. All options feature a large white rim at the top of the mug. With the Blackberry and Teal coloured mugs, the white rim ensures a clear contrast between the drinking lip and the rest of the mug. This is handy for anyone experiencing decreased contrast sensitivity. If you’d like a complementary lid for your Thermo Mug, there are three styles to choose from (see below for more details). The Thermo Mug and all lids made from break-resistant plastic and are dishwasher and microwave-safe. Capacity: 160 ml Diameter: 7 cm Features: Internal cone, Thermal Function Height: 11 cm Material: PP Use & care: BPA free, dishwasher safe, food-suitable, microwaveable Weight: 145 g

It’s ideal for use at home or outdoors with great manoeuvrability from its multiple rear wheel positions and outstanding drive performance from its lightweight aluminium frame along with new lightweight options. The Orca Bath Lift provides confidence while getting in and out of the bath. The sturdy seating platform allows you to simply sit down and lower yourself to enjoy a comfortable and relaxing bath. Once in the water you can recline the back rest or leave it upright to find the most comfortable position. The Orca is compatible with most baths, and its ergonomic design sits lower and further towards the back of the bath. This creates more legroom and allows for a deeper, more relaxing bathe. Once you’re ready to get out, use the floating hand control to raise the lifter. The Orca’s scissor-lift action is smooth and controlled and comfortably lifts you to the edge of the bath for a safe transfer to your feet. The battery is powered by Sony™️ technology and is protected by a one-year warranty. The frame and mechanism is covered by a three-year warranty.

The Neo G Stabilized Open Knee Support utilises metal spiral stays to help support the knee complex whilst still allowing controlled and flexible movement. The open patella design with stitched buttress helps with patellar tracking whilst providing added support and helping with overall stability by eliminating glide and twisting at the knee. Weight bearing pressure during movement is more evenly distributed over the joint helping with arthritic and meniscus pain. The durable, heat therapeutic neoprene helps with arthritic knees, chronic aches and stiffness. A dynamic support, ideal for occupational use, summer and winter sporting activities such as tennis, skiing, golf etc. Helps with strains, sprains, instability and patellar tracking in the knee Helps support and stabilise injured, weak or arthritic knees during occupational and sporting activities Interchangeable metal spiral stays on either side help provide flexible support and the open patella design and stitched buttress help give reinforced support to the patella The adjustable design is universal, and is suitable for both men and women to use on either the right or left knee. It’s also compatible with the Hot & Cold Therapy Disc

The Neo-G elbow strap offers moderate support to muscles in the forearm, helping to prevent and recover from strains and sprains. It’s specifically designed to help provide dynamic compression and support to the forearm muscles and elbow tendon complex. It works by helping to dampen vibration, stress and strain at the medial and lateral elbow by helping to support and cushion the flexor and extensor muscles in the forearm. The premium quality silicon pad helps provide targeted compression, protection and support and help with vibration dampening during occupational and sporting activities. The durable heat-therapeutic neoprene helps provide warmth to ease pain. This elbow strap is particularly useful in cases or tennis or golfer’s elbow as it helps reduce tendon irritation and overuse. Wear during or after playing sport, or during everyday tasks. The universal design is suitable for either the left or right forearm for men or women.

This clever wrist brace features a removable metal splint to allow variable stabilization of the wrist and hand. The adjustable strap provides additional compression around the wrist and/or hand if needed which can help encourage correct alignment of the carpal bones and therefore help reduce inflammation in the wrist. This is particularly useful for managing Carpal Tunnel Syndrome. The support can also be used to help reduce strain caused by repetitive movements at the wrist associated with typing, writing and other occupational or sporting activities. The durable, heat therapeutic neoprene helps with arthritic wrists, chronic aches and stiffness. Used to help ease Carpal Tunnel Syndrome, Tendonitis, Tenosynovitis, repetitive strains and weak & injured wrists. This universal design is one-size-fits-most, is suitable for both men and women, and can be used on either the left or right wrist.

The Neo G open knee support is a moderate support to help injured, weak or arthritic knees during occupational and sporting activities. The open patella design and stitched buttress helps with patellar tracking whilst providing added support and helping with overall stability by eliminating glide and twisting at the knee. The therapeutic neoprene also helps ease pain and stiffness by providing warmth for muscles and joints. The product is a Universal Size and fits up to 560 mm / 22 inches, measure thigh circumference 4 inches above knee for maximum size. The support provides adjustable support, fits the left or right knee in men or women and is compatible with the Hot & Cold Therapy Disc.

This reusable, flexible, dual Function Hot and Cold Disc is compatible with various Neo G supports for hands free therapy. Cold therapy helps soothe aches and pains, while hot therapy helps to relax muscles and ease symptoms of arthritis. The ergonomically designed Disc moulds to hard-to-reach areas of the body, such as the kneecap, thumb, elbow, shoulder, heel, ankle etc. The Disc is also designed to be compatible with the Neo G range of orthopaedic supports, to maintain a constant and secure position on the affected area and controlled compression when required. Inside: Non-Toxic Gel Outside: Woven Nylon, PVC Sleeve: Polypropylene Wash & Care: Hand wash only with soap and cold water

This ankle support is designed to help provide dynamic support and compression around the ankle complex during sporting and occupational activities. Perfect for stabilising injured, weak or arthritic joints. The support helps to reduce excessive plantarflexion as well as inversion and eversion of the ankle all of which are associated with ligamentous injuries and instability of the ankle. Plus, the durable, heat therapeutic neoprene helps warm muscles and joints, helping with arthritic pain and chronic aches and stiffness. The product is adjustable one-size-fits-most. The Neo-G Wrist Support offers moderate support for muscles and joints to help aid weak, injured or arthritic wrists. It can also aid recovery from strains caused by repetitive wrist movements such as typing, writing or playing sport.

products.name: Vitus Elite Auto Folding Mobility Scooter

detail.description: Safety features include solid tyres, anti-tippers and an anti-roll back system so you’re safe on hills. Newly added features include shock-absorbing front and rear suspension, an LED headlight, USB charging point and a comfortable delta tiller for easier operation. A great scooter for getting out and about! This compact scooter can be easily folded for transport on the move. Weighing 27.5 kg, the scooter is small enough when folded down to fit in most car boots. You can fold it via controls on the tiller or by a handy remote control. A carry handle also makes it easier to lift in and out of storage spaces, making the Vitus Elite particularly handy for longer journeys, such as cruises. When on the go, the comfortable padded seat and backrest make the Vitus Elite mobility scooter ideal for longer journeys (you can travel for up to 13 miles on a single charge). The tyres are puncture-proof, making it safe to travel on bumpier terrain, and the anti-rollback function makes steep hills no problem! The new Vitus Elite is a compact mini scooter that can be folded in seconds using the remote control or tiller buttons, so it’s easier to transport and store. Its lithium battery makes it ideal for flights but it’s also great for all types of travel including cruises and bus trips.

The HurryCane’s three-point base replicates the foot’s own three points of contact with the ground. This provides excellent balance and stability and mimics the feel of natural movement. The SteadiGrip base also provides excellent traction on almost every terrain. Just like the human ankle, the HurryCane’s pivot function automatically swivels into an optimum position. This counteracts any possible imbalance caused by walking on gradients and uneven or unstable ground. The HurryCane’s stable three-point base means it can stand upright, so you won’t need to find a surface to prop it up against. This feature also makes it the ideal support for getting up from a seated position – for example out of an armchair or car seat. The HurryCane is made from strong yet lightweight aluminium. It also quickly folds down to a third of its original size, and comes with a carry-case. Alternatively, it’s small enough to stow away into a larger handbag, for example, or the car glove box. With eight different height positions 775 – 950 mm / 30.5 – 37.4 inches, it’s easy to adjust the cane to suit you. Just push the button and find your ideal height in seconds.

Optimal comfort for bariatric patients. With an ideal seating position, the SB755 Wide minimises shear and friction. Its attractive design is easy to clean, will blend harmoniously into any environment, and is flexible enough to cater for a wide variety of users. The generous width provides extra space and comfort for larger clients and plenty of room to turn. The SB755 has also been engineered with a sophisticated auto-regression system to offer total comfort. Plus, the extendable head and foot ends make it easy to accommodate taller users.

products.name: Softform Bariatric Static Foam Pressure Relief Mattress

detail.description: Practical and durable, Softform Bariatric Static Foam Pressure Relief Mattress is suitable for those heavier patients that are considered at ‘Very High Risk’ of developing pressure ulcers. The specialist cut foam for pressure redistribution distributes pressure evenly, reducing the risk of pressure ulcers for bariatric patients who have limited range of movement. Many obese patients have difficultly lying flat due to breathing difficulties. The hinged backrest section of the the Softform Bariatric mattress will be an advantage to many. Other features include multi-stretch, breathable, waterproof cover and an innovative integrated glide system (see below).

With a safe working load up to 60 Stone (385 kgs), the Octave is a robust yet stylish profiling bed solution for bariatric clients. The fully powered 4-section profiling provides optimal comfort and support to the client, as well as an ideal working environment for the carer. The frameless construction of the mattress platform allows improved side access to the client, and the bed ends can be detached independently of the side rails for quick and easy access to both head and feet. Great comfort and stylish design The bed frame extends to the edges of the bed base for enhanced support and ease of transfer. An easy-to-use hand control allows the client to operate the bed´s height and profiling function themselves. And the Octave’s heavy duty motors enable a smooth and almost silent operation. This substantial, yet stylish bed blends in with most decor.

products.name: Access BDD Flow X Stairlift for Curved Stairs

detail.description: The Access BDD Flow X Stairlift for Curved Stairs is the only curved flight stairlift capable of swivelling during travel both up and down the staircase. This exclusive feature allows the FlowX to be fitted to extremely narrow staircases. Its compact, folding design is aesthetically pleasing and maximises free space on the staircase. Discreet Single Rail Design Even in cases where the staircase is narrow and steep, with a single discreet rail, the Flow X can be installed closer to the step and on either side of the staircase. Your stairlift will be less obtrusive, and your staircase remains accessible for other family members in your home. Advanced Swivel and Levelling Technology Advanced Swivel and Levelling technology (ASL) allows it to be fitted on staircases as narrow as 610mm. This feature, unique to Flow X, enables your stairlift to rotate while in motion, making it one of the most versatile stairlifts in the world! Ergonom ic Armrests Flow X’s innovative armrests provide several key benefits. They have an ergonomically-tapered form, designed to give you extra support both when standing and sitting. And thanks to the unique open-access armrest position, transferring to a stairlift has never been easier. Call Device Stay connected with friends and family with up to three different telephone numbers contactable directly from your Flow X Stairlift. And More! One-handed operation seatbelt and wrap-around armrests keep you secure throughout. detail.description: The Presence mobile hoist combines an excellent range of movement with a large lifting capacity, making it capable of handling more demanding patient transfers.

The Advance is a compact mobile hoist with excellent functionality and ergonomics, which is able to perform an extensive range of patient transfers including from floor level. It is especially suited to home care and small nursing environments where space is sometimes limited. It benefits from being able to fold making it easy to transport and store. All patient lifting equipment needs to be LOLER (Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations 1998) tested every 6 months.

products.name: Pad Low Pressure Relief Positioning Cushion
products.mfrCategory: LEJRELET Pressure Relief Cushion Support System

detail.description: The LEJRELET Pad Low is a thin rectangular pressure relief cushion for optimum relief and adaptation in situations where extra stability and support are required. The Pad Low cushion can be used under an individual to protect them during transfers from hard surfaces or sharp edges. This cushion can be used flat under arms or hands, or under the legs to offload pressure from the heels. It can also be used folded or coiled to provide pressure relief between the thighs, knees or ankles. The Pad Low is made of viscoelastic memory foam, meaning it is energy absorbent and soft, and it moulds to the body in response to heat and pressure, evenly distributing weight.

products.name: Pad High Rectangular Pressure Relief Positioning Cushion
products.mfrCategory: LEJRELET Pressure Relief Cushion Support System

detail.description: The LEJRELET Pad High is a rectangular pressure relief cushion for a variety of positions. The height of the Pad High cushion is half the average adult hip width. This means that when used to support the upper leg in a lateral position, the individual will have a neutral hip position – avoiding compression in the hip joint and providing stability, comfort and pressure relief. This pressure relief cushion supports a variety of positions, including the leg in a lateral position, the leg during lower hygiene tasks and the arm in a lateral position. The LEJRELET Pad High can also be placed under the individual’s legs in a supine position to offload pressure from the heels. The LEJRELET Pad High cushion is made with a core of polyurethane foam covered by a 20mm layer of viscoelastic memory foam. This gives the cushion the necessary firmness and support, whilst still providing flexibility and comfort for pressure relief.

products.name: Wedge Pressure Relief Positioning Cushion
products.mfrCategory: LEJRELET Pressure Relief Cushion Support System

detail.description: The LEJRELET wedge pressure relief cushion is modelled from an anatomical view of the thorax and pelvis, ensuring optimum support when it’s used. The length of the Wedge cushion is the same as the average length of an adult torso, providing complete support for the upper and/or lower body. The Wedge cushion can be used in behind the back to stabilise an individual in the side lying position. The angle of the Wedge cushion can also facilitate a 30 degree position for pressure relief. The stable position provided by the Wedge cushion makes care tasks – such as wound care and personal hygiene – much easier. The Wedge can also support the arms and legs in lateral positions. The LEJRELET Wedge is made with a core of polyurethane foam covered by a 20mm layer of viscoelastic memory foam. This gives the cushion the necessary firmness and support, whilst still providing flexibility and comfort for pressure relief.

products.name: Tube 125 Pressure Relief Positioning Cushion
products.mfrCategory: LEJRELET Pressure Relief Cushion Support System

detail.description: The LEJRELET Tube 125 pressure relief cushion is 125cm in length (hence the name). A shorter and lighter variant of the 250cm cushion, the Tube 125 offers excellent pliability and usability in a variety of situations. This pressure cushion can easily be folded and moulded into a shape that offers great support, as well as supporting the body in a lateral position. The Tube 125 can provide support for legs and forearms in a sitting position, as well as creating stable lateral positions. The Tube 250 can also be used in a chair as well as on the bed. Like the Tube 250, the Tube 125 is made of shredded viscoelastic memory foam, meaning that it can be moulded to the body shape of the individual without the contents migrating away from the contact points.

products.name: Oval Pressure Relief Positioning Cushion
products.mfrCategory: LEJRELET Pressure Relief Cushion Support System

detail.description: The LEJRELET Oval pressure relief cushion is a compact oval shaped pressure cushion. The Oval cushion is very flexible and pliable whilst providing discreet and supportive repositioning for a variety of situations. It can be used behind the back in a supine position as a lumbar support, under or between any bony prominences like the elbow, or between the knees or ankles for pressure relief. The LEJRELET Oval is often called the ‘walking cushion’, as it is a good size and shape for individuals to hold, providing tactile stimulus and reducing muscle tone. The Oval cushion is made of viscoelastic memory foam granules, meaning it is energy absorbent and soft. It moulds to the body in response to heat and pressure, evenly distributing weight.

products.name: Tube 250 Pressure Relief Positioning Cushion
products.mfrCategory: LEJRELET Pressure Relief Cushion Support System

detail.description: The LEJRELET Tube 250 pressure relief cushion is truly unique: it is the only positioning cushion at 250cm long (hence the name). This length makes it possible to position the cushion around the entire body in a lateral position, or around the head and both sides of the torso in a supine position. This pressure cushion provides pressure relief for the scapula, arms, legs and heels. The Tube 250 can also be used in a chair as well as on the bed. Unlike many other cylindrical cushions, the Tube 250 is made of shredded viscoelastic memory foam. This means that it can be moulded to the body shape of the individual without the contents migrating away from the contact points.
