Irrigation cadence, medicine and irrigation, device lifetime and pin code questions. Q: How often should I perform TAI? A: At the start it is common to irrigate once every day for the first 10-14 days. Later on, the frequency may possibly be reduced to once every other day or every third day. The frequency should be decided in consultation with a healthcare professional. Q: Can I stop using stool modifying medicine when I start using Navina Irrigation System? A: TAI is usually part of a bowel management program. It is possible that you may be able to reduce the amount of laxative they are using eventually but you may have to continue using some to ensure that the stools have the right consistency to ensure easy evacuation. It is best to continue with your current laxative regimen until you are getting regular results from TAI. Consult a healthcare professional before changing your personal regimen. Q: How long does the procedure take? A: It is very individual but the aim is that the bowel management routine will take less than one hour. For some people the results are fast and emptying of the bowel is complete. For others it will be more time consuming and the bowel empties intermi

Symptoms questions in conjunction with irrigation. Q: What if bleeding should occur? A: A small amount of bleeding or smearing of blood on the cone may occur and should not alarm you. More severe or sustained rectal bleeding with or without pain suggests a possible bowel perforation, which should be treated as a medical emergency and requires immediate medical attention. Q: What should I do if I feel pain? A: If cramps, discomfort, or pain occur while instilling the water, pause instillation for a few moments and continue more slowly once the discomfort has subsided, ensure that the water is warm enough, at body temperature. If pain is severe or persistent stop the irrigation immediately. It could be perforation of the bowel which should be treated as a medical emergency. Q: What if I feel sweating, palpitations or dizziness during irrigation? A: If you have a spinal cord injury this may be a sign of autonomic dysreflexia. Instill the water slowly and limit the time on the toilet depending on tolerance. Water and device questions related to instillation. Q: Why can’t I get from priming to instillation with my Navina Smart? A: Occasionally small amounts of water can get trapped inside the Navina Smart control unit. To prevent this from happening, make sure to always follow the order of the disassembly instructions given in the IFU (disconnect tubes before pressing the power-button on the unit). If the unit is already stuck in priming mode, try placing the water container higher than the catheter and squeezing the water container gently during the priming step. This increases the water flow and may dislodge the trapped water. Q: How much water should I instill? ADULTS: A healthcare professional will advise you how much water should be used. For adults it is common to start around 500 ml. CHILDREN: A healthcare professional will advise you how much water should be used. For children it is common to calculate 20 ml/kg body weight. A maximum of 200 ml may be added for activating the catheter´s hydrophilic surface and to expel air from the System. Q: Can I add salt to the water? detail.description: Questions on the balloon inflation step. Q: What balloon size is recommended? A: A healthcare professional will advise you of the appropriate balloon size. It should be just big enough to hold the catheter in place and seal the anal opening to minimize leakage during irrigation. Navina Classic; Maximum 5 pumps for the regular catheter and maximum 2 pumps for the small catheter. Navina Smart; Maximum step 5 for the regular catheter and maximum step 3 for the small catheter. Q: Why shall the Navina balloon catheter regular with Navina Classic be inflated with maximum 5 pumps? A: The maximum size of balloon inflation was selected after consultation with healthcare professional experts, to meet the anatomical needs and prevent over-inflation of the balloon and the risk of balloon burst. Q: Why shall the Navina balloon catheter small with Navina Classic be inflated with maximum 2 pumps? A: The maximum size of balloon inflation was selected after consultation with healthcare professional experts, to meet the anatomical needs, safety in children, prevent over-inflation of the balloon and the risk of balloon burst. detail.description: Maintenance questions. Q: Can the catheters/cones be reused? A: No, the rectal catheter is for single-use only. Dispose of it after use in the normal household waste. If reused, Wellspect HealthCare cannot guarantee the functionality nor the safety of the product. Q: How should the Navina Irrigation System be stored? A: After the components are cleaned and dried, store your Navina Irrigation System in the Navina case. Also ensure that the tubes are not kinked and that the parts are kept away from sharp objects. Keep away from children. Q: Can I wipe the control unit with alcohol? A: No, only use mild soap and water. Share key:global.print-this-page

Navina™ Smart App Q: Why do I get a message about Bluetooth® when trying to synchronize? A: Your smartphone communicates with the Navina Smart control unit with a wireless technique called Bluetooth. If the app asks you to activate Bluetooth, do so via your smartphone settings. If you have activated Bluetooth on your smartphone, and the message still appears when trying to connect to Navina Smart control unit, your smartphone or your iOS/Android version is probably not supporting the correct version of Bluetooth, called Bluetooth LE. That means your device unfortunately may not be used together with Navina Smart control unit. The Bluetooth® word mark and logos are registered trademarks owned by Bluetooth SIG, Inc. and any use of such marks by DENTSPLY International is under license. Q: How can I do an Evaluation? A: In the Main Menu, chose Evaluation which will lead you to a list of evaluations. To perform a new evaluation, choose the plus symbol in the top right corner of the screen . Visit product on your local market How to catheterize with LoFric Elle Pro with 12 Pro eyelets Ensure to follow the advice and training on the catheterization procedure given by your Healthcare Professional, before use. Please refer to instructions for use included in the package, for important information and complete instructions. Contact your prescriber if you experience difficulties. Wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water. Open the upper lid. Hold the catheter in your hand and gently bend the upper part to open. Pull the catheter out. Connect the container to the catheter with a gentle twist, make sure the arrow on the container points down. Tilt your pelvis upwards, spread the labia, lift slightly to locate the urethra. The urethra is located just above the vaginal opening. With the other hand, insert the catheter slowly into your urethral opening until urine starts to flow, insert slightly more to ensure a steady stream. Apnea : A cessation of airflow for ≥10 seconds.

Obstructive sleep apnea : The most common form of sleep disordered breathing (SDB). A partial or complete collapse of the upper airway caused by relaxation of the muscles controlling the soft palate and tongue.

Central sleep apnea : A type of sleep disorder that occurs when the respiratory control center in the brain fails to send a signal to the muscles that control your breathing during sleep. CSA causes you to repeatedly stop and start breathing during the night.

Mixed sleep apnea : A combination of OSA (absence of airflow but continued respiratory effort) and CSA (absence of airflow and respiratory effort). It often starts with central apnea episodes followed by obstructive apnea events.
Periodic breathing : Clusters of breaths separated by periodic intervals of not breathing (apnea) or near-apnea, as opposed to normal breathing.

detail.description: The NeuroLight Pupillometer elevates neurological assessment with its non-invasive and objective approach. This innovative tool automates pupillometry, a crucial technique for evaluating neurological function. By providing accurate measurements of pupil size and light reflex, NeuroLight empowers clinicians to gain early insights into a patient’s neurological state. This translates to faster diagnosis, more informed treatment decisions, and ultimately, improved patient outcomes. The portable pupilometer features an easy-to-use interface and a comfortable, reusable eye cup. It precisely measures pupil size and response time, converting them into a clear QPI score. This allows for the identification of potential neurological issues, with patient data being logged, tracked and transferable for further analysis. Learn More Read Support Literature Pupil Reactivity Assessment with NeuroLight QPI Score This chart translates pupillary response, measured by the NeuroLight device, into a clear and objective QPI score (Quantitative Pupillometry Index). Score Range Red – 0-1-2: Non-Reactive / Weak – May suggest significant neurological dysfunction. Orange – 3: Reduced – May indicate potential neurological issues. Green – 4-5: Good / Very Good – Considered normal pupillary response. Product No Product Description NPC Code D85.500 Neurolight Pupilometer N/A

Timesco R Engines – A quick, simple and low cost solution to convert existing dry cell laryngoscope handles to a rechargeable version. Simply replace the dry cell batteries with the equivalent Timesco R engine. Product Code Description 3115.150.20 Timesco R Engine Small (AA size), 2.5v 3115.150.50 Timesco R Engine Medium (C Size), 2.5v Timesco R engines are guaranteed for 3 years. The engines convert Timesco reusable handles to a rechargeable system. No special end caps/modifications required (excluding stubby handles). The batteries use Lithium Ion technology to provide quick charging in an ION-R charger, (typically takes approx. 4 hours to fully charge batteries for medium handles) and deliver consistent and reliable power. Adaptors/Inserts are used to ensure that both engine sizes fit into the ION-R charger. Once engines are fully charged the recharger will switch to a low power mode to avoid using unnecessary electricity. Only the engine is inserted into the charger, reducing the risk of cross contamination from a handle to the charger. The ION-R charger (single and daisy chained) takes approx. 4 hours to fully charge batteries for medium handles. A fully charged Timesco R Engine Medium (C Size) will last approx. 2 hours The colour changing LED indicates the health of the battery and the charging cycle. Side plates can be removed to daisy chain 3 chargers together to receive power from a single power supply.

detail.description: Optima CLX fibre optic replacement cores for Optima CLX Macintosh, Miller, Robertshaw & Seward laryngoscope blades. The fibre optic core in each Optima CLX laryngoscope blade clicks in and out for easy disassembly and reassembly – no tools are required. The core can be replaced at the end of its working life whilst the blade, continues to provide a high quality product for many years to come. Each fibre optic core in the Optima CLX laryngoscope system is an average 4mm in diameter and therefore increases light output by over 25% lux. This increase in light output results in an enhanced view of the laryngeal structures for the Anaesthetist, making the process of intubation easier and potentially safer. Introducing an exclusive, all-in-one support package designed to elevate outcomes in repositioning, tissue viability, and mobilisation. The Aria Turn+ Therapy System creates a truly unmatched solution for the care of plus-size patients. This package is exclusive to Medstrom and is designed to overcome the most common challenges in clinical practice, enabling caregivers to get closer to the patient, simplify complex repositioning tasks, and support safer, more dignified mobilisation.
The Vela XL Stretcher is a versatile extra-wide stretcher supporting improved patient care throughout a hospital stay.

products.name: Aria Lateral Tilt Bed and Dolphin Therapy

detail.description: This unique bed and surface duo combines full platform lateral tilt and exceptional immersion. It offers an ideal solution for the most complex patients, in both critical care and general ward environments. In addition to outstanding pressure area care, benefits include easier patient repositioning and care, and improved caregiver efficiency.

Designed with both safety and convenience in mind, the AER Magna is a bariatric dynamic air mattress with an adjustable width from 90 to 120cm. Combined with the Versatech 1100, the AER Magna provides effective protection against pressure ulcers while maintaining patient comfort and dignity.

Designed for full compatibility with the Medstrom Solo Luxe bed frame, the advanced construction of the Protecta Luxe offers enhanced skin and pressure ulcer protection for a wide variety of patients.

For a growing patient population with complex mental and physical problems, there’s a need for mattress solutions that prioritise safety without compromising on clinical outcomes. The Protecta 7 has been specifically designed as a solution to these challenges, providing enhanced skin protection in even the most high-risk scenarios.
Uniquely suitable for children, adults and adults with atypical anatomy, the Solo Luxe offers enhanced protection and safety for all.

It’s time for change. The ECO portable patient shower is the future of patient hygiene, utilising innovative hydro-molecular technology. The result? Patient dignity and experience restored, up to 65% reduction in caregiver time and up to 95% water reduction than a traditional bed bath.

The 360Care+ Package is an innovative rental package that provides effective falls management and safe mobilisation, increases nursing efficiency and improves patient outcomes.
As the temperatures drop, Medstrom is here to support with escalation preparation.

With an established range of bariatric equipment, including two known and widely used bed frames, Medstrom is delighted to exclusively introduce the Versatech 1100 bariatric bed to its growing portfolio, significantly adding to the solutions available. The Versatech 1100 is a width adjustable, ultra-low bed with a high safe working load of 500kg and additional high specification benefits such as Class III weigh scales, bed exit alarms and a range of electric profiling functionality.

The Medstrom Aria cushion is designed to be ultra-portable and compact, with its own control unit accompanied by a 12-hour battery life to acknowledge the drawbacks with traditional systems. Equipped with an ultra-low profile of just 6.5cm and innovative cubed cells, the cushion ensures safe mobilisation to and from a chair without compromising on therapeutic benefits.

The Riser Recliner PRO is the latest advancement in riser recliner functionality, achieving a bespoke seating solution for every patient. UK manufactured and available in different widths from 20” through to 38”, the PRO range has been specially adapted to deliver reassuring stability and support, helping to promote early patient mobilisation.
A unique and highly versatile hospital bed with an unrivalled height range for maximum patient and caregiver safety.
Medstrom is here to support you over the festive period with specialist product rental, equipped with round-the-clock clinical and technical support.
Discover the Aria Junior, specifically designed for paediatrics, providing optimal therapy and immersion whilst enhancing comfort.
Discover the advanced semi-dynamic support surface that offers immediate protection from pressure ulcers and behaves like a dynamic mattress, even in non-powered mode.

The Oxford Calibre is an ergonomically designed mobile patient hoist for the safe lifting of plus-size patients. Sturdy and robust, with a safe working load of 385kg (60 stone), it is specifically designed to meet the unique demands of bariatric care.

The Pro-Bario Active bed is designed for plus-size users living at home with complex needs. The wide sleep platform provides comfort and support to the user, and the electric controls help protect caregivers from manual handling injury. This bariatric bed is safely assembled inside the user’s home by qualified technicians, easy to clean and durable. A range of compatible surfaces and accessories is available.

Understanding the risks involved in safeguarding both clients and caregivers, the SoloMH bed is an innovative four-section, electric profiling bed frame that has several adaptations to optimise safety and provide enhanced protection.

Optima Juve is a therapeutic support system suitable for both the treatment of existing pressure ulcers category I-IV as well as for children who have been assessed to be at high risk from complications of immobility. The surface compromises two layers of air cells, with the top layer being pre-filled to allow greater immersion. The closed air system automatically adjusts to individual patient weight, providing excellent pressure redistribution.

A unique combination of full platform lateral tilt with unrivalled immersion. This helps improve outcomes, enhance patient care, and increase caregiver efficiency, both inside and outside intensive care.
Clinically and technologically advanced fluid immersion simulation therapy has transformed the prevention and treatment of pressure ulcers for the most complex patients.

Equipped with a unique and patented valve system and semi-dynamic technology, P.R.O. Matt Plus in non-powered mode, is able to achieve a pressure profile similar to that of a dynamic air mattress. This offers significantly higher therapy than a foam mattress and a traditional hybrid system and means patients are protected immediately. If the patient requires a ‘step up’, cell-in-cell technology allows a control unit to be added, converting the system to powered therapy and uniquely offering both alternating and continuous low pressure.
Dolphin Therapy extra-wide, suitable for bariatric beds, is the ideal choice of surface for complex and difficult-to-manage plus-size patients.

The TurnCair 1000 low air loss bariatric mattress provides a high specification of support surface for pressure redistribution, plus a TurnAssist feature that enables safe handling of patients. The TurnAssist feature facilitates easy manual handling for personal care and positional changes, easy changes of linen, inserting slide sheets and positional changes that can be carried out with one nurse.

The Neo is one of the only surfaces available specifically designed for neonates that have been compromised and at high risk of skin breakdown. The intelligent controller registers individual patient weight to provide a reactive support surface, even for the smallest of babies. Two versions available for compatibility with incubators and infant warmers.

The Medstrom Bariatric Tilt-in-Space chair provides a versatile seating and transport solution for high dependency plus-size patients. Multiple positions can be effortlessly achieved via an intuitive electrically operated handset, providing comfort for the patient and removing moving and handling risks for the caregiver.

The Bariatric Rotunda provides a safe and dignified method for plus-size patients to transition between a bed, seat, commode or wheelchair. Simple to use, the robust frame offers greater reassurance when mobilising, with highly visible feet and hand points for extra stability. Caregivers can then easily pivot patients between five different positions, significantly reducing the manual handling effort required.

Contact Us Custom Biliary – Biodegradable Stent Treatment of benign biliary stenosis can present significant challenges that many clinicians and interventional endoscopists can relate to. Off-the-shelf solutions often involve compromise, especially when patient-specific anatomy or pathology demands more precision. Key points: Benign biliary stenosis can be difficult to treat effectively with standard stent sizes and designs.
Clinicians often have to settle for the “closest fit”, which may not always yield optimal results.
Custom-made biodegradable stents, like those from Ella CS, offer a tailored approach that can better match the anatomy and healing profile of the patient.
Custom ERCP and CE marked Transhepatic options available.
Tracheal and bronchial stenting for complex benign airway disease can be extremely challenging, especially in newborns with congenital tracheal anomalies .
Postnatal complications , such as malformed or underdeveloped airways, often require creative and cutting-edge solutions.
Using a biodegradable stent avoids some of the long-term risks associated with traditional metallic or silicone stents.
The case at GOSH involved a scaffold-based approach , where the BD stent helped maintain airway structure while the stem-cell tissue matured and integrated.

Designs vary but it is basically an encircling band which wraps around the upper forearm and is secured by a velcro strap. The band has shaped pads which can be either fixed or movable. When correctly positioned and the velcro strap fastened to the correct tension, the band applies a compressive force over the area where the muscles and tendons blend and reduces the stress on the tendon at its attachment to the bone just below the elbow. detail.description: Silicone Laminated AFO - AM Healthcare Group Hit enter to search or ESC to close Search Close Search [vc_single_image image=”2107″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”] What is Silicone Laminated AFO? A silicone sleeve containing within it a thermoplastic shell. The silicone sleeve extends from approximately mid-calf to the ball area of the foot. It opens along the posterior (back) section of the leg and has an opening at the heel area. The posterior opening is secured with velcro closures. What does it do? It applies a lifting force to the foot to allow for clearance when the foot swings through and its design allows for a very flexible, thin and cosmetic AFO. The inclusion of thermoplastic within the Orthosis provides more structural control than is available when using a purely silicone device. It is not suitable for all foot drop types. detail.description: Supra Malleolar Orthoses (SMO) - AM Healthcare Group Hit enter to search or ESC to close Search Close Search [vc_single_image image=”3873″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”][vc_wp_text]Pictured above: Additive Supra Orthosis[/vc_wp_text] What is Supra Malleolar Orthoses (SMO)? A shell which extends from above the ankle bones to underneath the foot. It may extend to the ball of the foot or to the end of the foot depending on individual requirements. The shell covers the ankle bones but is cut away at the posterior (back) portion of the ankle and over the instep. The strapping requirements will depend on the condition being treated. Padding is included to protect bony areas. Material options include 3D printed nylon and thermoplastic. What does it do? Provides controlling forces to stabilise the foot position. It’s higher trimline helps to reduce pressure on the foot which can sometimes be experienced when using devices with a lower trimline. A thigh and calf shell connected by either a single (positioned on one side of the knee) or double (positioned one on each side of the knee) jointed strut(s). The shells are secured by velcro fastenings. One strut is adjustable to apply either a valgus (pushing the knee inward) or varus (pushing the knee outward) corrective force. What does it do? detail.description: Polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) is an exclusive surface treatment applied to FCI lacrimal products to improve the hydrophilic properties of silicone. The benefit of such a treatment is to enhance the efficiency of tear drainage and to limit the accumulation of debris at the surface of our silicone intubations and PVP perforated plugs. The Disposable Precivia® Device Precivia Device is a tried and tested disposable device that simplifies* intravitreal injections. Its special design ensures a fast, accurate & predictable procedure*. • The Precivia Device eliminates unnecessary instruments: no speculum, caliper or pressure plate needed. • Assures accuracy: fixed guide ensures proper angle, depth & distance of injection every time. • Relaxes patients*: immobilizes the eye & hides the needle resulting in less patient anxiety. • Prevents leakage*: Rotating the device pre & post injection, displaces & replaces the conjunctiva over the injection hole. The Precivia Device is the gold standard for all intravitreal injections. Precivia Device Notes: An intravitreal injection is a shot of medicine into injected into the eye. The inside of the eye is filled with a jelly-like fluid (vitreous). During this procedure, a health care provider injects medicine into the vitreous, near the retina at the back of the eye. The medicine can treat certain eye problems and help protect your vision. This method is most often used to get a higher level of medicine to the retina. *References: Ratnarajan G, Nath R, Appaswamy S, et al. Intravitreal injections using a novel conjunctival mould: a comparison with a conventional technique. British Journal of Ophthalmology 2013;97:395-397. Petri, A., Boysen, K., Cehofski, L.J. et al. It is designed to reduce operating time and trauma for the patients, either in the intubation phase as well as for the removal of the device. The intubation is self-retaining thanks to two wider silicone portions on the silicone tube. The surgical procedure is similar to the conventional Ritleng® lacrimal intubation and involves the use of Ritleng® instruments. • Regular 0.64mmsilicone tube for a comfortable fit in the intrapalpebral loop • Wider 0.94 mm silicone segments to be positioned in the lacrimal sac ensuring the self-retaining feature of the intubation: no need tomake knots in the nasal fossa • Blackmark to control the central placement and correct positioning of the silicone tube between the two punctums • Easy removal fromthe nose • Require Ritleng® instruments (S1.1460, S1.1470, S1.1480) The Ritleng®+ intubation systemis a Class IIbmedical devicemanufactured by FCI S.A.S. – Notified Body: GMED CE n°0459.

Ritleng® intubation system consists of a silicone (or PVP) tube connected at each extremity to a Poly Ether Ether Ketone (PEEK) thread guide to reduce time and trauma in lacrimal duct intubation surgery. The procedure involves inserting the hollow Ritleng® Probe into the nasolacrimal duct and feeding the thin PEEK thread through it. The probe is then withdrawn, leaving the PEEK to pull the silicone tubing into place. • Less traumatic for patients • Easy retrieval from the nose • Medical grade silicone – PVP option • Sterile The Ritleng® lacrimal intubation set is a Class IIb medical device manufactured by FCI S.A.S. – Notified Body: GMED CE n°0459.

Rapid screening test for Chlamydia trachomatis infection. The Chlamydia trachomatis Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay designed for the detection of Chlamydia trachomatis antigen in clinical specimens such as urine or swabs, depending on the test configuration. Chlamydia infection is often asymptomatic, making screening an essential part of sexual health programmes. This rapid test delivers results within minutes, supporting timely identification and referral for further clinical management. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Rapid semi‑quantitative screening of prostate‑specific antigen levels. The PSA Rapid Test Cassette is a semi‑quantitative lateral flow immunoassay for the detection of prostate‑specific antigen (PSA) in whole blood, serum or plasma. Elevated PSA levels may be associated with prostate cancer, benign prostatic hyperplasia or prostatitis. This test provides rapid screening results to support early clinical assessment and monitoring in professional healthcare and urology settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Rapid powder screening for synthetic nitazene opioids in harm reduction and forensic settings The Nitazene Powder Test Cassette is a rapid immunoassay device designed to screen dissolved powder samples for the presence of nitazenes. Nitazines are a group of potent synthetic opioids increasingly associated with fatal overdose incidents. Operating at a cut-off of 2000 ng/mL, the cassette delivers a visual result in 5 minutes from a prepared powder solution, without laboratory analysis. It is a valuable tool for drug checking services, harm reduction organisations, forensic drug testing teams and law enforcement agencies seeking to identify high-risk synthetic opioids in seized or submitted substances. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Rapid urine test for GHB detection at 10 µg/mL for clinical and forensic use The gamma-hydroxybutyrate (GHB) Test Cassette is a rapid immunoassay device that detects GHB in urine at a cut-off of 10 µg/mL. GHB is a central nervous system depressant associated with recreational misuse and drug-facilitated sexual assault. Because GHB clears from the body rapidly, often within 4-8 hours of ingestion, fast testing is critical in clinical and forensic settings. The cassette format requires only 3 drops of urine and delivers a clear visual result in 5 minutes, making it practical for emergency departments, sexual assault referral centres (SARCs) and forensic drug testing programmes. For professional use only

Rapid urine testing for Nicotine and Tobacco exposure screening The Cotinine Cassette is a rapid immunoassay test that detects cotinine – the primary metabolite of nicotine – in urine. As the main breakdown product of nicotine from tobacco and e-cigarettes, cotinine provides a reliable biomarker for tobacco and nicotine product use. Results are available within minutes with no laboratory equipment required, making the test practical for smoking cessation programmes, occupational health checks and insurance or pre-employment screening. Available in two cut-off configurations to suit different screening requirements: COT100 (100 ng/mL) for sensitive detection of light exposure; COT200 (200 ng/mL) for standard smoking status screening. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Rapid, portable surface drug test for detecting trace drug residues from powders or surfaces, with results in 5 minutes DrugTrace is a non-invasive, surface-based drug residue detection test that screens for 8 drug classes from swabbed surfaces or dissolved powder samples. No biological specimen is required from individuals. The 8 panel test simultaneously detects amphetamine, cocaine, fentanyl, ketamine, MDMA, methamphetamine, opiates and cannabis from a single surface swab and buffer solution. Results are available in 5 minutes. DrugTrace is designed for prisons, probation services, workplaces, border control, law enforcement and any setting where surface contamination monitoring or non-invasive drug detection is required. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Chain of Custody hair sample collection kit for confirmatory laboratory drug testing The Hair Drug Confirmation Kit is a complete professional collection kit for gathering, packaging and despatching hair samples to an accredited laboratory for confirmatory drug testing. Hair testing provides a significantly longer detection window than urine or oral fluid. A standard 3 cm head hair sample reflects approximately 0-3 months of drug use history, and extended history testing is possible with longer samples. The kit is used in workplace investigations, child safeguarding assessments, legal proceedings, insurance programmes and any situation where a robust, defensible, long-window drug use history is required. The kit includes all materials for a standardised, Chain of Custody compliant collection. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

products.name: Covid-19 IgG/IgM Antibody Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid screening of IgG and IgM antibodies to SARS‑CoV‑2. The COVID‑19 IgG/IgM Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the qualitative detection of IgG and IgM antibodies to SARS‑CoV‑2 in whole blood, serum or plasma samples. These antibodies may be present following previous exposure to the virus or as part of an immune response. IgM antibodies typically appear earlier in the immune response, while IgG antibodies may persist for a longer period. Combined IgG/IgM detection supports antibody screening and serological assessment when interpreted alongside clinical evaluation and patient history. The test delivers results within minutes using a simple cassette format suitable for point‑of‑care and laboratory settings. The COVID‑19 IgG/IgM Rapid Test Cassette is intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use only and should not be used for the diagnosis of acute SARS‑CoV‑2 infection. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Rapid saliva alcohol screening using a simple dip and read test strip. The Alcohol Rapid Test Strip is a simple, instrument‑free solution for the qualitative detection of alcohol in saliva. Based on enzymatic oxidation technology, the strip produces a colour change proportional to alcohol concentration, covering a range from 0.02% to 0.30%. Designed for professional use, it delivers fast, easy‑to‑interpret results within minutes, making it suitable for workplace screening, occupational health programmes and on‑site alcohol checks where immediate decision‑making is required. For professional use only . Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

7 parameter urine validity strips for detecting specimen tampering and substitution Adulteration Strips are rapid test strips that simultaneously assess 7 specimen validity parameters from a single urine dip, helping to identify samples that may have been tampered with, diluted or substituted. Parameters include pH, creatinine, nitrites, bleach, glutaraldehyde, PCC (pyridinium chlorochromate) and specific gravity. Detecting adulterated specimens is a critical quality control step in drug testing programmes, particularly in workplace and forensic settings where the integrity of results must be assured. Strips deliver clear colour-change results immediately after dipping, with no additional equipment required. For professional use only

Simple temperature verification for urine specimens This single-use temperature strip attaches to a urine specimen container and gives an immediate visual reading to confirm the sample is within the expected body temperature range of 32-39°C. Checking specimen temperature is a straightforward way to detect samples that may have been substituted or tampered with during collection. It is a standard part of many workplace and forensic drug testing protocols. For professional use only

On the spot screening for GHB, ketamine and benzodiazepines in drinks DrinkSpike is a rapid 3 panel dip card test that screens drinks for three substances most commonly associated with drink spiking: GHB (gamma-hydroxybutyrate), ketamine and benzodiazepines. The card is simply dipped into the suspect drink and results are read in 5 minutes. No specialist knowledge, equipment or laboratory is required. DrinkSpike is compact, discreet and designed for use in bars, clubs, universities, events and any setting where personal safety is a priority. It can be used on alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Chain of Custody urine drug confirmation kit for laboratory verified drug test results. The Urine Drug Confirmation Kit is a professional grade sample collection and packaging kit used to send urine specimens to an accredited laboratory for confirmatory drug testing. Designed to meet Chain of Custody requirements, it is suitable for workplace investigations, clinical settings, legal proceedings and forensic drug testing where a defensible, laboratory confirmed result is required. The kit contains all necessary components for secure, tamper-evident sample collection, sealing and despatch. Confirmatory analysis is performed using LC-MS/MS or equivalent technology at an approved laboratory. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Fast, donor friendly oral fluid drug test for on-site, rehab and clinical screening. SureSwab Rapid is a streamlined oral fluid drug screening device designed for faster collection and quicker results than standard oral fluid tests. A click-activated swab mechanism ensures accurate sample insertion, while a red saturation indicator confirms sufficient saliva collection in as little as 30 seconds. Available in a 7 panel configuration covering amphetamine, benzodiazepines, cocaine, methamphetamine, ketamine, opiates and cannabis. SureSwab Rapid is CE-marked and suitable for workplace, occupational health and on-site drug testing where speed and ease of use are critical. Results are available in 10 minutes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

products.name: On Call® Blood Glucose & Ketone Monitoring System

detail.description: Integrated blood glucose and ketone monitoring system for routine metabolic health management. The On Call® Blood Glucose & Ketone Monitoring System supports routine monitoring of blood glucose and β‑ketone levels using compatible test strips and a dual‑function meter. Designed for wellness and metabolic health management, the system enables regular monitoring to support diabetes management and ketone awareness. Components are intended for in vitro diagnostic use with capillary whole blood samples and provide clear, digital results when used according to the relevant Instructions for Use. For self testing and professional use

Rapid semi‑quantitative screening of C‑reactive protein (CRP) to support the assessment of inflammation and infection risk. The CRP semi-quantitative rapid test cassette is designed to provide fast and accurate measurement of C-reactive protein, supporting infection and inflammation assessment in professional healthcare settings. The test cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the detection of C‑reactive protein (CRP) in whole blood, serum or plasma samples. CRP is a non‑specific inflammatory marker that may be elevated in response to infection, tissue injury or inflammatory disease. The test delivers a semi-quantitative result by categorising CRP concentrations into clinically relevant ranges. This supports the assessment and monitoring of inflammatory conditions and may assist healthcare professionals in evaluating the likelihood of bacterial infection when interpreted alongside clinical findings and other diagnostic information. Results are available within minutes using a simple cassette format suitable for both point-of-care and laboratory environments. The test is designed for professional use and provides a rapid screening solution where timely inflammation assessment is required. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Convenient midstream urine test for rapid hCG detection. The Pregnancy Test Midstream is a rapid, one‑step lateral flow immunoassay for the qualitative detection of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine. The midstream format allows direct urine application without the need for additional collection devices, providing a convenient option for pregnancy screening in professional and supervised settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only.

Dip‑and‑read urine pregnancy test strip for hCG detection. The hCG Pregnancy Rapid Test Strip is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay designed to detect human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine specimens. The strip format offers a simple, cost‑effective solution for high‑volume pregnancy screening in professional settings. Results are available within minutes and are intended as a preliminary screening aid. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only.

Rapid qualitative detection of hCG to support early pregnancy screening. The hCG Pregnancy Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay designed for the detection of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine, serum or plasma specimens. hCG is produced shortly after implantation and is an established marker for early pregnancy detection. This test provides clear results within minutes and supports use in professional clinical and laboratory settings as a screening aid for pregnancy. For professional in vitro use only

products.name: Transferrin & Faecal Occult Blood Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Dual detection of occult blood and transferrin in stool samples. The Transferrin & Faecal Occult Blood Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative immunoassay designed to detect both human haemoglobin and transferrin in stool specimens. Combined testing improves the detection of gastrointestinal bleeding from both upper and lower regions of the GI tract. This enhanced screening approach supports early identification of conditions associated with colorectal and upper gastrointestinal cancers. For professional use only

products.name: Group A Streptococcus pyogenes (Strep A) Antigen Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid point‑of‑care screening for Group A Streptococcus infection. The Strep A Antigen Rapid Test Cassette detects Group A Streptococcus antigens from throat swab specimens. Producing results within minutes, it supports rapid assessment of streptococcal pharyngitis in clinical and primary care environments. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Influenza (Flu) A/B Antigen Combo Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid point‑of‑care screening for Influenza A and Influenza B from a nasal swab. The Influenza A/B Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the qualitative detection of Influenza A and Influenza B antigens from nasal swab specimens. Delivering clear results within minutes, it supports fast clinical decision‑making during respiratory infection assessment. The test is intended for professional use in point‑of‑care settings such as GP practices, clinics and healthcare environments where rapid differentiation of influenza types is required. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Covid-19 Antigen Rapid Test Cassette – Gold

detail.description: Reliable, rapid screening for SARS‑CoV‑2 antigen from nasal swab samples. The COVID‑19 Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the qualitative detection of SARS‑CoV‑2 antigen from nasal swab specimens. Antigen testing supports the screening of individuals with suspected acute infection and aids infection control decision‑making when used alongside clinical assessment. Results are available within minutes using a simple cassette format suitable for point‑of‑care and laboratory settings. The test is intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use only and should not be used as the sole basis for diagnosis or patient management. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Faecal Occult Blood Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid stool test for the qualitative detection of faecal occult blood. The Faecal Occult Blood (FOB) Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay for the detection of human haemoglobin in faecal specimens. The presence of occult blood in stool may indicate gastrointestinal bleeding associated with conditions such as colorectal cancer, polyps or ulcers. The test delivers fast results at the point of care and does not require dietary restrictions, making it suitable for routine screening and early clinical assessment in professional healthcare settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Helicobacter Pylori Antigen Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid stool antigen screening for active Helicobacter pylori infection. The H. pylori Antigen Rapid Test Cassette detects Helicobacter pylori antigens in stool specimens, supporting diagnosis of gastrointestinal infection associated with ulcers and gastritis. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Antigen Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid point‑of‑care RSV antigen detection from nasal swab specimens. The RSV Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay for the qualitative detection of Respiratory Syncytial Virus antigens from nasal swab specimens. RSV is a common cause of respiratory infection, particularly in infants, young children and older adults. This test delivers clear results within minutes, supporting timely clinical assessment and infection management in professional healthcare settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Urine alcohol screening using ETG for extended detection after drinking. The ETG Urine Alcohol Test is a rapid screening test designed to detect ethyl glucuronide (EtG), a direct metabolite of alcohol, in urine at a cut‑off of 1000 ng/mL. Unlike saliva or breath tests that indicate recent alcohol use, ETG testing extends the detection window, identifying alcohol consumption for up to several days after drinking. The test is suited to professional screening programmes where alcohol abstinence or compliance monitoring is required, including workplace testing, occupational health and rehabilitation settings. Results are available within minutes using a simple dip and read format. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

products.name: SARS-CoV-2 & Influenza (Flu) A/B Antigen Combo Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Combined antigen screening for Covid‑19 and Influenza A/B from one sample. The first dual test in the UK to be awarded CTDA approval. The SARS‑CoV‑2 & Influenza A/B Antigen Combo Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed to detect Covid‑19 and Influenza A/B antigens from a single nasal swab. This combined approach supports efficient differential diagnosis of respiratory infections at the point of care, delivering fast results to aid clinical decision‑making. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Advanced breath alcohol screening with optional printed results. The Intoximeter is a professional breath alcohol screening device designed for organisations requiring enhanced functionality and robust testing workflows. Using fuel cell sensor technology, it delivers fast and consistent BrAC screening results from breath samples. In addition to direct breath testing, the Intoximeter supports passive and drink sniffer modes, allowing screening without a direct mouthpiece blow. Optional integrated printing provides immediate hard‑copy records, making the device suitable for structured workplace, clinical and compliance‑driven alcohol screening programmes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

Reliable breath alcohol screening using fuel cell sensor technology. The Alcometer is a professional breath alcohol tester designed to provide fast, reliable screening for alcohol using advanced fuel cell sensor technology. Measuring breath alcohol concentration (BrAC) across a range of 0.00 to 2.00 mg/L, it delivers clear digital results within seconds. Its compact, easy‑to‑use design makes it suitable for workplace screening, occupational health programmes and on‑site alcohol testing where quick, preliminary results are required. Built‑in warning indicators support alcohol policy thresholds while maintaining straightforward operation for professional users. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

Dip‑and‑read urine reagent strips for rapid multiparameter screening. Urinalysis Reagent Strips are dip‑and‑read test strips designed for the rapid qualitative and semi‑quantitative detection of multiple parameters in urine, including glucose, protein, blood, ketones, pH, nitrite and leukocytes. Results provide valuable information relating to general metabolic status, kidney and urinary tract function, and overall health. These strips are intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use and can be read visually using a colour chart or instrumentally with urine chemistry analysers. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Non-invasive oral fluid multi-drug test for workplace and rehabilitation screening. SureSwab is an oral fluid (saliva) drug screening device that detects multiple drugs of abuse without the need for urine collection or restroom facilities. Using a sponge collector, the donor provides a saliva sample which is transferred to the integrated test cassette. A collection indicator confirms that sufficient sample has been obtained. Available in 8 and 10 panel configurations, SureSwab is CE marked and designed for use in workplace drug testing, ‘for cause’ testing, rehabilitation programmes and any setting where observed, non-invasive collection is important. Results are available in 10 minutes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Flexible multi‑drug urine screening from a single low‑volume sample. The Multi‑cassette urine drug test offers flexible multi‑drug screening using individual cassettes from a single urine specimen. Designed for low sample volumes, it allows specific drug combinations to be tested simultaneously with results available in minutes. Its modular format is well suited to workplaces, laboratories and clinical settings requiring adaptable screening options. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Targeted, cost‑effective urine drug screening with fast, reliable results. The Single Drug Test Strip provides a simple and cost effective solution for targeted urine drug screening where only one analyte is required. Designed for professional use, it delivers clear visual results in minutes without the need for laboratory equipment. Its compact format makes it ideal for high volume testing programmes, workplace screening and clinical settings requiring focused testing for specific drugs. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

High throughput dip‑and‑read urine drug screening in a single device. The Multi‑panel urine drug test houses multiple test strips in one dip‑and‑read device, enabling simultaneous screening for several drug classes. Designed for high throughput environments, it delivers results in minutes while reducing handling and simplifying workflow. Its robust construction and clear visual cues support consistent use in workplace and clinical screening programmes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Fast, secure urine drug screening with integrated testing strips. The Rapid Cup is an all in one urine drug test cup designed for fast on‑site screening. Integrated test strips and built in validity indicators streamline the collection to result process, reducing handling and delivering results within minutes. Its secure, leak resistant design makes it ideal for workplace, clinical and mobile testing environments. For professional use only

All in one urine drug test cup with enhanced specimen security and rapid results. The Integrated Key Cup combines urine collection and multi‑drug screening in a single secure device. A built‑in activation key controls test initiation, reducing handling and supporting sample integrity. With clear results available in minutes and integrated validity checks, it is widely used in workplace, occupational health and forensic screening programmes where security, speed and ease of use are essential. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Regulated Disinfectant Cleaner. PT2 Disinfectant – BPR Registered. pH neutral. Achieves full disinfection in just 1 minute. Eliminates the pre-cleaning step entirely, reducing time, chemical usage, and the risk of cross-contamination between cleaning and disinfection stages. Designed to deliver excellent surface aesthetics on a range of surfaces. Benefitting from properties such as: Low residue, low tackiness, low streaking (high gloss and low haze), compatible with alcohol-sensitive surfaces. Safe on a wide range of materials including plastics, rubber, glass, and metal alloys, without the surface damage risks associated with acidic or alkaline disinfectants. Should not be used on Brass, Copper and Mild Steel.

detail.description: Grid Pad 13 is a powerful and fully featured environmental control unit with speech generation and full computer access ready for use with eye tracking technology or head mouse. Designed for people with acquired needs including and not limited to MND / ALS, Cerebral Palsy, brain injury and other conditions that affect speech and mobility.

Night-time seizures can be difficult to monitor, creating anxiety for families and caregivers. Epi-Care 3000 is an advanced epilepsy bed alarm that monitors for tonic-clonic seizures during sleep, helping caregivers respond quickly when every second matters. Designed for both children and adults, it combines proven sensor technology with intelligent movement analysis to deliver reliable seizure detection night after night.

Combi 4 is a compact, easy-to-use controller that allows you to manage multiple devices with just four buttons. Whether you need 4 or up to 8 commands, Combi 4 delivers flexibility through Infra-red and Radio control , making it the perfect solution for assistive technology users.

The Possum Combi 1 is an advanced single-switch environmental controller designed for individuals who require straightforward functionality. It enables users to turn one or two devices on and off with ease, providing independence and convenience for those with limited physical movement.

The Possum Freeway is a versatile environmental control unit designed for individuals with mobility, visual, or cognitive challenges. It enables seamless control of household devices, entertainment systems, and telecare solutions—bringing freedom, safety, and convenience into everyday life.

Qwayo 2 is the next-generation assistive technology device, designed with input from users, NHS assessors, and specialists. It supports individuals with conditions such as Multiple Sclerosis (MS) or Cerebral Palsy, as well as those who may not be able to physically access devices in their home or use a standard phone or computer. Qwayo 2 combines intuitive navigation, robust connectivity, and a streamlined design to make communication, environmental control, and daily living simpler, safer, and more independent.

The Possum Primo Pro is a dedicated environmental control unit designed to empower independence. Compact yet powerful, it offers seamless control of everyday devices and integrated Bluetooth telephony access , so you can make and receive calls effortlessly. Engineered for reliability and flexibility, Primo Pro is an excellent assistive technology solution for accessible living and promoting independence.

The Possum Wireless Input Output Relay provides a simple and effective way to integrate third-party equipment, alarms and building systems into a Possum telecare or nurse call environment. Using secure wireless communication, the relay enables devices to trigger actions, generate alerts or control connected equipment, helping create a more responsive and intelligent care setting. Designed for flexibility, the Wireless Input Output Relay is ideal for both new installations and retrofit projects where running additional cables may be difficult, disruptive or costly.

The InfoPpger provides health and care teams with a simple way to receive and manage alerts from multiple compatible telecare sensors through one portable device. Designed for care environments with on-site teams, it helps staff identify incoming alerts and coordinate an appropriate response. The Infopager can be used as a standalone local alerting system or configured to retransmit alerts through a compatible carephone, providing an additional escalation route when required.

The HC1823 Relay expands the capabilities of a Possum Environmental Control System (ECS) by providing up to 14 relay outputs, allowing a Possum controller to operate equipment that cannot be controlled directly via infrared. Ideal for bespoke environmental control installations, it enables users to independently control a wider range of devices and environmental functions from a single system, supporting greater accessibility and independence

The HC603C Socket is an infrared-controlled power socket designed for use with Possum Environmental Control Systems. It enables users to remotely switch electrical appliances, such as lamps, fans, radios and other compatible devices, on or off using a Possum controller. As part of an Environmental Control System (ECS), the HC603C Socket helps people with limited mobility maintain greater independence by allowing them to control everyday household appliances without needing physical access to switches or plug sockets. By integrating appliance control into the user’s existing environmental control setup, it can reduce reliance on carers and make it easier to manage the home environment safely and independently.

The Possum Sip and Puff Switch makes life easier for anyone with limited mobility. With a simple sip or puff, you can control communication aids, environmental controls, and computers—without lifting a finger. It’s hygienic, responsive, and designed to give you independence every day.

The Possum Chin Switch makes life easier for anyone with limited mobility. Just a gentle chin movement lets you control your devices—whether it’s communication aids, environmental controls, or computers. It’s comfortable, easy to use, and designed to give you more independence every day.

The Guarded Plate Switch is designed for individuals who experience involuntary hand movements or tremors. Its protective guard ensures accurate activation, reducing accidental triggers and providing confidence in everyday use. Perfect for conditions such as Parkinson’s disease and Multiple Sclerosis (MS), this switch integrates seamlessly with our full range of environmental controllers.

A versatile, easy-to-use adaptive switch designed for individuals with limited mobility or dexterity. With its large activation surface and light-touch operation, it provides effortless access to assistive technology and environmental controls, helping users maintain independence and confidence.

The Head Mouse enables users to control a computer, tablet, smartphone or environmental control system using simple head movements, providing a completely hands-free method of access. Designed for people with limited hand or arm function, it delivers smooth, accurate cursor control with minimal effort, making it easier to communicate, access technology and interact with their environment independently. With customisable settings, dwell-click functionality and support for external switches, it can be tailored to suit a wide range of individual needs and abilities. Ideal for environmental control systems, the Head Mouse allows users to operate doors, lights, televisions, phones and other connected devices, helping them maintain greater independence, choice and control in everyday life.

Possum Freedom makes life easier by bringing door entry, intercom, and telephone features together in one handy, wireless device. It’s designed with accessibility in mind and works perfectly with environmental control systems, so you can stay connected and in control with confidence.

Possum Novo is a digital carephone system designed to provide safety, independence, and peace of mind for people who may need emergency assistance at home. It connects to broadband or mobile networks and integrates with a wide range of telecare peripherals such as fall detectors, smoke alarms, and bed sensors. When an alarm is triggered, Novo automatically calls a pre-programmed number—this could be an Alarm Receiving Centre (ARC), family, or friends—ensuring help is on the way quickly.
The Vibby Oak Fall Detector automatically detects hard falls with impact and raises an alert to a connected telecare system, helping users stay safe, confident and independent at home.

Smile Fall is a wrist-worn device that monitors for movements associated with a hard fall. When a fall is detected, it automatically raises an alert through the connected system, helping carers, family members or a monitoring response service become aware that assistance may be required. Designed for people with an identified risk of falling, Smile Fall provides an additional way to request support when the wearer may be unable to press a personal alarm button, supporting a timely and appropriate response.

Formerly known as the Paper Thin Bed Sensor, BedSense is an ultra-thin occupancy sensor that provides timely notification when a person leaves or returns to their bed or chair. Positioned discreetly beneath the bed sheet or directly on the chair, its flexible, low-profile design minimises disruption to comfort while providing reliable occupancy monitoring. Designed for hospitals, care homes, supported living and community care settings, BedSense connects with compatible Possum telecare and nurse call solutions. By alerting care teams to changes in bed or chair occupancy, it supports timely assistance, proactive management of falls risk and more responsive, person-centred care.

What is SensorMATe? Sensor MATe is a clever device that works with bed and floor mats to help keep people safe. It detects movement or occupancy and sends alerts straight to your care system, so you know when someone needs attention. No complicated setup, no PC required – just peace of mind. How It Works Plug in up to two sensor mats (for bed or floor). Set your preferred times and alarm delays using the easy keypad and screen. SensorMATe sends wireless alerts to your Possum pager or carephone when triggered. Runs on AA batteries for up to a year – no mains power needed.

detail.description: The Possum Floor Mat Kit is a reliable falls prevention solution designed for care home environments, helping staff identify when a resident gets out of bed or enters a high risk area. When pressure is applied, an alert is triggered immediately via the Info pager enabling staff to respond quickly and reduce the risk of falls or long lies. The mat can be securely fixed in place using adhesive , helping to prevent movement and reduce trip hazards in busy care settings. Suitable for bedside, doorway, or other high risk locations, the Floor Mat Kit supports safer monitoring while reducing unnecessary checks and disruption to residents.

The Possum Flood Detector helps you stop water damage before it starts. If it senses a leak or spill, it sounds a loud alarm and sends an alert to your telecare system—so you can act fast and avoid costly mess.

The Possum Heat Detector monitors rapid rises in temperature, providing early warning of fire risk without the false alarms common with smoke detectors. Ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, and environments where steam or smoke may trigger unwanted alerts, this sensor sends a wireless signal to a Novo Carephone or Info Pager, ensuring immediate response. Integrated with telecare systems, it can escalate alerts to an Alarm Receiving Centre (ARC), which can contact emergency services on the user’s behalf.

The CO Detector continuously monitors for dangerous levels of carbon monoxide and provides an immediate warning when the gas is detected. Designed to support safer independent living, it offers reliable protection against the risks of carbon monoxide poisoning and can be integrated into telecare solutions for enhanced safety and reassurance.

Our Smoke Detector is designed for vulnerable adults living alone, where safety and peace of mind matter most. It quickly detects smoke from smouldering or open fires and sends instant alerts to caregivers. With a built-in radio transmitter, it connects seamlessly to devices like care phones or pagers, so help is never far away. Simple to install and reliable, this is safety you can trust.

The Emfit Epilepsy Sensor from Possum is designed to monitor tonic-clonic seizures during sleep. Placed under the mattress, it uses advanced movement and heart-rate sensing to detect abnormal activity and send instant alerts to caregivers. This clinically proven solution offers reassurance for families and care providers, helping ensure timely assistance when needed.

The Companion Mini is a discreet epilepsy monitor designed to detect tonic-clonic seizures during sleep. Placed under the mattress, it senses seizure movements and instantly alerts carers through a base unit and pager — providing reassurance and timely support.

Epi-Care Free uses a clinically tested wrist-worn sensor to detect movement patterns associated with tonic-clonic seizures, during the day or while sleeping. When these patterns are detected, a real-time alert is sent through the control unit to a compatible pager, carephone or nurse call system—supporting timely carer awareness while enabling greater independence within the system’s operating range.

EpiCare Mobile is a discreet wristband that monitors for tonic-clonic seizures wherever you go. It connects to a smartphone app, sending instant alerts to caregivers or family members — giving independence and reassurance at home or on the move.

A door/window alarm sensor monitors the opening of a door or window and sends a notification through a compatible pager or nurse call system. This enables carers to respond promptly when support or further checks may be needed. This helps protect residents who may be at risk of wandering, while supporting a safe and secure environment without restricting independence.

Managing multiple medications can be challenging, particularly for people living with memory loss, dementia, visual impairments or complex medication routines. The Possum Pippa Tipper Automatic Pill Dispenser is a simple, secure and reliable solution that automatically presents the correct medication dose at the programmed time. With a lockable 28-compartment carousel, customisable reminders and a long-lasting rechargeable battery, it helps reduce missed doses, prevent accidental over-medication and support greater independence.

Previously sold as SmartSole GPS, SafeSole is the updated GPS tracking insole available from Possum. SafeSole is a discreet GPS shoe tracker built into an insole and worn inside everyday footwear. It provides reliable location tracking without the need for a visible wearable device, making it particularly suitable for older people and individuals living with dementia who may be at risk of walking with purpose or becoming lost. Unlike watches, pendants or standalone GPS trackers that can be forgotten, removed or left at home, SafeSole stays discreetly inside the user’s shoe. This makes it a practical GPS tracker worn inside the shoe, helping family members, carers and support teams locate someone quickly while supporting independence, confidence and dignity. SafeSole uses a roaming SIM card to connect to available mobile networks, helping provide reliable location tracking across the UK. Its discreet design supports greater independence and confidence for the user, while offering reassurance and peace of mind for family members, carers and support teams.

The Vibrating Pillow Alert provides a simple and effective way to notify users and carers of telecare alarms without relying on sound alone. Using a powerful vibrating pad placed beneath a pillow, it delivers a clear tactile alert when a connected telecare alarm is activated. Ideal for people who are deaf or hard of hearing, as well as carers who need to respond to telecare events during the night, the Vibrating Pillow Alert helps ensure important alerts are not missed while sleeping. The Vibrating Pillow Alert has been adapted to work with compatible Neat telecare equipment, allowing telecare alarms and sensors to trigger both the strobe light and vibrating pillow pad. This provides an effective alerting solution for people with sensory impairments and for carers who need to respond quickly to telecare events during the night.

The Possum Wall Family is a versatile range of wall-mounted call and control devices designed for assisted living environments. Completely wireless, the devices require no fixed cabling and can be installed with minimal disruption. This makes them easy to retrofit within existing buildings as well as suitable for new developments. Available in a range of configurations, the Wall Family can be tailored to different users, environments and care requirements. The devices provide convenient access to assistance, communication and compatible environmental controls, supporting responsive care and greater independence.

The Possum Swytch transforms a standard telecare pendant into a large, easy-to-activate alarm trigger for people with limited mobility, dexterity or strength. Compatible with pendants from most leading telecare providers, Swytch securely houses the user’s existing pendant while creating a larger activation surface. Its waterproof design makes it ideal for bathrooms and shower areas, supporting safer and more independent bathing. With a range of mounting options available, Swytch can be positioned wherever help may be needed most, ensuring assistance is always within easy reach.
The REPO+ II Radio Repeater extends telecare coverage across large and complex care environments, helping ensure critical alarm signals are delivered reliably whenever they’re needed.

The Smile Pendant provides a simple and convenient way for people to request support when they need it. Worn around the neck or on a wrist strap, its lightweight, waterproof design makes it suitable for everyday use. A quick press of the button raises an alert to the receiver unit. Depending on the system configuration, this can contact an alarm response centre or notify a carer, nurse or family member through a compatible pager. With an open-air wireless range of up to 200 metres from the base unit, the Smile Pendant is suitable for residential and nursing care, supported living, healthcare environments and use at home.

The Possum Nursecall Logger provides a central record of alarm activity, giving care providers greater visibility of when calls are raised and how they are handled. Clear reporting helps teams review response performance, identify recurring patterns and maintain an auditable record of activity. By transforming alarm data into meaningful management information, the Nursecall Logger can support service reviews, operational planning and evidence-based decisions about staffing and care delivery.

The Optima Joystick provides smooth and responsive access to environmental controls and assistive technology, enabling users with limited mobility to operate everyday devices confidently and independently. Designed for users who have reliable hand, finger or directional movement, the Possum Joystick offers accurate and effortless control of environmental control systems and assistive technology. Its ergonomic design and responsive operation make it an ideal access method for individuals seeking greater independence in daily living.
The Specs IC Switch offers a compact 1.375-inch activation surface for users who need precise control. Interchangeable caps and flexible mounting make it versatile and user-friendly.
The Big Red Switch provides a large 5-inch activation surface, perfect for users with visual or motor challenges. It offers tactile and auditory feedback and interchangeable tops for customisation.

The Micro Light Switch is designed for people who need the lightest possible touch. It’s perfect for users with very limited strength or mobility. Despite its tiny size, it delivers big performance with tactile and auditory feedback, so you always know when it’s activated. Compact, reliable, and easy to position, this switch makes independence simple.

Designed for users with moderate to severe motor disabilities who need a large, easy-to-press switch. With a large activation surface and light-touch activation, it provides reliable control for communication aids, environmental systems, and more.

The Pillow Switch is designed for users who need a soft, comfortable surface for activation. Perfect for head, cheek, or other gentle movements, it offers low activation force and secure mounting options for everyday accessibility.

Perfect for users with very limited range of motion who need a small, precise switch. For example: Mounted on a wheelchair tray for controlling a speech-generating device. Positioned near the headrest for activation with a slight head movement. Used in hospital or home care settings where hygiene and durability are essential. Its compact size and waterproof design make it ideal for environments where space is limited and reliability is critical.
features: Mounted on a wheelchair tray for controlling a speech-generating device.

detail.description: Vibby Home combines advanced monitoring, fall detection, and wellbeing features to help people live independently while keeping carers and families connected.

The Possum Foot Switch is a simple access device that allows people to control their Possum Environmental Control System using their foot. It is ideal for individuals who have limited hand or arm movement but can comfortably use their foot or leg to operate a switch. A gentle press of the switch can be used to navigate menus, select options and control connected devices, helping users interact with their environment more independently. Whether used to operate lights, communication aids or other environmental controls, the Foot Switch provides a reliable and easy-to-use access method.

WanderSafe uses a discreet wearable device assigned to the individual being monitored. As they move around the building, strategically placed monitoring points identify their location and can detect when they enter specific areas, approach exits, or require assistance. Only the person wearing the WanderSafe device is monitored, meaning other residents can continue their daily activities without interruption. This makes WanderSafe ideal for care homes, supported living schemes and other multi-resident environments where one or more individuals may require additional support while preserving the independence and privacy of everyone else. When support is needed, care staff receive an instant alert showing who the person is and where they are, enabling a quick and appropriate response while maintaining freedom, dignity and independence.

ProTECtor is a wireless staff safety system that helps care teams get help fast when it’s needed most. At the press of a button, staff can raise an alarm that is instantly sent to colleagues, along with their location, enabling a rapid response. Alarm activity is automatically recorded, providing a clear audit trail for incident management and reporting.

Easywave connects compatible transmitters, receivers, sensors and interfaces using radio technology. This allows users to control equipment wirelessly, reducing the need for control cables between the user and the device.

The range includes simple single-button transmitters, large-button remote controls and switch-accessible scanning controllers. Depending on the controller and the equipment installed, users can control functions such as televisions, music systems, lighting, doors, windows and bed functions.

detail.description: Development of Modern-Day Hip Resurfacing Information for healthcare professionals Modern-day hip resurfacing is based on observations of patients with large diameter metal-on-metal (MoM) total hip prostheses such as the McKee-Farrar and the Ring Hip (Figure 1), who retained functioning hips with very little wear for more than 30 years after their operation 3 . Finsbury (now MatOrtho ® ) was involved in the development of the Birmingham Hip Resurfacing (BHR), which was based on study of the successful devices and the application of modern manufacturing techniques. Since its first use in 1997, thousands of successful hip resurfacing procedures have been performed around the world. Figure 1: Historical MoM prosthesis: the Ring Hip implanted 1964–1979. The ADEPT ® Hip Resurfacing System was developed using the knowledge gained by direct involvement in the BHR and the extensive research of historical MoM devices, and as the original manufacturer of the BHR 3 , manufacturing over 200,000 BHR devices. The clinical success of the MRK™ has strong relevance as a ‘proof of concept’ to the expected long-term outcomes for the SAIPH® Knee, which is an evolution of the original design. Overall, the MRK™ has been shown to provide greater inherent stability than comparator devices 18,19,20 . products.name: Principles Of The Saiph Medially Stabilised Knee

detail.description: Principles of the 'SAIPH ® Medially Stabilised' Knee Information for healthcare professionals Tibiofemoral Articulation The SAIPH® Knee design is based on the principle of medial stability in the normal knee, which has been described in historical literature 2 and widely in recent literature 3,4,5 . In normal, healthy knees the shapes of the medial and lateral tibial condyles are different: the medial side is concave; the lateral side is convex. Stability is provided collectively by the collateral ligaments (MCL and LCL), both cruciate ligaments (ACL and PCL) and the menisci. The shapes of the articular surfaces and the arrangement of stabilising soft tissue structures collectively provide greater stability about the medial condyle. Knee flexion is accompanied by axial rotation of the femur with respect to the tibia, which is achieved with a limited freedom for antero-posterior (AP) movement of the lateral femoral condyle relative to the tibia. Stability throughout flexion is crucial to normal knee function: a knee with a deficient ACL or medial meniscus, for example, is likely to be unstable and may require corrective surgery.
