detail.description: Orthopaedic Data Evaluation Panel (ODEP) Information for healthcare professionals ODEP provide a service evaluation for TKR ratings and award ratings based on ongoing assessment of implant performance (rate of revision), and the number of patients for which principally UK data is available. The registries and clinical studies described in this document report excellent rates of survivorship for the SAIPH® Knee, with cumulative revision rates lower than the average TKR revision rates and among the lowest of all available devices 17,43,45 . Within the MatOrtho® philosophy for safe introduction of new technology, the SAIPH® Knee was released with limited availability and under closely monitored use over the first 10 years. To ensure versions of implant brands are reported appropriately, ODEP separate devices into their available constructs. For the SAIPH® Knee, this means separating UK data for SAIPH® Knee procedures with no patella, with a cementless patella and with a cemented patella. How well a TKR achieves this can be determined by evaluating the pattern of movement in patients’ knees during well-selected activities. To evaluate the kinematics of the SAIPH® Knee, a consecutive series of one surgeon’s first 14 patients (mean 69 years old, range 51-83), with no exclusions were assessed using video fluoroscopy at a minimum 24 months postoperatively 7 . Study participants were asked to perform clinically relevant functional activities, including: a full internal-to-external pivot standing on the affected leg to show the AP extents of medial and lateral condyles with large torque while under load; a kneeling activity to establish full passive flexion; lunge and step-up/down activities to establish ROM and AP stability in both condyles for the loaded knee. In all activities the SAIPH® Knee exhibited an asymmetric pattern of movement: the knee was AP stable on the medial side and lateral translation was permitted when required (Figure 1) 7 . Hook and loop fasteners are a type of closure mechanism used in a wide variety of applications, including clothing, footwear, medical devices, and more. These fasteners consist of two components: a hook component and a loop component, which adhere to each other when pressed together. Hook and loop fasteners are available in several different formats, including sew-on fasteners, elasticated fasteners, self-adhesive fasteners, and Omni mixed hook and loop. Sew-on fasteners are designed to be stitched onto fabrics or materials, while self-adhesive fasteners can be easily attached to surfaces without the need for sewing or other types of fastening. Elasticated hook and loop fasteners are ideal for applications that require a snug, secure fit, such as medical devices or sports equipment. Omni mixed hook and loop fasteners combine both hook and loop components on a single strip, providing greater flexibility and versatility in their use. These fasteners are supplied in 25-metre rolls in a range of widths and are available in primarily black and white colours, making them suitable for a wide range of applications. The quality of hook and loop fasteners is a critical consideration, as these fasteners need to be reliable and durable, particularly in high-stress applications. Overall, hook and loop fasteners are a versatile and practical solution for a wide range of fastening needs. With various formats and sizes available, they can be customised to meet the specific requirements of each application. The high-quality construction and availability of these fasteners make them a popular choice for both commercial and personal use.

The motion sprint 900 SE: Professional Slat-Technology for Level-Ground Training The motion sprint 900 SE is a robust, professional-grade treadmill featuring advanced lamella (slat) technology. Engineered for clinics and training facilities that require a high-performance, flat-surface running environment, the SE model provides the same exceptional joint protection and mechanical precision as the rest of the 900 series. Superior Impact Absorption and Mechanical Efficiency The running surface is composed of 60 individual slats, each laterally mounted on high-precision ball bearings. This allows the lamellas to react dynamically to every step, creating a “swing” effect that significantly reduces impact forces on the patient’s joints. The low-friction design of the slat system ensures remarkably smooth synchronisation and allows for consistent operation at ultra-low speeds starting from just 0.1 km/h—ideal for early-stage gait training and neurological rehabilitation. While this specific model is designed for level-ground exercise (no inclination), it offers a standard speed range up to 17.0 km/h, with an optional performance package available to reach 22 km/h.

The motion sprint 900 SL is a robust, high-performance treadmill engineered with advanced lamella (slat) technology. Designed for both clinical rehabilitation and professional athletic training, it provides a superior running surface that prioritises joint protection and mechanical precision. Advanced Lamella Engineering for Joint Protection At the heart of the motion sprint 900 SL are 60 individual slats, each laterally mounted on high-precision ball bearings. This allows the running surface to “swing” freely and respond dynamically to every footfall. The result is a highly shock-absorbent surface that optimally protects the patient’s joints while ensuring smooth synchronisation even at low motor power. This low-friction design is particularly beneficial for delicate rehabilitation, as it enables smooth, consistent operation at speeds as low as 0.1 km/h. For higher-intensity diagnostics, the system supports speeds up to 17.0 km/h as standard, with an optional performance package increasing the maximum speed to 22 km/h.

The motion stair 900 is the final component in our comprehensive equipment line, specifically designed to bridge the gap between clinical exercise therapy and functional everyday movement. By simulating the natural action of climbing stairs, it provides a highly effective platform for simultaneous cardiovascular conditioning, muscular strengthening, and the advancement of coordinative skills. Versatile Motion and Enhanced Patient Safety Unlike traditional steppers, the motion stair 900 utilises a pedal-independent system. This allows for a vast variety of movement amplitudes and specialised work tasks, making it an essential tool for training balance and motor coordination. To ensure the system is accessible to the widest possible patient demographic, the frame features a newly designed handrail. This ergonomic support provides a higher degree of security, extending the device’s application to users with compromised balance or weaker coordination. Furthermore, the entry point has been optimised for safer and easier access, ensuring patient confidence from the very start of the session.

The motion body 900 WM provides the full therapeutic power of our premier upper-body trainer in a specialised, wall-mounted configuration. Designed for facilities where space is at a premium, this model maintains all the advanced functionality of the standard motion body 900 while offering a significantly smaller footprint and unhindered access for wheelchair users. Maximum Functionality, Minimal Footprint The motion body 900 WM is the ideal solution for clinics that require a high degree of flexibility without occupying valuable floor space. With a simple, robust installation on any solid wall, the unit becomes a permanent, stable fixture for a wide range of patients. Its impressive 40 cm vertical adjustment range allows clinicians to quickly set the drive axle to the perfect height for seated patients, wheelchair users, or those performing standing exercises. Like its floor-mounted counterpart, it features the ability to switch between asynchronous and synchronous “handibike” modes, ensuring it can handle everything from delicate joint mobilisation to intensive muscle-building protocols.

The motion body 900 is an indispensable component of holistic exercise therapy and integrated cardiovascular training. Specifically designed for active engagement of the upper extremities, this versatile system is ideal for both endurance training and the targeted mobilisation of the arms and shoulders following joint injuries or surgery. Exceptional Versatility and Ergonomics The drive unit features an extensive adjustment range, allowing the axle height to be perfectly positioned for both seated and standing training. The system supports both forward and backward movement, and the standard length-adjustable cranks can be quickly switched to a synchronous “handibike mode.” The asynchronous movement is excellent for shoulder joint and rotator cuff mobilisation, while the synchronous motion sequence is preferred for muscle building and is the optimal training mode for wheelchair users. To ensure maximum safety and comfort, the unit is equipped with Leki® grips. These feature a specialised click mechanism that allows for the use of hand straps or gloves, providing extra security for patients with limited grip strength.

The motion cross 900 is designed to engage the entire body, making it an ideal solution for activating patients with sedentary lifestyles or those requiring low-impact cardiovascular conditioning. Its guided movement pattern ensures a safe and immediate start to training, promoting an upright posture while coordinating upper and lower body movement for maximum therapeutic benefit. Ergonomic Motion and Clinical Safety The system features long cranks and an ergonomic linkage between arm and leg movements, creating a smooth, sweeping stride that mimics natural motion. Unlike many other cross-trainers on the market, the motion cross 900 is engineered for joint-friendly performance and whisper-quiet operation. With its intuitive interface and easy-to-learn movement, the device allows patients to train effectively with minimal supervision, optimising staff resources. Furthermore, the exceptionally low step-on height of just 18 cm makes it one of the most accessible machines in its class for clinical rehabilitation.

The motion relax 900 is a premium recumbent training system engineered for comfort during extended sessions. It is specifically designed to meet the needs of patients with neurological or orthopedic restrictions, as well as those requiring a higher weight capacity. By prioritising ergonomic support, the motion relax 900 ensures that even the most challenging rehabilitation goals remain accessible and safe. Enhanced Accessibility and Specialised Support This latest development features an extended step-through area and a narrow, joint-friendly Q-factor to promote natural movement. To ensure the safety of every patient, the unit is equipped with robust support handles for easy mounting and dismounting, alongside a standard adjustable backrest for personalised lumbar support. For bariatric care, the “Boosted 250” version offers an expanded swivel seat and high-positioned armrests, facilitating easier access and supporting a maximum user weight of 250 kg.

The motion cycle 900 has been meticulously engineered with a focus on biomechanical excellence, meeting the rigorous requirements for both clinical rehabilitation and athletic performance. Designed to provide an optimal, individualized training position, it ensures that every user—regardless of physical stature or mobility—can train safely and effectively. Maximum Accessibility and Ergonomic Flexibility Recognizing the needs of patients with restricted mobility, the motion cycle 900 features a compact housing that allows for a wide, low step-through of approximately 36–41 cm. This deep-axle design ensures effortless mounting and dismounting. The system is highly inclusive, accommodating a vast range of users from children (starting at 135 cm) to tall adults (up to 205 cm). With a narrow Q-factor of no more than 18 cm and a wide range of horizontal and vertical adjustments, the motion cycle 900 provides a natural, joint-friendly pedaling motion tailored to the individual.

The motion cycle 100 med is a robust and medically certified ergometer that is easy to operate and includes the basic functions of a medical training device. It is always manufactured according to the medical directive (EU) 2017/745, class IIa and equipped with a coded pulse receiver, three training programmes, backlight and interface. The included quickstart programme is speed-dependent, the timed training is watt-constant and thus speed-independent. We also consider a pulse-controlled and therefore also speed-independent training programme to be essential for good endurance training. The valuable independence from the power grid avoids annoying tripping hazards and saves electricity. The unit is always equipped with a chip card reader so that training programmes can be stored on customer cards without a PC. The particularly small housing leaves enough space for easy access.

The Blueflow Flow Sensor is a revolutionary advancement in spirometry technology, specifically engineered for Geratherm Respiratory systems. Designed to meet the most stringent international criteria for pulmonary testing, the Blueflow sensor combines the high-precision performance of a gold-standard diagnostic tool with the convenience and safety of a fully disposable product. By utilising a pre-calibrated design, the Blueflow sensor ensures that every test delivers first-class results while providing complete security against cross-contamination, making it an essential component for any modern respiratory laboratory.

detail.description: The Spirostik Blue represents the latest advancement in spirometry from Geratherm Respiratory. A powerful and versatile diagnostic tool, it is designed for use across all clinical environments, from busy hospitals to private practices. Whether used for initial diagnosis, follow-up screening, or severity assessment, the Spirostik Blue is essential for the differential diagnosis of obstructive conditions—such as Asthma, COPD, and Emphysema—as well as restrictive diseases, including pulmonary fibrosis and neuromuscular disorders. Clinical Flexibility and Safety The Spirostik Blue is engineered for the modern clinic. It can function as a standalone device or be networked across multiple practices to centralise patient data. At its core is a pre-calibrated, single-use flow sensor designed with extremely low dead space, significantly improving patient safety and comfort. With its revolutionary snap-in handle, changing sensors is quick, easy, and secure, ensuring your clinic maintains the highest standards of hygiene and efficiency.

The Ambistik CPET builds upon the foundation of the standard Ambistik module, providing a specialised solution for the rigorous demands of Cardiopulmonary Exercise Testing. In addition to monitoring temperature, barometric pressure, and humidity, this advanced module features integrated, continuous measurement of ambient CO2 levels. Precision Performance in High-Activity Environments In a clinical or sports science environment, ambient CO2 levels are rarely static. Factors such as multiple people in a testing room or the high ventilatory output of an athlete during maximal exertion can significantly elevate local CO2 concentrations. By feeding real-time CO2 data directly into the BLUE CHERRY® software suite, the Ambistik CPET compensates for these fluctuations instantly. This ensures that gas exchange calculations remain undisputed, protecting the clinician from data misinterpretation and ensuring the highest level of accuracy for every CPET measurement.

Here is the edited copy for your Bronchial Challenge System, maintaining the professional, high-precision, and clinical tone established for your pulmonary diagnostic range. Bronchial Challenge System: Precision and Safety in Provocation Testing This compact, microprocessor-controlled compressor unit is specifically designed to perform standardised bronchial challenge testing with the highest degree of accuracy. Featuring a medically certified, integrated air compressor, the system operates independently of any external air source, making it a versatile and self-contained solution for modern pulmonary laboratories. Automated Workflow and Clinical Compliance The system is engineered to fulfil all international standards for automated pulmonary testing routines. An integrated LCD screen provides the clinician with real-time information and guides the user through predefined test sequences, ensuring high reproducibility and a streamlined workflow. The low-noise operation of the built-in compressor ensures a calm environment, helping to keep the patient relaxed throughout the provocation protocol. Superior Hygiene and Environmental Protection Patient safety and hygiene are at the forefront of this system’s design. It utilises an advanced 3-way valve system that directs patient airflow precisely, preventing the exhaled air from contaminating the side stream nebuliser and the provocation liquid. Additionally, the system features integrated filtration for exhaled air, protecting the clinical environment and ensuring that both the patient and staff can breathe safely without risk of cross-contamination.

The AMEDTEC Mobile ECG is a high-performance 12-lead resting system designed for the rigours of modern clinical environments. Compact enough to fit in a pocket, it features a brilliant display and is engineered for 24/7 availability, providing immediate diagnostic power wherever the patient is located. With its dedicated docking station for rapid charging, the system is always ready for the next shift. Paperless Efficiency and Hospital Integration Designed specifically for the day-to-day requirements of high-traffic hospitals, the AMEDTEC solution is entirely paperless and free from mechanical moving parts. Its smooth, robust exterior is easy to disinfect, ensuring the highest standards of hygiene during mobile use. The device integrates seamlessly with the AMEDTEC ECGpro® data management system, allowing for the direct transfer of patient data and orders from HIS/PACS or practice software, supporting a truly mobile, digital workflow. System Capabilities Automatic Recording: Supports both standardised resting ECGs and longer-duration rhythm traces. 24/7 Readiness: Includes a rapid-charge docking station to ensure the device is always powered for round-the-clock clinical use. Brilliant Visuals: A high-resolution display provides clear, real-time visualisation of all 12 leads for immediate clinical review.

The Spirostik Blue is the latest advancement in spirometry technology from Geratherm Respiratory, providing a powerful diagnostic tool suitable for everything from large hospitals to private clinics. It is a versatile solution for the initial diagnosis, follow-up screening, and severity assessment of a wide range of respiratory diseases. The system is essential for the differential diagnosis of obstructive conditions—such as Asthma, COPD, and Emphysema—as well as restrictive diseases, including Interstitial Lung Disease, pulmonary fibrosis, and neuromuscular disorders. Enhanced Safety and Versatility Designed with modern clinical needs in mind, the Spirostik Blue offers unparalleled flexibility. It can be used as a standalone spirometer or networked across multiple locations to centralise patient results from a group of practices. To ensure the highest standards of hygiene, the system utilises pre-calibrated, single-use flow sensors with extremely low dead space, significantly improving patient safety while eliminating the need for manual calibration.

The Ambistik is a high-precision, USB-based module designed to monitor environmental conditions temperature, barometric pressure, and humidity with total accuracy. This data is continuously fed into the BLUE CHERRY® software suite, enabling the system to perform real-time BTPS (Body Temperature, Pressure, and Saturated) corrections. Why Environmental Accuracy Matters In pulmonary function testing, precision is paramount. Lung function is measured at a constant body temperature of 37°C. As exhaled air cools, its volume decreases; even a small temperature variance of 2°C can result in a 1% deviation in measured results. Furthermore, atmospheric pressure—which fluctuates significantly between sea level and high altitudes—and humidity levels directly impact gas volume and oxygen concentration. Without accurate, real-time correction for these variables, diagnostic data can be compromised. The Ambistik eliminates this risk by providing a continuous stream of ambient data, ensuring every measurement is standardised and clinically valid.

The Ergoselect 12 combines trailblazing functionality with an expressive, ergonomic design to create the definitive stress echo reclining ergometer. Engineered specifically for the high demands of echocardiography, this system provides the perfect patient positioning for clear imaging while maintaining the rigorous performance required for clinical stress testing. Precision Stability and Patient Access Accessibility and stability are the foundations of the Ergoselect 12. The couch features an exceptionally low entry height, allowing elderly or mobility-impaired patients to mount the device conveniently without interference from the ergometry unit or seat. Its robust, heavy-duty construction supports patient weights of up to 200 kg, ensuring a vibration-free environment during testing—a critical factor for acquiring high-quality ultrasound images during peak exertion.

The Ergoselect 10 is a multifunctional, half-reclining ergometer designed to provide maximum safety and stability during stress testing. It is an ideal solution for elderly patients or those with physical limitations, offering a secure alternative to upright exercise. With a reclining surface that adjusts from a horizontal position up to a 45° angle, the system ensures optimal patient positioning for both diagnostic accuracy and comfort. Seamless Conversion and Clinical Efficiency Efficiency is at the core of the Ergoselect 10. Using a simple remote control, clinicians can electronically adjust the inclination and seat position to suit each patient. The device is uniquely versatile: with just a few simple adjustments, the ergometry unit can be folded away and the seat removed, instantly converting the system into a comfortable, high-quality examination couch. This dual-purpose design maximises clinic space without compromising on medical functionality.

By combining sophisticated detection algorithms with a highly intuitive user interface, the system transforms vast amounts of data into actionable diagnostic insights, ensuring that even multi-day recordings are processed with unparalleled speed and accuracy. detail.description: The Tango M2 Stress Test Monitor provides clinicians with the ultimate confidence that patient movement, mechanical vibration, and observer variability will not compromise diagnostic accuracy. Engineered specifically for the high-intensity environment of the stress lab, the Tango M2 automates blood pressure acquisition, allowing your team to maintain their primary focus where it matters most: on the patient. Engineered for Motion and High-Noise Environments Recording reliable blood pressure intervals during exercise is traditionally one of the most difficult tasks in cardiac diagnostics. The Tango M2 overcomes these challenges using our proprietary DKA algorithm, which filters out the noise and motion interference associated with treadmill and ergometer testing. When paired with the specialised Orbit-K™ Cuff, the system delivers exceptional performance, ensuring that precise readings are initiated at the exact moment required for each stage of your stress protocol. Technical Specifications Display: 7-inch High-Resolution Colour LCD. Interface: Automated RS-232 or USB communication with Stress ECG systems. Memory: Internal storage for up to 300 readings. Validation: Specifically optimised for Treadmill, Ergometer, and Pharmacological Stress testing.

detail.description: The ergoscan system represents a sophisticated approach to ambulatory blood pressure monitoring, combining advanced oscillometric technology with durable, clinician-focused design. Engineered for high-traffic medical environments, the ergoscan ensures the acquisition of clean, reliable data while prioritising ease of use for both the patient and the healthcare provider. Precision Technology and Artefact Suppression At the core of the ergoscan is a specialised oscillometric measuring logic that eliminates the need for cumbersome microphones or electrodes. This technology is specifically designed to suppress motion artefacts, ensuring that readings remain accurate even during the patient’s daily activities. The result is a more comfortable patient experience and a significantly more reliable diagnostic dataset for the clinician. Intelligent Workflow and Data Integrity The ergoscan is built for the rigours of daily clinical practice. It features a robust, snap-on metal cuff connector that ensures a secure, leak-proof attachment between the cuff and the recorder. To further enhance data accuracy, the device includes a dedicated day/night button. This allows the patient to manually signal their actual sleep transitions, enabling the software to precisely evaluate diurnally important differences without the need for manual, time-consuming corrections after the test.

The AMEDTEC Holter-RR is a premier solution for 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring (ABPM), designed to deliver highly accurate, meaningful data in a patient-friendly format. Validated to the most stringent international standards, this system provides clinicians with a reliable foundation for the diagnosis and management of hypertension and related cardiovascular conditions. Intelligent Comfort and Clinical Versatility Patient compliance is critical to successful ambulatory monitoring. The Holter-RR utilises Auto Feedback Logic (AFL), an advanced inflation algorithm that ensures quiet, rapid measurements with significantly lower cuff pressure. This adaptive approach, combined with the ability to record for up to 72 hours, makes it an ideal tool for long-term clinical assessment. Furthermore, the system includes integrated threshold tables for children and adolescents, ensuring precise and age-appropriate interpretation across all patient demographics. Diagnostic Specifications Measurement Accuracy: Clinically validated to ESH and BHS (AA) standards. Recording Duration: 24h standard, up to 72h maximum. Inflation Technology: Adaptive Auto Feedback Logic (AFL). Software Hub: AMEDTEC ECGpro® Data Management. Technical Integration Interface: High-speed digital USB for rapid data transfer. Software: Comprehensive Windows®-based evaluation suite. System Connectivity: GDT/HL7 compatible for hospital and office integration.

products.name: Sleepnet Arie Nasal CPAP Mask – FitPack

detail.description: Arie CPAP Nasal Mask The Arie Nasal Mask is designed to sit comfortably on the face without feeling bulky, helping reduce pressure points while maintaining a stable fit throughout the night. The lightweight design allows for flexibility and a clear field of vision, making this a good CPAP mask for side sleepers and active sleepers. Due to the AIR°sil Cushion which adapts to the contours of your face, this mask is easy to use as it ensures minimal air leaks and sits comfortably on your face. Check out the Quick Start Guide in the Downloads tab for extra guidance. Features of the Arie Nasal CPAP Mask AIR°sil Cushion Technology: Built with Sleepnet’s soft medical-grade silicone cushion, AIR°sil technology adapts to your facial contours to create a secure, comfortable seal while helping to minimise air leaks and skin irritation. 360° Rotating Swivel: A fully rotating swivel connection allows the tubing to move freely with you, reducing drag and helping maintain a consistent seal. This makes the Arie Nasal Mask a good option for active sleepers who may change sleeping positions during the night. Clear Field of Vision: The low-profile frame offers an open line of sight, making it easier to read, watch TV, or wear glasses before sleep without removing your mask. Lightweight Frame: The frame is made from lightweight materials to reduce any unnecessary bulk, designed to provide support and structure and sit comfortably on the head. Replaceable Parts: The cushion can be easily removed and replaced, helping maintain hygiene, easy cleaning and ensuring consistent performance over time. Who Is This Mask Suitable For? Nasal breathers Users who prefer a lightweight, minimal-contact mask Active or side sleepers Please note that this mask is not suitable for CPAP users that breathe through their mouth at night, and should consider the Arie Full Face Mask instead.
features: Users who prefer a lightweight, minimal-contact mask

products.name: Sleepnet Arie Full Face CPAP Mask – FitPack

detail.description: Arie Full Face CPAP Mask The Sleepnet Arie Full Face CPAP Mask covers both the nose and mouth, making it suitable for mouth breathers or those with nasal congestion. Alongside the compact and lightweight frame, this mask reduces any unnecessary bulk. The cushion is produced with medical-grade silicone, and Sleepnet’s innovative AIR°sil cushion technology gently adapts to the contours of each face to create a soft, secure seal that minimizes air leaks. Check out the Quick Start guide in the Downloads tab for extra guidance on getting started with this mask. Features of the Arie CPAP Full Face Mask Soft AIR°sil Cushion for Comfort and Fit: The silicone cushion adapts to facial contours to create a comfortable seal while helping to reduce air leaks. Lightweight, Low-Profile Frame: Designed to reduce bulk while maintaining stability, helping improve comfort throughout the night. 360° Swivel for Freedom of Movement: The rotating swivel allows the tubing to move naturally, helping maintain a consistent seal in different sleeping positions. Clear Line of Sight: The design keeps your vision unobstructed, so you can relax before sleep without removing the mask. Easy Maintenance: The removable cushion allows for easy cleaning and replacement, helping to keep your therapy hygienic. Who Is This Mask Suitable For? Mouth breathers Users with nasal congestion Those needing a dependable seal at higher pressures

AirMini user will need an additional universal hose adapter (sold separately above) with the QTube. Please note that QTube will not reduce noise from the machine itself or any whistling noise from the CPAP mask’s exhalation port. It is intended to reduce noise from the tubing and mask. How it works The muffler attaches between your device and the tubing with a short 8-inch flex tube. It then reduces the noise using an internal foam layer that can be removed and replaced. The QTube Muffler contains the muffler and a short tube to connect it to the CPAP machine. Your regular hose then connects to the other end of the muffler. The muffler filter needs to be replaced after two weeks of continuous use (not sold at Intus). IMPORTANT: The CPAP Muffler should not be used with a water-based humidifier, as the filter inside may become saturated. However, most humidifiers act as a muffler anyway, so this would not be required when using one.

detail.description: M1 Mini Filters & Filter Cap Each filter pack contains two replacement fine filters for the M1 Mini Machine . These are disposable filters and can not be washed or reused. Depending on usage and the manufacturer’s recommendations, these filters should be replaced every 2 to 4 weeks. You can set the air filter reminder cycle on the LightTrip app to remind you when to replace your filter. To replace your filter: Slot the filter behind the round filter cap on the side of your device. The filter cap is designed to protect your air filter it is supplied with your device as standard, but should you need to replace the cap or would like a spare, this filter cap is suitable. What does a CPAP filter do? CPAP filters are designed to capture dust, pollen, and other airborne particles, allowing you to breathe in cleaner and healthier air throughout the night. By capturing airborne particles, these filters help reduce the risk of potential blockages. Please note: These filters are designed for the M1 Mini device and are incompatible with other models. If you require a new filter cap cover , you can purchase this separately.

If you use a nasal CPAP mask, then this item will gently stop your mouth from opening while you sleep and ensure you get the most effective Sleep Apnoea therapy. The strap is made from a soft and slightly padded neoprene fabric. Around 40% of CPAP users suffer from mouth leaks. This means their therapy is not as effective as it should be because some of the air pressure is escaping. The affordable strap provides a comfortable way to quickly eradicate that problem. The Universal CPAP Chin Strap from CPAPHero is a One-Size-Fits-All design, made of a stretchy, breathable material and is worn over the head and under the chin. The strap is adjustable, so it can be tightened or loosened to achieve a secure and comfortable fit. Please note that chin straps are designed to complement CPAP therapy. On their own, they do not treat snoring or Sleep Apnoea. Optimises Comfort & Reduce Leaks An affordable way to instantly get a better night’s sleep. detail.description: UVMATIC® Water Trap Effective reduction of bacteria in sinks and wash basins. Water traps are some of the most contaminated areas in hospitals and increasingly recognised as potential vehicles for transmission of multi-drug resistant bacteria to patients. Water used for staff hand washing, hygiene of patients or washing devices is contaminated and then drained through the sinks. If the flow of the water is restricted, biofilm-forming bacteria may form stable reservoirs in the waste pipes and the semi-horizontal drain pipes if they are not inclined enough or are partially blocked. The UVMATIC® Water Trap Disinfector keeps the water in sink waste pipes sanitised, killing bacteria and preventing biofilm formulation. By preventing the spread of multi-resistant bacteria you reduce the risk of HCAI’s which is not only cost efficient, but also safeguards your clinicians and patients’ health. The UVC lamp only uses approximately 12w per hour and will only need changing once a year for continued efficiency. Easy to install and inexpensive to run the DDC UVC Water Trap Disinfector is available to fit all sink and wash basin variations. FIND OUT HOW WE CAN HELP Benefits How do BioFilms Form?

DDC Stainless Steel Furniture Stainless steel furniture is the hallmark of pristine surgical suites, and has raised the bar for what we expect to see in a safe, sanitary and sterile medical environment. But surgical settings are not the only places which need to be kept sterile for patient safety – preventing the spread of dangerous pathogens in potentially unclean environments such as your sluice or dirty utility room is just as vital to the success of any infection control strategy. By equipping your sluice room with stainless steel fixtures and fittings, you can take care of infection control from the ground up. All surfaces in a sluice room must be able to be thoroughly cleaned; or they could harbour bacteria and become the breeding ground for dangerous pathogens. The smooth surfaces and clean welds on stainless steel furniture mean that microbes can find very few places to hide; there are seldom any crevices where germs can become trapped and difficult to remove. Similarly, stainless steel is corrosion-resistant, allowing for strong cleaning agents to be used without risking degrading the metal. detail.description: Footbox Chunc footboxes are designed to support safe, consistent foot positioning within a wheelchair seating system. By maintaining correct foot alignment, they help reduce strain on joints and muscles while supporting a neutral pelvic position — a key foundation for stable and effective seated posture. A footbox is particularly beneficial for users with increased muscle tone, involuntary movements, contractures, or reduced sensation in the lower limbs. By enclosing the feet, it helps prevent them from slipping off the footplates, protects against accidental impacts or friction, and assists in managing uncontrolled leg or foot movements. This added containment supports improved lower limb stability and overall postural control. Optional padding can be added to enhance comfort and pressure management. Padded footboxes help distribute pressure more evenly, reduce muscle fatigue by minimising the effort required to maintain positioning, and lower the risk of pressure-related skin concerns during prolonged use. Footboxes are often considered for users who spend long periods in their wheelchair, have a higher risk of pressure injury, experience spasms or high muscle tone, or require additional postural support for development. They can also provide reassurance for caregivers by helping maintain consistent and protected foot positioning throughout daily activities. Flip-up footbox options are available for users who require greater flexibility. These designs allow easier access for transfers, support foot positioning prior to standing, and enable leg position adjustments throughout the day. This makes them particularly helpful when caregiver access and functional movement are important considerations.

Sunshade and Raincover Designed specifically for Chunc wheelchairs, the sunshade and raincover offers versatile protection for children and adults in any weather. Whether shielding from harsh sunlight or keeping dry in rain, this accessory ensures comfort, safety, and continued participation in outdoor activities. The lightweight, durable design is easy to attach and remove, and its adjustable frame allows a secure fit for different wheelchair models. Transparent panels maintain visibility, while side and rear coverage help protect from wind and rain. Perfect for parents and caregivers, the Chunc sunshade and rain cover enhances user comfort during outdoor activities, excursions, and daily travel. Its practical, easy to use design makes it an essential functional accessory for Chunc wheelchair users.

Under Chassis Equipment Tray For wheelchair users with complex medical and mobility needs, essential life-support equipment must remain safely secured, easily accessible, and stable throughout the day. Under-chassis equipment trays provide a practical and reliable solution by creating dedicated, low-profile storage space beneath the wheelchair frame. These trays are designed to support a wide range of critical equipment, including oxygen cylinders, suction machines, portable ventilators, battery packs, and other medical devices that may need to be used continuously. By keeping equipment securely positioned under the chassis, they help maintain a clean, organised seating environment without compromising comfort or mobility. Under-chassis trays are designed around real-world care requirements, supporting frequent transfers in and out of the wheelchair, carer-led adjustments, indoor and outdoor use, and transport in accessible vehicles. Their integrated design helps ensure equipment remains stable and accessible while supporting long-duration comfort and consistent seating performance. Specifically, under-chassis trays provide a secure sub-frame storage platform that helps keep weight low for improved wheelchair stability. They also protect equipment from accidental knocks and damage, free up rear and side space for carers and additional accessories, and support continuous use without interfering with postural setup or seating alignment. By combining safety, practicality, and accessibility, under-chassis equipment trays help make daily care more manageable for both users and carers while supporting complex mobility and medical requirements.

Oxygen Cylinder Mounts This oxygen cylinder mount has been carefully designed to provide a stable and secure method of holding oxygen cylinders during routine, day-to-day use. Built with durability and reliability in mind, the system reflects a strong focus on quality materials and sound engineering principles, giving clinicians and families confidence in its performance within a static care environment. The mount integrates seamlessly with the Chunc chair range, while its adaptable design means it may also be suitable for use with other wheelchair models. This flexibility allows it to meet a wide range of user needs without compromising on stability or ease of use. Its straightforward attachment and secure hold make it an essential accessory for individuals who require consistent access to oxygen therapy, supporting both independence and comfort. While the system has not been formally crash tested or validated for use in moving vehicles, its design ensures that, when properly installed, the cylinder remains well-supported during normal use. For situations involving transport, it is important that a separate, user-led risk assessment is carried out. Factors such as wheelchair configuration, vehicle type, and additional accessories can all influence safety, and appropriate precautions should always be taken to ensure the cylinder is correctly positioned and fully restrained. Overall, this mount offers a dependable, high-quality solution for safely carrying oxygen in everyday settings—supporting users, families, and clinicians with a practical and adaptable piece of equipment. For a full-time wheelchair user.

Communication Aid Mounting Brackets For communication aids to be truly effective, correct and consistent positioning is essential. Mounting the device to the wheelchair is therefore just as important as the technology itself, ensuring the user can access it reliably throughout the day. Chunc’s communication aid bracket provides a secure and stable mounting solution, keeping the device within the user’s optimal line of sight and reachable range at all times. This supports more immediate access to communication, reducing the need for caregiver assistance with setup or repositioning and enabling greater independence, faster interaction, and more natural conversation. The bracket assembly is height adjustable to accommodate individual postural requirements and user needs, supporting optimal positioning across a range of seating setups. Designed for versatility, it is compatible with a wide variety of communication aids and integrates seamlessly with Chunc wheelchair systems. This solution helps ensure that communication remains consistently accessible, supporting participation, expression, and engagement in daily life. Please note: This product includes the bracket assembly only. Communication devices are not included.

Activity Tray An activity tray is more than a surface for tasks — it acts as a postural, functional, and assistive support system within a wheelchair seating setup. By providing a stable, accessible platform, it helps promote improved posture, upper limb control, and functional independence during a wide range of daily activities. The tray offers secure forearm and hand positioning, supporting comfort and stability for tasks such as eating, writing, using communication aids, and engaging in sensory or educational activities. This helps users maintain a more functional upper body position while carrying out everyday tasks. Designed with practicality in mind, the tray features a durable, easy-clean surface with raised edges to help prevent items from slipping or falling. It can be securely fitted to all Chunc wheelchairs and is designed for quick and easy removal, supporting safe and efficient transfers when required. The activity tray also helps create a structured, contained working area, allowing users to focus visually and physically on the activity in front of them. Essential items such as plates, books, or devices can be positioned within easy reach, supporting consistency and predictability in daily routines. By combining postural support with functional usability, the activity tray enhances independence, safety, and meaningful engagement in everyday activities.

Recline Kit (180°) This configuration provides the highest level of clinical flexibility, combining tilt-in-space with full recline to 180°, enabling transition from seated to a fully supine position. It supports full pressure redistribution and offers enhanced capability for managing complex needs, including high tone and spasticity. The ability to reposition fully within the chair can assist with hygiene care, unplanned events, and situations where reducing transfers is beneficial for both the user and carers. Tilt-in-space continues to provide effective pressure management and postural stability during seated phases, while full recline enables complete body repositioning when required. An important clinical consideration is that postural supports must be readjusted when moving into supine and again when returning to an upright position, as alignment changes significantly through these transitions. Tilt-in-space at 45° underpins postural stability and pressure management, with recline extending capability to full supine positioning—introducing additional clinical considerations that must be managed as part of a complete seating system. Selection of the appropriate configuration should always be guided by an Occupational Therapist or specialist seating assessment to ensure safe and effective clinical outcomes.

Recline Kit (160°) Combining pressure care through tilt-in-space with functional repositioning via recline, this configuration delivers a highly effective and stable seating solution. Recline 160 opens the back angle up to 160°, allowing the user to move into a semi-supine position while keeping all postural supports in place. The backrest moves backwards while the seat remains fixed, opening the hip angle and enabling the user to “lean back” without compromising their established positioning. This differs from tilt-in-space, where the entire seating system tilts as one unit, maintaining all body angles. When used together, tilt and recline provide complementary benefits—tilt supports pressure redistribution and minimises shear, while recline enables controlled changes in posture and hip angle. Reclining helps redistribute pressure away from the pelvis and sitting bones and can support users who experience fatigue in upright sitting. It allows the body to settle where independent postural control is limited, offering rest periods without the need for transfers. This can reduce physical demand on carers and improve tolerance for extended periods of use, including community participation. Tilt-in-space at 45° underpins postural stability and pressure management, with recline adding controlled hip angle adjustment—introducing additional clinical considerations such as shear, which must be managed as part of a complete seating system. Selection of the appropriate configuration should always be guided by an Occupational Therapist or specialist seating assessment to ensure safe and effective clinical outcomes.

Elbow Blockers Chunc elbow blockers are designed to improve upper limb positioning, providing supportive guidance for the arms and elbows to enhance comfort, control, and overall sitting stability. Particularly beneficial for users with reduced muscle control, they help maintain consistent arm placement on the armrests, preventing the arms from slipping off the side or falling behind the seat. By supporting the upper limbs, elbow blockers contribute to improved overall postural alignment and can help reduce slumping during seated activities. This added stability supports a more balanced upper body position, which in turn can enhance functional comfort throughout the day. Elbow blockers also help reduce fatigue by minimising strain on the shoulder and upper back muscles during prolonged sitting. In addition, they help prevent accidental arm movement that could lead to discomfort or injury, particularly during wheelchair movement, transfers, or changes in position. This ensures the arms remain safely positioned and clearly supported at all times. Chunc elbow blockers are available in left and right-handed options, as well as small and large sizes, allowing for tailored positioning to suit individual user needs and seating configurations.

Height Adjustable Arm Support (Pair) Standard or Multiplane Adjustable arm supports provide consistent and reliable forearm support, helping clinicians fine-tune upper limb positioning to improve posture, stability, and comfort throughout the day. With flexible mounting and adjustable positioning, the system supports a wide range of clinical needs and functional goals. Both options help to: Promote midline orientation Reduce compensatory trunk movements Support a more stable and energy-efficient sitting posture Reduce load through the shoulders Improve overall trunk alignment Provide a stable base for functional activities Front or rear mounting options allow the setup to be tailored for both clinical positioning and practical considerations, including safe transfers in and out of the wheelchair. Option 1: Height Adjustable Arm Supports Height adjustable arm supports provide reliable forearm support for users who benefit from improved upper limb positioning but do not require additional containment. Adjustable height and flexible mounting allow precise alignment, helping maintain a supported and symmetrical sitting posture. This option is ideal for: Reduced trunk control Postural asymmetry Fatigue from unsupported arms Functional activity support Option 2: Multiplane Adjustable Arm Supports with Elbow Containment The multiplane adjustable arm supports with elbow containment provide a higher level of positioning and stability for users with limited or no voluntary arm control. Multi-axis adjustability — including height, angle, width, and mounting position — allows highly individualised setup. Integrated elbow containment offers gentle guidance to: Help prevent shoulder subluxation Reduce uncontrolled or involuntary arm movement Support consistent midline orientation Improve overall postural integrity Reduce asymmetrical loading This option is particularly beneficial where muscle tone fluctuates, arm control is limited, or unsupported movement impacts posture or safe

detail.description: Toe Straps Featuring a convenient hook-and-loop fastening system, these straps allow for quick, adjustable, and hassle-free application and removal, ensuring a secure yet comfortable fit. Made from durable nylon fabric, they provide long-lasting performance while maintaining user comfort throughout the day. When selecting the appropriate straps, it’s important to choose a length that allows for easy adjustment, accommodating different footwear styles and ensuring a proper fit at all times. Sold in pairs: 58cm strap length

Ankle Huggers Chunc Ankle Huggers are anatomically contoured to surround the ankle, providing lateral stability while evenly distributing pressure for improved comfort and skin protection. Ankle huggers aid foot positioning and act as an alternative to foot straps. Stabilising the foot and ankle helps improve balance and supports better posture when sitting or moving. Their dynamic, flexible design offers a more comfortable and effective alternative to traditional rigid foot straps. Sold in pairs.

Shoulder Harnessing Chest harnesses are designed to provide additional upper body positioning within a wheelchair seating system. Used as a secondary postural support, they help improve trunk and upper thoracic alignment by offering gentle anterior and posterior stability. This makes them particularly beneficial when pelvic positioning and lateral supports alone are not enough to maintain functional sitting posture. Harnessing should always complement, not replace, a well-configured seating setup. Accurate measurement and correct fitting are essential to achieve effective support, even pressure distribution, and long-term comfort. When properly positioned, the harness should sit securely across the chest without shifting during use, supporting stability while allowing functional movement. A range of harness styles is available to suit different clinical needs. Cross-shoulder harnesses are typically used for higher levels of postural instability, asymmetry, or reduced trunk control. They help promote midline thoracic alignment and reduce asymmetrical collapse, making them suitable for users with significant instability, complex tone patterns, or poor head and trunk dissociation. Narrow front-pull harnesses are suited to users requiring lighter support. These designs offer greater upper limb freedom while helping to resist forward flexion. They are often appropriate for mild to moderate instability or when reminder-style support is sufficient to maintain positioning. Regular review is recommended to ensure the harness continues to provide effective support as needs change. Monitoring fit and positioning helps maintain comfort, minimise the risk of pressure, and ensure the user receives appropriate postural support within their overall seating system.

Lap Belt Designed to help maintain a stable and safe pelvic position in a seated posture. Secured across the pelvis (hips), anchoring chair user into the seat. It is positioned across the bony pelvis and adjusted to provide secure but non-restrictive support. A 2-point system is typically used as the baseline option. Preventing forward sliding in the seat, maintaining general pelvic stability. Supports a neutral seated posture in users with: Good or moderate trunk control Predictable sitting balance Low to moderate postural asymmetry A 4-point system provides additional directional control of the pelvis, using two anterior and two posterior/anchoring points. Best for complex or unstable sitting postures: Actively controls pelvic alignment in multiple planes Help correct or manage asymmetry Reduces pelvic rotation and uneven loading If you would like support identifying the most appropriate option for an individual, or need help reviewing an existing seating setup, please get in touch.

detail.description: Footplates Chunc footplates provide essential lower limb support, creating a stable base that helps promote balanced weight distribution and improved seated posture. Without appropriate foot support, a greater proportion of body weight is transferred to the thighs and ischial tuberosities, increasing the risk of discomfort and pressure-related concerns. Properly adjusted footplates help redistribute load more evenly, reducing pressure on the buttocks and rear thighs during prolonged sitting. In addition to pressure management, footplates play an important role in overall postural stability. By maintaining consistent foot positioning, they help support correct pelvic alignment, which forms the foundation for trunk stability and spinal positioning. This can reduce the likelihood of slouching, forward sliding, and asymmetrical sitting. Footplates also improve safety by preventing the feet from dragging, striking objects, or becoming caught in wheelchair components such as caster wheels. This helps support safer mobility both indoors and outdoors. For optimal positioning, footplates should typically be adjusted to achieve approximately 90° at the hips, knees, and ankles, supporting a neutral and balanced seated posture. Swing-away or elevating options can improve access for transfers, allowing the user to position closer to beds, chairs, or toilets while supporting safer transitions. Chunc footplates are available in a range of configurations, including fixed full-width platforms for consistent support, and independent (split) footplates for users requiring individual leg positioning and adjustability.

Calf Pads Chunc calf pads are designed to enhance lower limb stability, comfort, and safety for wheelchair users. They help maintain correct leg positioning during movement and seating adjustments, including when the seat is tilted or the leg rests are elevated. By supporting the calves, they reduce strain on heel straps and help promote more even pressure distribution across the lower limbs. In addition to improving comfort, calf pads play an important safety role by helping to prevent the feet from slipping off the footrests or becoming caught in wheelchair components. This reduces the risk of injury and supports more secure, confident positioning throughout the day. Calf pads provide both postural support and safety benefits, contributing to improved overall seating stability. For best results, they should be used alongside other foot positioning accessories such as heel loops and footplate padding to ensure balanced support and optimal pressure management.

Seat Cushions The range at a glance: Standard shaped – everyday comfort and protection without correction Contour – guided positioning with improved stability Ischial – focused protection of key pressure points with pelvic stability Enhanced contour – advanced postural support for more complex needs From comfort and protection without correction through to guided positioning with improved stability, and focused protection of key pressure points with pelvic support. Simply use the selector tool to find the most appropriate level of support. An assessment is recommended where there are concerns around prolonged sitting, reduced mobility, or changing postural needs. Preventing pressure ulcers is a key benefit, particularly for people with spinal cord injury, stroke, or reduced sensation. Improving posture and body alignment, appropriate seating can help address issues such as pelvic obliquity, forward sliding, and postural asymmetry, supporting a more balanced sitting position. Enhancing comfort and tolerance of sitting allows longer, more comfortable periods of use, helping support participation in daily activities and reducing the risk of secondary complications associated with poor sitting posture or prolonged pressure.

detail.description: Pommel The Chunc pommel is a clinical positioning aid. Its purpose is to improve lower-limb alignment, enhance postural stability, and support safe, comfortable seated function. It is particularly beneficial for individuals who require assistance maintaining leg alignment and preventing unwanted forward or lateral movement while seated. Positioned between the legs, the pommel helps guide and stabilise the user’s posture, supporting a more secure and functional seating position. This can improve overall comfort, reduce the risk of sliding, and enhance stability during everyday activities. The pommel is available in both fixed and adjustable options, allowing clinicians and caregivers to select the most appropriate setup for each user’s needs. Its padded design ensures comfort during prolonged use, while its durable construction supports consistent performance in daily environments. Designed for seamless compatibility with the Chunc wheelchair range, the pommel integrates easily into existing seating systems, providing a practical and effective solution for improved positioning and support.

Supportive Back Cushion The custom contoured wheelchair back supports provide enhanced postural control straight away. Its shape is designed to closely match the user’s body rather than relying on flat or generic surfaces. This can reduce fatigue, improve sitting tolerance, and enhance functional performance such as head control and upper limb freedom. A key strength of the design is the structured back pan, which provides a stable foundation for further postural refinement. This allows lateral supports to be added with a high degree of flexibility in type, size, depth, and positioning, enabling precise adjustment to suit individual clinical presentations. This modular approach means the system can be progressively configured—from mild support through to complex, multi-point control—helping build a scalable product range that can meet a wide spectrum of client needs. For More Complex Postural Needs For users requiring advanced, multi-point trunk support, the Octoback system offers a fully modular backrest solution with independently adjustable segments to support the pelvis, lumbar, and thoracic regions.

Standard Back Support Chunc’s Standard Back Support Cushion is designed for use with our wheelchair range. Offering reliable postural support for children and adults with varying trunk control needs, this straightforward yet effective cushion helps maintain upright posture, providing stability and comfort throughout daily use. The padded design gently supports the back while distributing pressure evenly to help reduce fatigue and discomfort. Its simple, durable construction makes it easy to position and adjust, supporting consistent setup across different environments. Clinicians and caregivers can select from a range of cushion sizes to achieve the most appropriate fit for each user. By combining comfort and stability, this back support cushion offers a practical and clinically informed solution for everyday postural support. Designed for wheelchair users with more complex postural requirements, this back support also contributes to improved trunk control and alignment. By supporting a neutral pelvic base and encouraging optimal spinal positioning, it can help manage asymmetries such as scoliosis while promoting overall stability. Carefully contoured surfaces and pressure-distributing materials work together to reduce the risk of pressure-related discomfort during prolonged use. Integrated seamlessly with the wider seating setup, the cushion supports functional movement, breathing, and upper body use, contributing to safer and more effective daily positioning.

Lateral Trunk Support Lateral supports provide essential trunk positioning for wheelchair users requiring additional stability and alignment. With adjustments in width, depth, height, and angle, they enable precise set-up to optimise posture, balance, and functional comfort. Multi-angular positioning allows the supports to accommodate complex body shapes and postures, maintaining consistent trunk contact where needed. This makes them suitable for users with asymmetry or evolving postural requirements. The hardware is lightweight yet durable, featuring reversible brackets with dual length options and slotted adjustment points for straightforward installation and fine-tuning. Quick-release and swing-away options allow the supports to be moved or removed easily, supporting safe transfers and flexibility in use. A wide choice of pad shapes, sizes, and cover materials ensures an appropriate fit for each individual. Selecting the correct pad contour and pressure-relieving properties is important to help reduce the risk of skin breakdown, particularly around bony prominences. Available back-mounted (seating shell) or cane-mounted (wheelchair uprights) configurations. The back assembly is engineered for compatibility with a wide range of third-party accessories, facilitating continuity of care. By combining targeted adjustability with supportive stability, lateral trunk supports enhance posture and enable greater comfort and participation in daily activities.

Winged Contour Head Support The Chunc Winged Contour Headrest is specifically designed for seamless integration with our wheelchair range. Offering reliable and comfortable head support for both paediatric and adult users with complex postural needs, its unique winged design gently cradles the head, providing lateral support that helps maintain midline alignment without restricting natural movement. Fully adjustable, this headrest allows clinicians and caregivers to position it precisely to each user’s individual requirements, supporting optimal postural alignment and functional positioning. The padded surface ensures comfort and effective pressure distribution, making it suitable for prolonged use throughout daily activities. By promoting stability, comfort, and improved head positioning, the winged contour headrest enhances overall seating tolerance and supports better postural outcomes. It offers a versatile solution for therapists, caregivers, and prescribers seeking a clinically effective head support system.

Contoured Adjustable Head Support Designed by Chunc specifically for seamless compatibility with our wheelchair range. This contoured headrest delivers effective head and neck support for users with complex postural needs. It is ideal for both paediatric and adult users who require improved head positioning, stability, and comfort in their seating system. The contoured shape gently cradles the head, helping to promote midline alignment while reducing the risk of fatigue, asymmetry, and poor head control. This makes it particularly beneficial for users who need consistent, supportive positioning throughout the day. The adjustability of the headrest allows clinicians and prescribers to achieve precise positioning tailored to each individual. This flexibility supports optimal clinical outcomes while ensuring the user remains comfortable and well supported during everyday activities. A cushioned surface provides effective pressure distribution, enhancing comfort during extended use, while the supportive structure contributes to improved postural stability. As part of the Chunc wheelchair accessory range, this headrest integrates easily with our seating systems, offering a reliable solution for therapists, caregivers, and users alike.

detail.description: --> Overview ClearView ClearView TOTAL Overview Contact Us Maximum Manipulation, Complete Control ClearView® is an innovative, completely disposable, uterine manipulator providing surgeons with optimal visibility and complete uterine control during laparoscopic procedures. ClearView provides 120° anteversion and 90° retroversion as well as lateral movement; for the greatest motion range of any uterine manipulator. The light-weight, balanced-design, allows the ClearView to be moved into position and left, freeing the hands of the surgeon and eliminating the need for an assistant. The 1cm spacer included in the kit adjusts the tip length, effectively changing a 9cm tip to an 8cm tip or a 7cm tip to a 6cm tip. If the spacer is needed to optimize sizing it snaps into place in seconds. Contact Us ClearView Contact Us The ClearView Uterine Manipulator boasts the greatest range of motion of all uterine manipulators. The rotating control handle facilitates one-handed control, enabling the surgeon to manipulate the uterus without breaking the sterile barrier. ClearView has a tip balloon as well a dye-injection port for effective chromotubation. The kit contains; 1-Clearview, 1-1cm spacer for tip length adjustment, 1-10ml syringe to inflate the tip balloon, 1-disposable sound dilator to ensure adequate dilation. Contact Us ClearView TOTAL Contact Us The ClearView TOTAL has the same great features as the ClearView with the addition of a pre-attached occluder balloon as well as three different sizes of colpotomy cups, conveniently packaged in a sterile inner tray which can be removed and placed aside until use. The colpotomy cups were designed for improved visibility during insertion and are colored for easy identification when making the colpotomy incision. The occluder balloon serves as a seal, preventing the loss of the pneumoperitoneum once the colpotomy incision has been made. It is filled with 60-120ml of sterile saline using the included 50ml syringe. Contact Us Request

--> Overview OMNICUP OMNI-MT Overview Contact Us A Complete Vacuum Delivery System to Assist in Fetal Delivery The Kiwi Complete Vacuum Delivery System is designed to give control back to the physician. Whatever your preference or needs are, the Kiwi family of products offers a vacuum to meet them. Contact Us OMNICUP Contact Us The OmniCup is the most versatile of the Kiwi vacuums. Its flexible-stem and low profile cup enable placement over the flexion point of the baby’s head no matter the fetal head position. This is vital in order to realign the head so that the smallest diameters of the fetal head are presented to the birth canal. When the OmniCup is properly placed and traction is exerted in-line with the pelvic axis, malpositions of the fetal head can be corrected. Contact Us OMNI-MT Contact Us The Omni-MT has the same great features as the OmniCup with the addition of the Traction Force Indicator. The Traction Force Indicator is designed to measure the force exerted during traction. This allows the operator to correlate tactile sensation of traction force with a visual scale, helping to reduce “pop-offs” and especially valuable for training purposes Contact Us Vacuums, Forceps and Birth: What every parent should know about Assisted Deliveries – Podcast with Dr. Tori O’Daniel Curious about assisted deliveries? In this episode of The Pulling Curls Podcast, Hilary Erickson, The Pregnancy Nurse®, sits down with Dr. Tori O’Daniel, a board-certified OB GYN, to demystify vacuum and forceps deliveries. They explain when and why these tools might be used, how they work, the differences between them, and what you can expect if your delivery needs a little extra help. They also bust some common myths and share real-life experiences (including Hilary’s own forceps story), plus get honest about risks, benefits, and postpartum recovery tips. Whether you’re prepping for birth or just want to be informed, this episode has all you need to feel more confident about your option

Infection Control - Advanced Medical Solutions Advanced Medical Solutions Infection Control Contact Us Antimicrobial wound dressings play an important role in managing infected wounds by helping to prevent and control bacterial growth. Infected wounds are a serious concern as they can delay healing, increase the risk of complications, and lead to systemic infection. 1 Antimicrobial dressings contain agents such as silver, PHMB or CHG, which have antimicrobial properties and can help to reduce the number of bacteria in the wound bed. These agents work by disrupting the cell membrane of bacteria or by interfering with bacterial replication. 1 In addition to their antimicrobial properties, some types of wound dressings also provide a moist environment that can promote wound healing. For example, foam, fibre or hydrogel dressings can help maintain a moist environment optimal for cell growth and tissue repair. AMS’ range of antimicrobial wound dressings are an important tool in the management of infected wounds, and can help prevent and control bacterial growth, promote healing and reduce the risk of complications. Exudate Management - Advanced Medical Solutions Advanced Medical Solutions Exudate Management Contact Us Exudate management is an essential aspect of chronic wound care. Exudate is the fluid that is present in a wound, and it contains a variety of substances, including blood plasma, white blood cells, nutrients and waste products. Excessive exudate can impair wound healing and increase the risk of infection; insufficient exudate can lead to dehydration of the wound bed and interfere with the formation of new tissue. 1 There are various methods for managing exudate in chronic wounds, and the choice of method will depend on the wound type, location and severity, as well as the patient’s overall health status. 1 Effective exudate management is essential for promoting wound healing and preventing complications in chronic wounds. General Features The CRYO-LINE medical device is designed for use in ophthalmic surgery by qualified personnel. More specifically, the surgical procedures where the device can be used are listed below: • Retinal detachment • Glaucoma • Cataract CRYO-LINE operates according to the physical law of the Joule-Thomson effect to freeze the tip of the probe and reach freezing temperatures of approximately -60°C. The gases used must be medical-grade, hyperdry Nitrous oxide (N2O) or Carbon dioxide (CO2), at saturated vapor pressure (approx. 60 bar) and room temperature. The gases must be stored in non-siphon cylinders. The CRYO-LINE device consists of a control console fitted with a high-pressure hose and inlet filter for connection to a gas cylinder, and a foot pedal. The console is equipped with a connector for attaching a hose, which allows the exhaust gas to be channeled and released outside the operating theater if N2O is used. A Bariatric Solution Built on the Same Parts Platform The Circulo Bari serve users up to 350kg, using the same antimicrobial polymer frame as the standard Circulo . For loan stores, that means bariatric provision without a having another inventory to manage. Standard loan store chairs commonly stop at 160kg, leaving providers to resort to on-the-spot bariatric purchases as needs arise, with higher costs and delays. The Circulo Bari removes that entirely, giving providers a stocked, ready-to-issue bariatric chair with the same parts structure as the rest of the range. Multi-Motor Positioning for More Complex Needs The Bari’s multi-motor frame gives multiple positioning options, including dual motor tilt-in-space and zero gravity positioning, as well rise-only and single motor options. This allows providers match to match user’s clinical needs within the same product range. Built for Delivery and Collection Retractable wheels are standard on the Bari, making delivery and collection more straightforward for a chair of this size. Combined with the detachable backrest, the Bari is designed for single-handed delivery. The Same Hygiene and Durability at Bariatric Scale Like the rest of the Circulo range, the Bari uses an antimicrobial polymer frame with no wood, and pressure-relieving upholstery (Waterlow medium rating) in the seat, backrest and arms. The seat wrap lifts off in one piece for washing, and damaged parts can be swapped out individually rather than requiring a full chair repair/replacement. Who this is for: Explore community seating support for councils and OT teams .

A Smarter Approach to Community Seating The Circulo range was developed from the ground up to meet the needs of community equipment services, where equipment must withstand frequent cleaning, transportation and re-issue. By combining the construction of our HiBack range with the adjustability of the Lento, the Circulo delivers a highly durable seating solution that reduces maintenance requirements while supporting a broad range of users. The result is a chair range that can meet the needs of high turnover community loan stores, while maintaining comfort, performance and reliability. What makes the Circulo chair special? Designed for High-Turnover Environments Every aspect of the Circulo has been developed with operational efficiency in mind. Unlike traditional chairs that rely on fabric-covered frames, the Circulo uses hard-wearing propolymer that is anti-bacterial throughout with wipe-clean surfaces. This allows chairs to be cleaned quickly between users using clinical cleaning products, reducing turnaround times and infection control costs. The detachable backrest makes transportation easy, helping equipment providers reduce delivery and collection costs. Modular by Design The Circulo range has been engineered to be as maintenance-free as possible, with removeable armrests and panels and a small number of interchangeable accessories, reducing parts stockholding and repair callouts. For equipment loan stores this has multiple benefits, including: Simplified maintenance Reduced spare parts inventory Faster repairs Lower lifetime ownership costs Minimal equipment downtime Adjustable for Individual Needs No two users are the same, which is why Circulo incorporates a range of built-in adjustments. Height-adjustable armrests help support effective posture and positioning, while width adjustment enables the chair to accommodate different body shapes and requirements. detail.description: Home Products Eent EliteVue Macro Otoscope EliteVue Macro Otoscope Please note: Some products have been discontinued and may now be available under different item numbers. For further assistance, please feel free to contact us. The EliteVue Macro Otoscope is our top of the line, premium otoscope option. The otoscope has 5x magnification and a wheel to adjust focal depth, a specula ejection feature and your choice of battery power. Charging and battery options include, C cell alkaline batteries, a USB plug in charger with Lithium Ion batteries or a desk top charging base for use with Lithium Ion batteries. The C cell size handles are sturdy and robust. The collar on the handle has a +/- to turn the otoscope on, as well as brighten or dim to your liking. The otoscope also comes equipped with an auto shut off feature after 180 seconds to preserve battery and bulb life. EliteVue offers a 5x magnification and a field diameter of 11 mm at a distance of about 20 mm. Twice the field of view provides a complete view of the auditory canal and tympanic membrane and eliminates the need for panning the otoscope, supporting a more efficient diagnosis. detail.description: HemoCue ® HealthTrender to fight global anemia epidemic HemoCue® HealthTrender is currently commercialized in India and is pending approval and/or decision in other regions. Anemia is a public health problem that affects over 2 billion people globally. Failure to reduce anemia worldwide consigns millions of women to impaired health and reduced quality of life. For generations of children it means impaired development and learning, which leads to communities and nations loosing productivity as well as development. Today, there are numerous programs spending billions of USD to fight anemia in developing countries. detail.description: [vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text] Product Advantages PuraBond = No Preparation Surgeons may have to wait for haemostats to be assembled or prepared during a procedure, whilst having to manage the bleeding area. This can be time critical and costly as the procedure is prolonged. PuraBond is delivered in a prefilled syringe, just connect the applicator using the luer-lock and the product is ready to use. It does not require any preparation before or during surgery, allowing surgeons to quickly manage bleeding and continue with the procedure. PuraBond* has been demonstrated to achieve complete haemostasis in less than 15 seconds. 1 *PuraBond is part of the RADA16 family of products. The peptides self-assemble to form a 3-dimensional matrix upon a change in pH2 caused by exposure to an ionic solution such as blood, peritoneal fluid or other bodily secretions. Applying PuraBond is simple PuraBond is a haemostat existing of a nanofiber network structure that requires no preparation. This means it is ready to apply straight from packet to patient. To apply PuraBond is just as easy, simply deploy PuraBond at the base of the lesion and wait, following the instructions below: Remove as much blood as possible from haemorrhagic site. Apply an adequate quantity of PuraBond to the haemorrhagic site. The nozzle should be as close as possible to the bleeding point.
