ZOLL’s CPR-D-Padz features a one-piece design with real CPR help feedback and includes a CPR face shield. Ordinary AED’s require that the rescuer use two separate electrodes. By using CPR hand placement as the landmark, it is easy to place the CPR-D-Padz on the victim quickly. The CPR-D-Padz also last five years- the longest shelf life of any defibrillator electrode sold today. Real CPR Help Inadequate compression rate and depth are common during CPR. Adult victims need at least 100 compressions per minute and at a depth of at least 2 inches. Compressions must be done well to effectively move blood and oxygen. The Zoll AED Plus converts compression data instantaneously from the CPR-D-Padz and provides and adaptive metronome to help the rescuer with the proper rate ad depth, saying push “push harder” or “good compressions” as needed. It also shows CPR compression depth on the display screen. ZOLL’s AED Plus is the only AED that helps the rescuer achieve the correct rate and depth of chest compressions during CPR. Hema-T Combat Arterial Tourniquet 30-80 cm single device Each Hema-T comes with a yellow time sticker to document the moment of application — a critical step in emergency bleeding management. The tourniquet can remain in place for up to two hours. If evacuation requires a longer duration, the Hema-T can be temporarily rolled down while manual pressure is applied to the wound, and then reapplied after 10 minutes. Placement is straightforward: Upper limb: No need to remove clothing — apply over the sleeve. Lower limb: The shoe must be removed, but trousers can remain in place. The Hema-T is not a sterile device but is suitable for emergency first aid and pre-hospital care.

OTIOM – Monitoring Device for People With Dementia – For Private Homes

detail.description: Otiom is a unique, discrete tagging monitoring device which dementia patients/family members can easily carry, Otiom utilises rapidly growing Internet of Things (IoT) technology ensuring safe, reliable tracking indoors and out whilst increasing battery life way beyond other monitoring devices, cost effectively. Furthermore, the Otiom-app makes it simple to clearly define safe zones, which are areas where the person with dementia is allowed access to without being monitored and any immediate concern. Otiom comprises of: The Otiom-tag Monitoring device for persons with dementia. Can be carried around in a pocket, on a safety strap, sewn into clothing or mounted on a cane or walking frame. Battery life: Up to one month! Otiom Home Base The small wireless Home Bases must be placed in the apartment of the person with dementia as well as in common areas. The Home Bases communicate with the Otiom-tags and keep the tags in power-save mode while the residents are in the nursing home. Battery life: 3-4 years. Otiom-app For caregivers or relatives. Available for iOS and Android. As described above, the two main areas the Otiom device is designed for are private residences and care homes. Moreover; The Otiom can be managed using a smartphone and a safety zone can be set outside the personal home or care facility, including surrounding gardens or community areas. If the person with dementia leaves the safety zone, an alarm will be triggered and the Otiom-app will show the current location, allowing you to quickly attend to them and ensure safety is maintained.

High Quality Sharps Bin A high quality larger container for the safe disposal of sharps and clinical waste. The container is designed for frequent use in any healthcare setting where the need for safe disposal of large size sharps or equipment is required. The Container has dual lids offering a choice of size of aperture with temporary and final closure. It also has built in carrying handles and is fully compliant with BS.EN.ISO 23907 and UN 3291 Once permanently closed the lid provides a full hermetic seal by the means of an adhesive built into the two lids. The container has a very stable footprint and although normally positioned on the floor could be position at desk level depending on use.

The control panel of my ClearView C video magnifier is not responding. What can I do? Have you had the ClearView C video magnifier for a few years? The batteries of the control panel may then be empty. Read below to find out how to replace the batteries. Another possibility is that the control panel must be reconnected to the video magnifier. Follow the instructions to re-pair the console. Replace the batteries To replace the batteries, open the battery compartment on the side of the control panel. Depending on the model, a screw may need to be removed. Place two new button cell batteries (type CR2025) in the compartment. Close the box and the control panel is ready for use again. The control panel needs to be reconnected. Pairing the control panel Turn the ClearView C off and on again by pressing the power button on the left side of the metal cabinet behind the monitor above the cable connections;
Hold the control panel vertically, with the back against the right side of the metal cabinet;
An icon will appear on the screen to indicate that the linking process starts;
Press the on/off button (orange button on the control panel) and the overview function button (blue button) simultaneously for five seconds;
If the pairing process was successful, the pairing icon will disappear from the screen.
The batteries are empty: read Replacing the batteries;
The wrong buttons to start the pairing process have been pressed;

The control panel is defective: Please contact the Support department: 0800 1456115 or ordersuk@optelec.co.uk . The control panel will be replaced. If you receive a new console, you will need to re-pair it with your ClearView C (See: Pairing the console.).

How do I change between Easy and Advanced mode on my Compact 10 HD When the Compact 10 HD is switched on, a short press of the orange On / Off button will place the unit into standby mode. A short press of the orange On / Off button again will resume the Compact 10 HD operation in the mode in which it was put into standby. When resuming from standby, the Compact 10 HD will take approximately 1 second before an image displays on screen. When the Compact 10 HD is in standby mode, the unit can also resume by opening unfolding the Compact 10 HD. Closing the stand will automatically put it back into standby mode. The Compact 10 HD can automatically go into standby mode if no button is pressed or no movement is detected. Pressing the orange on / off button will switch it back on. The standby time can be changed or disabled in the Compact 10 HD menu. To power off the Compact 10 HD completely, press and hold the orange on / off button for three seconds. It will then make an audible chime to confirm power off. To switch on the Compact 10 HD back on, or for the first time, press and hold the orange button for three seconds again. When switching on the Compact 10 HD, it will take approximately 25 seconds before an image displays on screen.

How do I enter the user menu on my Compact 10 HD The Compact 10 HD will need to be set in Advanced in order to enter the menu. To open the menu, tap on the screen then tap on the “Menu” icon at the top left corner of the screen. The exact items in the menu will vary, depending on if you own the Compact 10 HD or 10 HD Speech. To activate a button, tap the button once. Activating a button will open a new menu screen or list. To go back to the main menu, tap on the “Back bar”. To adjust the slider, tap and hold the slider button while moving it to the right or left. The main menu contains the following options: · Voice (Compact 10 HD Speech only) · Line On/Off · Battery status · Save · Open · Brightness slider · Settings

Why is my battery not lasting very long? It is important to turn your Compact 10 HD off correctly when you are not using it. Pressing the power button once, puts the machine into standby mode. This will still deplete the battery, however at a very slow rate. We recommend turning the Compact 10 HD off properly in-between uses, this is done by holding the power button for 5 seconds until an audible bleep is heard.

What do the LED’s mean? Battery LED Descriptions Green – Solid: Battery charged – power adapter connected. Green – Flashing: Battery charging – power adapter connected. Red – Flashing: Battery low. Red – Solid: Error – unplug power adapter, wait a few seconds, and plug in again. If this condition persists, change the batteries. No LED: Battery charge ok, power adapter not connected; or RUBY is off.

Opening and Using the Reading Stand RUBY XL HD also incorporates a reading stand so that it can be set on a document allowing you to read an item at a convenient and consistent distance. On the top edge of the unit, use one thumb to push the ridge (1) in one direction while using your other thumb to push one of the tabs (2a or 2b) in the opposite direction. The unit is spring loaded and opens to its full reading position. If the unit is off, it automatically turns on when the reading stand opens. Next, place the unit on a flat item, such as a document or photo, to view and read it. When you close the reading stand, the unit automatically turns off.

My Ruby turns itself off when I’m reading. What can I do about it? This is normal behaviour. If no button has been pressed for 30 minutes, the RUBY will switch itself off to prevent the batteries from draining.

When reading with the RUBY I suffer from glare on the paper. Can anything be done about that? The glare on glossy paper is probably caused by the RUBY’s LED lights. You can turn the LED lights on and off by pressing the Green/Yellow button together with the Red button.

How do I change between Easy and Advanced mode on my Compact 10 HD When the Compact 10 HD is switched on, a short press of the orange On / Off button will place the unit into standby mode. A short press of the orange On / Off button again will resume the Compact 10 HD operation in the mode in which it was put into standby. When resuming from standby, the Compact 10 HD will take approximately 1 second before an image displays on screen. When the Compact 10 HD is in standby mode, the unit can also resume by opening unfolding the Compact 10 HD. Closing the stand will automatically put it back into standby mode. The Compact 10 HD can automatically go into standby mode if no button is pressed or no movement is detected. Pressing the orange on / off button will switch it back on. The standby time can be changed or disabled in the Compact 10 HD menu. To power off the Compact 10 HD completely, press and hold the orange on / off button for three seconds. It will then make an audible chime to confirm power off. To switch on the Compact 10 HD back on, or for the first time, press and hold the orange button for three seconds again. When switching on the Compact 10 HD, it will take approximately 25 seconds before an image displays on screen.

products.name: Coussins de positionnement du nouveau-né et du nourisson

detail.description: Sécurité de l’enfant Nettoyage et désinfection simples Résistance au temps et aux utilisations régulières Sécurité et prévention posturale Les coussins microbilles Carewaves by médipréma protègent le nouveau-né des lésions cutanées grâce à sa fonction anti-escarre. Ils limitent les risques de déformations ostéo-articulaires et les rétractations musculaires en positionnant les membres du bébé dans un axe adapté. Composé de mocrobilles en polystyrène, les coussins de positionnement ultra flexibles calent le bébé sans le compresser. Confort et liberté de mouvement Les produits médipréma diminuent les douleurs et le stress du nouveau-né, améliorant ainsi son état clinique général. En permettant les mouvements volontaires et en restraignant les réflexes primaires, ils favorisent le développement moteur. Les coussins facilitent également les soins quotidiens du personnel hospitalier et le contact avec l’entourage du bébé. Deux modèles sont disponibles Le coussin demi-lune Le coussin demi-lune permet de placer facilement et rapidement l’enfant dans un axe alignant la tête, la colonne vertébrale et les jambes. Le risque de bras en chandelier et la position de grenouille écrasée sont écartés. En décubitus latéral, ventral ou dorsal, l’enfant est maintenu en toute sécurité. Le coussin flexitube Le flexitube offre une grande liberté d’utilisation en permettant de modeler le coussin selon les cas et besoins médicaux. Il peut également entourer le bébé et ainsi reproduire le cocon maternel. Egalement disponible Housse de protection en maille jersey lavable : Maille jersey coton open end 100% Elastique et confortable Masse au m² : 130gr -10/+5g Résistance à la rupture : 75% dans le sens de la chaîne / 130% dans le sens de la trame Allongement sous 5 daN : 40% dans le sens de la chaîne / 85% dans le sens de la trame Coloris blanc Nettoyage : supporte un entretien classique à 60° – séchage en machine à 60°

Nettoyage : supporte un entretien classique à 60° – séchage en machine à 60°

Précis, il permet de délivrer un mélange air/oxygène sur une large gamme de débits allant de 0 à 30L/min. Le temps de réponse est très rapide (environ 15s). Un écran à cristaux liquides assure une bonne visibilité des paramètres et affiche directement la mesure de la concentration en oxygène relevée. products.name: Housse isotherme pour incubateur de transport Nite

detail.description: Confort et sécurité pour le nouveau-né A sa naissance, un bébé doit totalement apprendre à gérer sa température corporelle. C’est une période de transition particulièrement critique pour les bébés nés prématurément. Particulièrement vigilant au confort et la sécurité de l’enfant pendant les transferts hospitaliers, Médipréma a développé une housse isolante pour le transport. La housse isotherme prévue pour l’incubateur de transport Nite permet d’en augmenter les performances en l’isolant du froid et de la lumière environnante qui sont des sources d’agression pour le nouveau-né. Une fenêtre en face avant et sur le dessus permet de garder la visibilité sur l’enfant pendant le transport. Les 4 côtés peuvent être relevés indépendamment pour mieux voir l’enfant sans découvrir totalement l’incubateur. La fermeture est bien hermétique par 4 bandes velcro sur les côtés et l’ouverture facilitée en cas d’intervention urgente. La housse isotherme assure un confort supplémentaire au nouveau-né dans l’incubateur Nite, et rassure le personnel soignant soucieux des amplitudes thermiques pendant le transport.

Confort et maintient du nouveau-né En alliant le confort du matelas à mémoire de forme aux propriétés immobilisantes des microbilles, le matelas Carewave by médipréma apporte une solution aux problématiques de sécurité et de confort du nouveau-né pendant le transport. Le matelas à mémoire de forme en mousse visco-élastique assure une réelle empreinte du corps de l’enfant. Son confort moelleux atténue l’inconfort lié aux secousses pendant le transport. Le garnissage en microbilles garantit le maintien du nouveau-né. Mieux contenu, il se sent plus en sécurité et donc moins agité pendant le transport. Optimisé dans ses dimensions pour une utilisation en incubateur de transport Nite de médipréma, le matelas mousse et microbilles spécial transport se pose directement sur le matelas et permet d’accueillir le nouveau-né dans des conditions de confort idéales. Le matelas mousse et microbilles Carewave by médipréma dédié au transport peut être rattaché au plan de couchage à l’aide de sangles Magic Strips. Cette bande en micro-fibre souple, très douce au toucher et auto-agrippante se place et se retire très facilement. Le matelas mousse et microbilles Carewave by médipréma est léger et facile à mettre en place. Il se retire tout aussi facilement permettant ainsi de positionner rapidement le nouveau-né sur un plan dur si une intervention technique est nécessaire. Sa housse en polyuréthane bi-élastique est adaptée au contact cutané et se nettoie très facilement par lingettes désinfectante.

products.name: Solution de maintien du nouveau-né 10G CosySecure

detail.description: HOMOLOGATION 10G Ce système, testé et validé par crash-test 10G, garantit un maintien optimal de l’enfant pendant le transport d’urgence interhospitalier. SÉCURITÉ DU NOUVEAU-NÉ Le matelas de transport CosySecure est constitué de microbilles en polystyrène qui s’agglomèrent sous l’effet du vide. La dépression rigidifie le matelas et crée ainsi un cocon sécurisé adapté au corps de l’enfant. Pour une sécurité maximale, un bandeau de fixation permet de maintenir la tête de l’enfant. SURVEILLANCE ET ACCÈS À L’ENFANT Le matelas de transport CosySecure possède des découpes latérales qui facilient l’accès au corps de l’enfant pendant le transport. Les équipes médicales peuvent surveiller l’état du patient et assurer le maintien des mesures thérapeutiques. Pour des situations d’urgence nécessitant un accès rapide à l’enfant, les ceintures de sécurité sont déverrouillables rapidement par simple pression. CONFORT DU NOUVEAU-NÉ Le matelas de transport est renforcé de coussinets en mousse pour un meilleur confort du nouveau-né. Médipréma recommande l’usage de draps non-tissés à usage unique pour améliorer le confort thermique de l’enfant tout en protégeant sa peau. INSTALLATION Le matelas à dépression est fixé sur le plateau de l’incubateur Nite par des sangles ajustables.

products.name: Médirunner, le chariot de transfert interne

detail.description: Design épuré adapté au milieu hospitalier Format compact, peu encombrant Nettoyage et désinfection facilité Le chariot Médirunner, compatible avec l’incubateur de transport Nite, est destiné aux transferts internes. Un transfert rapide et sécurisé La maniabilité du chariot a été particulièrement étudiée pour faciliter le transfert et assurer un transport sécurisé du nouveau-né. La conception du chariot avec une poignée sur toute la largeur et des roulettes multidirectionnelles, offre une bonne prise en main et permet plus de souplesse dans les manœuvres. L’incubateur est fixé par 2 plots qui le maintiennent stable pendant les transferts. Tous les équipements additionnels sont positionnés pour assurer un monitorage optimal : le personnel soignant garde en permanence la visibilité sur le nouveau-né et l’accès aux fonctionnalités des dispositifs médicaux embarqués. Flexibilité d’équipement Le chariot Médirunner est livré avec des rangements optimisés : 2 grands casiers qui peuvent être remplacés par 2 tiroirs, 1 support pour 2 bouteilles et un conduit de passage pour les tuyaux et flexibles. Un bloc de 8 prise IEC protégées est intégré pour alimenter les dispositifs médicaux lors du transfert. Il est possible de personnaliser la configuration de base du chariot en ajoutant des dispositifs additionnels nécessaires au transport médicalisé du nouveau-né. Design épuré adapté au milieu hospitalier L’équipe R&D Médipréma a conçu le chariot Médirunner pour qu’il s’adapte au mieux à l’environnement hospitalier : Grâce à son format compact, le chariot est peu encombrant dans les couloirs. Les matériaux ont été soigneusement sélectionnés pour répondre aux attentes hospitalières en termes de nettoyage et de désinfection. Parce qu’il évolue essentiellement dans les services néonatalogie, des personnages ludiques décoratifs ont été ajoutés pour s’intégrer à l’univers enfantin des jeunes patients.

Flexibilité d’équipement Le chariot Médirunner est livré avec des rangements optimisés : 2 grands casiers qui peuvent être remplacés par 2 tiroirs, 1 support pour 2 bouteilles et un conduit de passage pour les tuyaux et flexibles. Un bloc de 8 prise IEC protégées est intégré pour alimenter les dispositifs médicaux lors du transfert. Il est possible de personnaliser la configuration de base du chariot en ajoutant des dispositifs additionnels nécessaires au transport médicalisé du nouveau-né. Design épuré adapté au milieu hospitalier L’équipe R&D Médipréma a conçu le chariot Médirunner pour qu’il s’adapte au mieux à l’environnement hospitalier : Grâce à son format compact, le chariot est peu encombrant dans les couloirs. Les matériaux ont été soigneusement sélectionnés pour répondre aux attentes hospitalières en termes de nettoyage et de désinfection. Parce qu’il évolue essentiellement dans les services néonatalogie, des personnages ludiques décoratifs ont été ajoutés pour s’intégrer à l’univers enfantin des jeunes patients.

detail.description: Une technologie de réchauffement unique La structure de transport Nite de médipréma dispose d’un véritable chauffage par voûte radiante, intégré à l’habitacle de l’incubateur, assurant un transfert de chaleur immédiat vers le nouveau-né. L’isolation thermique a été travaillée pour protéger l’enfant des perturbations de l’environnement et des ouvertures de portes nombreuses pendant le transport. Ce système de chauffage, efficace en toutes circonstances, permet d’intervenir sur le nouveau-né portes ouvertes sans compromettre son réchauffement. La montée en température est très rapide (20min de 25°C à 36°C température de commande 37°C) garantissant ainsi un réchauffement rapide du nouveau-né. La présence d’un capteur de mesure de la température de l’air dans l’habitacle associé aux sondes de mesure de la température de la voûte permet de moduler parfaitement le chauffage qui fonctionne en toute sécurité quelles que soient les conditions environnementales. Une ergonomie pensée pour faciliter le travail des équipes médicales Tout comme les autres incubateurs médipréma, l’habitacle de la structure de transport Nite a été conçu pour garantir une accessibilité totale à l’enfant. Équipé de 2 grandes portes avec hublots en face avant et arrière, d’une trappe côté pieds et d’une porte double battant côté tête, il offre une accessibilité totale à l’enfant par les 4 côtés de l’incubateur. Il permet également une visibilité parfaite de l’enfant sur 5 faces grâce à son habitacle en plexiglas transparent. L’incubateur de transport Nite de médipréma est équipé d’un écran d’affichage à cristaux liquides tactile et intuitif (avec possibilité de sélectionner différentes langues de travail) qui permet une bonne visualisation, avec zoom, des courbes de température en temps réel (monitorage) et de leur historique. Une solution fiable sans compromettre le confort de l’enfant L’incubateur Nite de médipréma a été pensé pour améliorer les conditions de transport du nouveau-né. Le plan de couc

Sécurité Minuterie de programmation du temps d’exposition : arrêt automatique Touche pause pour suspendre le traitement en cas de besoin Coupure automatique de la source lumineuse si débranchement accidentel du connecteur fibre optique du boitier Housse de protection usage unique : matière sélectionnée de manière à filtrer au minimum la lumière de traitement tout en étant agréable au toucher et adaptée au contact cutané Une thérapie de contact permettant un traitement efficace tout en favorisant la proximité entre la mère et l’enfant La natte de photothérapie B’bloo de médipréma permet un traitement de l’ictère efficace tout en étant souple d’utilisation . La lumière de traitement est conduite à l’enfant via une natte de fibres optiques permettant ainsi une thérapie de contact simple et efficace (l’enfant repose directement sur la source de lumière). La natte en fibre optique a été étudiée pour obtenir une homogénéité parfaite du flux lumineux sur l’ensemble de la natte. La source de lumière à LEDs bleues sélectionnées par médipréma permet une intensité lumineuse >3.3mW/cm². Deux réglages d’intensité sont possibles (pleine puissance ou 50%). Un dispositif adaptable à toutes les situations La natte de photothérapie B’Bloo de médipréma est facilement transportable grâce à son boîtier muni d’une poignée pour faciliter sa manipulation. La natte B’bloo est adaptée aux différents environnements d’utilisation : en incubateur, sur table radiante, en berceau, dans les bras d’un parent ou d’un soignant. Elle peut s’utiliser conjointement à d’autres appareils de photothérapie de type capot de photothérapie Leddy bloo permettant ainsi d’augmenter l’intensité du traitement.

Sécurité de l’enfant Monitorage de la température cutanée avec alarmes haute et basse Plan de couchage composé de quatre écrans de protection Le lit chauffant Calibed est une solution intégrée conçue pour apporter au nouveau-né le confort et la chaleur dont il a besoin . Composé de polyuréthane, le matelas gel anti-escarres , diffuse une chaleur constante et uniforme . Un ciel de lit, proposé en option, permet d’ isoler l’enfant des pertubations de l’environnement . La rampe chauffante Ambia de Médipréma est montée sur un berceau de soins ce qui facilite les soins et offre un grand confort au nouveau-né et au personnel soignant. Un système de réchauffement fiable et sécurisé Les rampes Ambia proposent un véritable mode air de 20 à 39°C avec des capteurs de température qui prennent en considération les variations de l’environnement pour asservir automatiquement la puissance du chauffage et indiquer la température (en °C) au niveau de l’enfant. Il suffit de simplement de saisir la température souhaitée et les sondes de température ambiante et radiante régulent automatiquement le rayonnement de l’élément chauffant pour compenser les variations de température d’une pièce à l’autre. Enveloppé d’une chaleur douce et homogène, l’enfant bénéficie d’un environnement optimal, pour la meilleure qualité de soin. Elles disposent également d’un mode cutané de 35 à 38°C (avec accès sécurisé au-delà de 37°C) qui permet de surveiller en permanence la température cutanée du nouveau-né. Le chauffage radiant par émetteur quartz, permet de concilier réactivité et qualité du réchauffement. L’analyseur d’oxygène intégré (sonde en option) dispose d’une échelle de mesure allant de 0 à 100%, avec seuils bas et haut réglables de 20 à 99%. Les rampes sont également équipées d’une minuterie APGAR avec double « bip » qui retentit à 1, 3, 5 et 10 minutes. Un système de réchauffement fiable et sécurisé Les rampes Ambia proposent un véritable mode air de 20 à 39°C avec des capteurs de température qui prennent en considération les variations de l’environnement pour asservir automatiquement la puissance du chauffage et indiquer la température (en °C) au niveau de l’enfant. Il suffit de simplement de saisir la température souhaitée et les sondes de température ambiante et radiante régulent automatiquement le rayonnement de l’élément chauffant pour compenser les variations de température d’une pièce à l’autre. Enveloppé d’une chaleur douce et homogène, l’enfant bénéficie d’un environnement optimal, pour la meilleure qualité de soin. Elles disposent également d’un mode cutané de 35 à 38°C (avec accès sécurisé au-delà de 37°C) qui permet de surveiller en permanence la température cutanée du nouveau-né. Le chauffage radiant par émetteur quartz, permet de concilier réactivité et qualité du réchauffement. Polyvalence et modularité S’utilise aussi bien comme incubateur ouvert ou table de réanimation Grande souplesse d’équipements et d’accessoires : insufflateur semi-automatique, mélangeur air/O², pédale de vide… Hauteur variable avec grande souplesse de débattement Hautement sécurisé pour le nouveau-né Ecrans de protection pour un véritable cocon sécuritaire autour de l’enfant Eléments facilement accessibles pour la désinfection (ex : écrans de protection rabattables et démontables) Surfaces lisses et planes pour un nettoyage optimal et rapide et la prévention des risques d’infection Médipréma a mis en œuvre tout son savoir-faire pour développer un incubateur radiant répondant aux exigences techniques et ergonomiques du personnel soignant. A la fois table de réanimation et incubateur ouvert, l’incubateur Fabie offre une chaleur douce et stable aux nouveau-nés grâce à un chauffage radiant par émetteur quartz. Pour ce faire, médipréma a développé un véritable mode air (exprimé en degrés Celsius), à l’identique des incubateurs fermés qui tient compte des variations de l’environnement pour asservir automatiquement la puissance du chauffage et indiquer la température (en °C) au niveau de l’enfant. Pratique et fonctionnel, l’incubateur radiant médipréma permet à l’équipe médicale de traiter les nouveau-nés dans les meilleures conditions. L’apport thermique requis est toujours assuré, sans perturbation par des alarmes intempestives. Ses écrans de protection ergonomiques facilitent l’accès à l’enfant et de nombreux orifices de passage de drains et de tuyaux sont intégrés pour faciliter les soins.

Facilité d’entretien et d’hygiène Chaque élément facilement accessible pour la désinfection Compatible avec un nettoyage vapeur / autoclave L’incubateur fermé Satis 3552 a été conçu pour une utilisation en services de néonatalité et de maternité . Un incubateur fiable et robuste L’incubateur fermé 3552 de médipréma est un incubateur robuste, fiable et facile d’utilisation . Grâce à son habitacle en plexiglas transparent, il offre une visibilité parfaite de l’enfant sur 5 faces et un accès au bébé facilité grâce à deux grandes portes à ouverture latérale avec hublot sur la face avant, deux hublots sur la face arrière ainsi qu’une porte double vantaux côté tête. Une version hauteur variable de l’incubateur est également disponible en option pour faciliter le travail de l’équipe médicale. Un système de thermorégulation fiable et facile d’utilisation L’incubateur fermé Satis 3552 de médipréma dispose d’un système de thermorégulation fiable avec deux modes de régulation de la température : air et cutané . Médipréma a conçu un système de ventilation unique pieds-tête (et non frontal) qui dirige l’air chaud le long des parois de l’habitacle assurant ainsi le maintien de la température requise à l’intérieur. Il favorise également un accès sécurisé à l’enfant lors de l’ouverture des portes sans risque de brûlure.

Une ergonomie avancée optimisée pour les soins L’habitacle de l’incubateur Satis + de médipréma a été pensé pour que le personnel soignant puisse accéder facilement à l’enfant grâce à ses deux grandes portes abattantes avec hublots et une porte double ventaux côtés tête et pieds. Les nombreuses ouvertures présentes sur l’habitacle permettent d’optimiser les soins apportés à l’enfant ( 11 orifices pour faciliter le passage des capteurs et tuyaux ). Le plateau sortant (tournant en option) est idéal pour accéder sans effort à la tête de l’enfant favorisant ainsi les soins précis et délicats . D’autre part, l’habitacle en plexiglas transparent assure une visibilité parfaite de l’enfant sur 5 faces. L’incubateur est muni de nombreux espaces de rangements et il est disponible en version hauteur variable pour optimiser la position de travail des équipes médicales. Un système de thermorégulation et d’humidification fiable et intuitif sans compromettre le confort de l’enfant L’incubateur fermé Satis + de médipréma dispose d’un système de thermorégulation précis , fiable et intuitif avec cinq modes de régulation de la température . On retrouve les modes de régulation air et cutané , présents sur tous les incubateurs médipréma auxquels s’ajoutent le mode Arrêt chauffage qui permet l’arrêt de la régulation thermo-hygrométrique de l’incubateur tout en maintenant le renouvellement de l’air dans l’habitacle (le monitorage de la température cutanée de l’enfant reste possible), le mode jumeaux adapté à la surveillance simultanée de deux nouveau-nés via deux sondes cutanées et le mode tendresse qui sécurise les séances de peau-à-peau. Médipréma a conçu un système de ventilation unique pieds-tête (et non frontal) qui dirige l’air chaud le long des parois de l’habitacle assurant ainsi le maintien de la température requise à l’intérieur. Il favorise également un accès sécurisé à l’enfant lors de l’ouverture des portes sans risque de brûlure. L’incubateur de réanimation néonatale Satis +

detail.description: Indications for Use This advanced bone cement is indicated for the treatment of pathological fractures due to: Osteoporosis – including vertebral compression fractures and sacral insufficiency fractures Cancer – such as multiple myeloma, metastatic breast or lung cancer, and lymphoma Benign lesions – including hemangioma and giant cell tumour The FDA has also cleared KYPHON® Xpede™ Bone Cement for the fixation of sacral fractures using vertebroplasty or sacroplasty, expanding its role in minimally invasive fracture management. This makes it one of the few bone cements clinically supported for use in both vertebral and sacral applications. Composition and Handling The cement is provided as a two-component system , ensuring precise formulation and consistent performance: Powder component: PMMA copolymer, barium sulfate (radiopacifier for clear imaging), benzoyl peroxide (initiator) Liquid component: methylmethacrylate monomer, hydroquinone (stabiliser), N,N-dimethyl-p-toluidine (promoter) When combined, the cement forms a high-viscosity, radiopaque material that is “quick to dough”, making it straightforward for clinicians to prepare and inject. Supplied with its own mixer, it supports efficient workflow in theatre while maintaining sufficient working time for careful placement. Clinical Evidence and Benefits KYPHON® Xpede™ Bone Cement has demonstrated effectiveness in clinical studies. A multicentre retrospective study of 243 patients with osteoporotic sacral insufficiency fractures treated with sacroplasty reported significant and immediate pain relief that was maintained after one year. The procedure showed a low complication rate, with only one patient (0.4%) experiencing symptomatic leakage requiring intervention. No major complications or procedure-related deaths were reported. 2 When used in combination with the Kyphon™ Cement Delivery System , radiation exposure to the operator can be reduced by up to 70%, as the system enables clinicians to stand further away

detail.description: Kyphon VuE™ Bone Cement brings clarity, control, and confidence to vertebral augmentation procedures. Used in conjunction with the Kyphon V™ Premium Vertebroplasty Platform , this quick-to-dough, high-viscosity polymethyl-methacrylate (PMMA) formulation contains augmented barium particles that markedly enhance fluoroscopic visibility, enabling clinicians to monitor cement flow in real time and tailor injection strategy to individual vertebral anatomy. Indicated for cementoplasty procedures such as balloon kyphoplasty, vertebroplasty, and sacroplasty, Kyphon VuE™ is specifically intended to stabilise pathological fractures caused by osteoporosis, cancer, or benign lesions. Its handling characteristics mirror those of Kyphon Xpede™ cement, preserving familiar preparation steps while adding a new level of visual feedback. Precise, high-viscosity delivery supports confident control, helping to limit extravasation and maintain procedural efficiency. Cadaveric and bench investigations confirmed superior flow recognition, a lower rate of leakage, and functional performance comparable to existing Medtronic formulations.¹-⁴ These attributes translate into predictable behaviour in the operating theatre and added assurance for both surgeon and patient, strengthening the clinical toolkit for the management of painful compression fractures. By combining reliable mechanical strength with enhanced radiopacity, the formulation allows surgeons to visualise every millimetre of cement progression, optimise vertebral filling, and restore spinal stability with confidence, all while maintaining the procedural speed and workflow to which they are accustomed each day. Based on internal data ETR 31101322, Kyphon VuE™ comparison to Kyphon Xpede™ cadaveric testing, 12 levels. 2021. Based on internal data ETR 31101320, Kyphon VuE™ bone cement sawbones bench testing, 20 samples. 2021. Based on internal data ETR 30101174-R, Kyphon VuE™ sacroplasty cadaveric testing, 20 procedures. 2021. Based on

For painful bone tumours The OsteoCool TM RF Ablation System is cooled radiofrequency (RF) ablation technology. It offers simultaneous, dual-probe capabilities for treating painful bone tumours. Product Details The OsteoCool RF Ablation system is cooled radiofrequency (RF) ablation technology. It offers simultaneous, dual-probe capabilities for treating painful bone tumours. Coaxial, bipolar technology delivers RF energy to the site, and automatically moderates power to keep RF heating within the desired treatment range. This reduces risk of potential thermal damage to adjacent tissue. 1 The active tip of the ablation probe is internally cooled with circulating water. RF energy heats the tissue while circulating water moderates the temperature close to the active tip. This combination: Creates large volume lesions without excessive heating at the active tip Minimises potential for char The OsteoCool RF ablation probes are sterile and intended for single use. Minimally Invasive Vertebral Compression Fracture (VCF) Treatment With over 20 years of commitment to procedural options and clinical evidence, Medtronic’s balloon kyphoplasty empowers you to treat VCF patients with the unmatched innovations of a reliable, robust product platform. Treating VCF with Balloon Kyphoplasty Balloon kyphoplasty uses orthopedic balloons to restore vertebral height and correct angular deformity from VCF due to osteoporosis, cancer, or benign lesions. After reduction, the balloons are deflated and removed. The resulting cavity allows for a controlled deposition of bone cement to form an internal cast and stabilize the fracture. Key Features of the Kyphon™ Balloon Kyphoplasty Platform 700 psi max rated inflation pressure, higher than previous 400 psi rated balloons.* Cement resistance technique lets you deliver cement through one cannula while the contralateral balloon remains inflated to maintain fracture reduction. Kyphon™ cement delivery system (CDS) lets you deliver cement from up to 48 inches away from the radiation source during a kyphoplasty procedure. Supercritical CO2 Sterilisation All of our frozen tendons are sterilised using the ‘Supercritical CO2 Sterilisation Process’. This technique makes use of supercritical fluid technology to cleanse and sterilise the allograft tissues which balances the pressure and temperature of SCCO2, simultaneously extracting blood and lipids from the allograft while terminally sterilising the tissue in its final packaging. This complex procedure ensures that contamination during handling is eliminated – providing an allograft with a Sterility Assurance Level (SAL) of 10-6.

Orthoblast II is a powerful choice of bone grafting and it is what is termed a “complete” bone graft, offering both conductivity and inductivity to the user Surgeon. It is available as a Putty in a tub where the conductive bone graft granules mixed in with the DBM Putty are larger given the method of delivery. This is a crunchy graft when handled by the Surgeon. The other method of delivery with this product is via a syringe, where the conductive granules are slightly smaller simply because they need to go through the tip of the syringe. This is no less a complete bone graft however, it is simply another method of delivery for the Surgeon, and contains demineralized bone matrix (DBM) to stimulate and regenerate new bone growth. Allograft bone is an ideal alternative to autograft for quick, complete bone regeneration. Cancellous chips and granules form the Osteoconductive scaffold for new bone formation while maintaining the porosity essential for tissue and vascular regrowth. Cancellous Bone packs well into any size or shape defect, for maximum surgical flexibility and is available for immediate use with no refrigeration or thawing required. Potential complications of iliac crest bone harvesting, such as morbidity, limited supply, and pain, make Cancellous bone an ideal autograft substitute which has been obtained from an AATB-Accredited Tissue Bank, ensuring the highest quality bone through rigorous donor screening, testing and sterilisation. In many cases, cancellous bone is preferable to cortical bone due to its higher surface area and open porous structure that allows for easy cellular penetration and incorporation and is a perfect compliment to IsoTis’ Accell® product line, and can be used as a bone graft extender or for composite grafting. We supply Allograft Cancellous Bone in a variety of sizes which can be purchased in chip or crushed formation – please see the tab below for further information. We use a guaranteed 24 hour delivery service for this product. The Jazz™ systems (which includes the Jazz™ Claw Connector) are temporary spinal implants specifically designed to provide a bone anchor for temporary stabilisation during the development of solid bony fusion to assist with the repair of bone fractures. The Jazz™ systems can be used for a number of spinal surgeries: Spinal trauma surgery Spinal reconstructive surgery Spinal degenerative surgery Also the Jazz™ Systems can be used in conjunction with other medical implants which are made of titanium alloy or Cobalt-chromium-molybdenum alloy and will work in coherence whenever wiring is used to help secure the attachment of other implants. The Jazz™ Claw System (hooks and rods) and the Jazz™ Frame System are designed to be used together in order to stabilise and immobilise spinal segments which assist with the fusion of the thoracic, lumbar and sacral spine. detail.description: TENOLIG Tenolig is a percutaneous implant for acute Achilles tendon tears. TENOLIG Tenolig is a percutaneous implant for acute Achilles tendon tears. Concept Three main techniques are used to repair ruptured Achilles tendons. PERCUTANEOUS This technique consists of passing two sutures with preloaded needles into which small harpoons are embedded. The entry points are about 6 cm proximal to the tear on the posterolateral side of the tendon. The exit points are on the posterolateral side of the tendon over the retromalleolar space, 4 to 5 cm below the tear. The surgeon passes the two needles percutaneously proximal to distal, through the ruptured tendon. The harpoons attach themselves into the upper portion of the tendon. The sutures are pulled downwards to bring the two ruptured tendon ends together, and then locked with polyethylene discs against the skin. The sutures can be removed by the surgeon after about 6 weeks. The percutaneous technique is based on four principles. Bringing the two ruptured Achilles tendon ends together for 6 weeks without using a surgical incision. During this time, the entire tendon can be mobilised through flexion/extension movements of the foot. Not dev

Concept When it was introduced in 2003, the ARROW shoulder system was one of the first universal systems for shoulder arthroplasty. It allows surgeons to implant a reverse or anatomical prosthesis with the same set of instruments . The universal stem can be used with and without cement for hemiarthroplasty, total anatomical (4-peg cemented glenoid base or cementless metal-back base) or reverse shoulder arthroplasty. The instrumentation set consists of four instrument baskets. Depending on the patient’s needs, the surgeon may have to revise the prosthesis. Concept When it was introduced in 2003, the ARROW shoulder system was one of the first universal systems for shoulder arthroplasty. It allows surgeons to implant a reverse or anatomical prosthesis with the same set of instruments . The evolution to ARROW II has enabled less invasive and more precise glenoid preparation using orientation guides. The universal stem can be used with and without cement for hemiarthroplasty, total anatomical (4-peg cemented glenoid base or cementless metal-back base) or reverse shoulder arthroplasty. The instrumentation set consists of three instrument baskets. Depending on the patient’s needs, the surgeon may have to revise the prosthesis. The surgeon can keep the current humeral stem and then: convert a hemiarthroplasty into a reverse shoulder or, convert a total shoulder into a reverse shoulder. detail.description: The AFOS down draught anatomy trolley provides a convenient unit for dissection procedures in a prosectarium. The body tray is fully interchangeable with an AFOS body store. It has a ventilated top with easily removable fluid catch tank and extraction port, and a hydraulic lifting mechanism with height adjustment to aid fluid drainage.

The AFOS Rotating Dissection Table is a space saving option allowing students of anatomy to rotate the cadavers for dissection. With complete open-bench working, the trolley allows easy access from either side.

The AFOS Ventilated Necropsy Table provides the opportunity to extract at the working position thereby providing maximum safety. Designed for dissection to operate via dedicated air extraction system and if required may have an integral sink bowl fitted to the end of the table. Containment of hazardous fumes is achieved by pulling air through the work surface of the table, where the clinical dissection procedure is undertaken.

The AFOS Ventilated Perfusion Table provides a safe and efficient workstation for blood sample and testing procedures. The unit incorporates a filtration system to remove airborne pathogens and fumes to provide a clean breathing space for the clinician.

The AFOS Ventilated Surgery Table provides uncompromising protection during surgical procedures, with an optional filtration or extract system to atmosphere pathogens and fumes. A mobile, recirculating unit is available with various options such as Corian work tray and integrated heated pad.

The AFOS Ventilated Staining Table is specifically designed to control exposure to xylene, formalin etc during the preparation of special stains. The staining trough incorporates a low flow water bath, making cleaning simple. Chemical recovery options are available.

The AFOS Ventilated Specimen Store provides a safe and controlled method of storing and transporting sample tissue in the laboratory. The store is available with adjustable shelves or a mobile rack system.

The Schiötz Tonometer offers a wide array of advantages for evaluating patients at risk of glaucoma. Its principal use is to provide an accurate calculation of the eye’s IOP. For this purpose, the instrument features a V-shaped mount with a scale that measures the corneal surface’s depth. In addition, the device includes a pointer/lever system that marks the scale between 0 and 20. The specialist analyses the resulting number with a conversion table to get the exact IOP. Moreover, the Schiötz Tonometer includes a plunger system with three different weights to calibrate the scale. The weight range of these pieces varies from 5.5 to 10.0 grams. Also, the operator can easily slide the weights into the assembly pin using a V-shaped keyway. Additionally, the instrument has a curved footplate at its bottom, which follows the contour of the cornea. As a result, the specialist can place the device on the eye without risk of trauma. Desempeña la esencial función de garantizar un medio eficiente para manipular los Clips de Raney . De tal modo, el instrumento cuenta con mandíbulas de superficies semicirculares que se adaptan a los clips. Como resultado, el cirujano puede ubicar el clip en la abertura y presionar sobre el cuero cabelludo para fijarlo. Al contrario, los bordes planos sirven para abrir los clips cómoda y atraumáticamente. Nuestra Pinza para Aplicar Clips de Raney también exhibe una cremallera para realizar sujeciones estáticas. Esta, a su vez, posee una hilera de dientes intercalados que permiten aplicar diferentes niveles de presión. Fabricado en acero inoxidable de primera calidad, que otorga una larga vida útil al instrumento.

La Pinza para Duramadre ofrece un amplio abanico de beneficios operatorios. Cumple la importante función de sujetar delicadamente la duramadre intracraneal. Para este fin, el instrumento posee mandíbulas con diseño angulado para abordar la membrana desde diversas posiciones. Asimismo, sus superficies dentadas garantizan firmeza, y sus puntas romas evitan lesiones a los tejidos circundantes. Nuestra Pinza para Duramadre ostenta también mangos curveados que se ajustan al contorno de la mano. Asimismo, ambas ramas convergen en una caja de traba, cuya tecnología evita distorsiones de las mandíbulas a largo plazo. Fabricado en acero inoxidable de excelente calidad con un acabado mate que evita reflejos de luz.

The Olivecrona-Toennis Clip Applying Forcep offers a wide array of surgical advantages. Its principal use is to provide an efficient method for placing vascular clips and control hemostasis. For this purpose, the instrument features alligator style, small jaws that easily bend the vascular clips around blood vessels. This allows surgeons to occlude the blood flow and dissect aneurysms, as well as to perform anastomosis procedures. Moreover, the Olivecrona-Toennis Clip Applying Forcep features ergonomically designed finger rings. As a result, surgeons obtain enhanced gripping and minimize finger strain. Manufactured in premium grade stainless steel to ensure the highest quality instruments in your operating rooms.

The Mckenzie Clip Applying Forcep offers a wide array of advantages in neurosurgery. Its principal use is to help in controlling hemostasis by offering the most efficient way to apply Mckenzie Clips . For this purpose, the instrument features slightly curved, slotted jaws that can hold the clips with enhanced precision. After that, surgeons can bend the clip around the desired blood vessel to occlude its lumen and prevent haemorrhage. Moreover, the Mckenzie Clip Applying Forcep features ergonomically designed finger rings that ensure optimal gripping. Furthermore, the ring handle prevents slippage and its attached to a spring mechanism, which offers smooth closure movements. Manufactured in premium grade stainless steel with a fine satin finish that reduces glare.

products.name: Raney Clip Applying and Removing Forcep

detail.description: The Raney Clip Applying and Removing Forcep offers a broad range of benefits during surgery. Its principal use is to provide the most efficient way of manipulating the Raney Scalp Clips . For this purpose, the instrument features jaws with semicircular inner surfaces, which are ideal to fit the Raney Scalp Clips . Surgeons can place the clips within the jaws and press the handle for placing or removing a clip with ease. Moreover, the Raney Clip Applying and Removing Forcep features ergonomically designed finger ringers. As a result, surgeons can manipulate the device with comfort and prevent slippage. The ratchet system is useful to lock the jaws at the desired width. Manufactured in premium grade stainless steel with a fine satin finish that reduces glare.

The Dura Strip Dissecting Forcep offers a wide assortment of benefits. Its principal use is to permit delicate gripping of the intracranial dura and other thin membranes, with the purpose of dissecting them. To this end, the instrument features angled jaws that allow for optimal surgical approaches. In addition, the jaws’ opposing surfaces have thin horizontal serrations that help in minimizing local damage. Moreover, the Dura Strip Dissecting Forcep features a plier grip style handle that promotes exceptional gripping. As a result, surgeons prevent slippage and fatigue during lengthy procedures. Manufactured in premium grade stainless steel to ensure the highest quality and product performance during surgical procedures.

El Punzón Craneal ofrece ventajas excepcionales en craneotomías y otros procedimientos. Desempeña la importante función de eliminar porciones circulares de hueso sin lesionar los tejidos adyacentes. Para este fin, el instrumento posee una cabeza en forma de C que encaja perfectamente en el hueso. Asimismo, el pin movible en el espacio hueco ejerce la fuerza necesaria contra el hueso para cortarlo. Nuestro Punzón Craneal posee un par de mangos ergonómicos que se ajustan con comodidad a la palma del cirujano. Además, el sistema de pivote entre los mangos ayuda a controlar la presión ejercida sobre el hueso. Fabricado en acero inoxidable de alta calidad, fácil de esterilizar, con un acabado mate que reduce los destellos de luz.

La Pinza Sacabocados de DeVilbiss ofrece beneficios indispensables en cirugías intracraneales. Desempeña la importante función de cortar superficies óseas sin dañar sus tejidos subyacentes. Para este fin, el instrumento cuenta con una punta de gancho que se desliza dentro de una ranura. Como resultado, este diseño garantiza cortes rectos y lineales al tiempo que evita las fracturas por corte. Asimismo, un pin anexo a la cabeza del dispositivo permite variar el ángulo de corte. Nuestra Pinza Sacabocados de DeVilbiss también exhibe mangos curvados y estriados que se ajustan a la mano. Además, el mecanismo de pivote entre los mangos ofrece movimientos suaves al momento de cortar el hueso. Fabricado en acero inoxidable de primera calidad, que otorga una larga vida útil al instrumento.

La Pinza Gubia de Dahlgren ofrece un rango amplio de ventajas quirúrgicas. Su función principal consiste en eliminar porciones delicadas de hueso de la superficie craneal. Para este fin, el instrumento presenta una punta de gancho que garantiza cortes precisos y lineales. Además, la punta se ensambla con un pin que permite modificar el ángulo de corte. Nuestra Pinza Gubia de Dahlgren ostenta mangos estriados y ergonómicos que se adaptan a la mano cómodamente. Además, un sistema de pivote entre los mangos suaviza los movimientos de apertura y cierre. Fabricado en acero inoxidable de excelente calidad con un acabado mate que evita reflejos de luz.

La Pinza Gubia de Bacon ofrece beneficios indispensables en diversas cirugías que involucran el cráneo. Desempeña la importante función de brindar acceso a la cavidad craneal eliminando piezas de hueso. Para este fin, el instrumento cuenta con mandíbulas resistentes, cóncavas y de bordes afilados. Como resultado, su diseño es ideal para cortar y brindar resistencia al hueso. Aparte, el perfil angulado de las mandíbulas garantiza abordajes quirúrgicos precisos y atraumáticos. Nuestra Pinza Gubia de Bacon también ostenta mangos delgados cuyas curvaturas se adaptan a la palma. Aparte, la caja de traba que une a las mandíbulas previene la distorsión de las ramas. Fabricado en acero inoxidable de excelente calidad con un acabado mate que evita reflejos de luz.

La Pinza-Guía de Adson ofrece beneficios indispensables en procedimientos de craneotomía. Su función principal consiste en conducir en la dirección deseada para realizar orificios. De tal modo, el instrumento cuenta con mandíbulas de ángulo doble que facilitan el abordaje del cráneo. Aparte, posee orificios que facilitan el cómodo paso del perforador. Sus superficies internas y dentadas permiten sujetar tejidos al tiempo que se atraviesa una estructura. Nuestra Pinza-Guía de Adson exhibe también una cremallera entre los mangos para sujeciones estáticas. Asimismo, la caja de traba que une las mandíbulas evita la distorsión a largo plazo del instrumento. Fabricado en acero inoxidable de alta calidad, fácil de esterilizar, con un acabado mate que reduce los destellos de luz.

La Pinza para Tracción Craneal ofrece una gama variada de ventajas operatorias. Su función principal radica en brindar un soporte eficiente al cráneo en cirugías de fractura o dislocación cervical. Para lograrlo, el instrumento posee dos brazos curvados y unidos en la base, ideales para seguir el contorno craneal. Asimismo, cada brazo exhibe en su punta un pin de fijación para insertar en el hueso parietal. Nuestra Pinza para Tracción Craneal también ostenta una base de fijación para unir a la mesa de operaciones. Esto, a su vez, garantiza una sujeción completamente estática del cráneo. Fabricado en acero inoxidable de excelente calidad con un acabado mate que evita reflejos de luz.

The Cone Cranial Punch offers a broad range of surgical advantages. Its principal use is to provide a secure way to punch holes without damaging the intracranial tissues. For this purpose, the instrument features a C-shaped tip that easily accommodates to the desired skull bone. In addition, the upper blade of the tip is moveable, which permits surgeons to push it against the lower pin and create the hole. Moreover, the Cone Cranial Punch features a plier grip style handle that enhances gripping and minimizes the risk of slippage. Furthermore, the riveted joint helps to slide down the upper blade with a smooth movement. Manufactured in premium grade stainless steel to ensure the highest quality instruments in your operating rooms.

The De Vilbiss Cranial Rongeur offers a wide array of surgical advantages. Its principal use is to provide an efficient method for cutting the skull bones without damaging local or underlying tissues. For this purpose, the instrument features a hook-shaped tip that slides within a slot, thereby ensuring atraumatic cuts. In addition, an adjustable pin attached to the hook permits to modify the hook’s angle to perform different approaches. Moreover, the De Vilbiss Cranial Rongeur features a plier grip style handle with horizontal ridges. This ergonomic design allows for optimal control of the instrument while minimizing the risk of slippage. Furthermore, one of the handle’s stems has a dorsal thumb horn for resting the finger. Manufactured in premium grade stainless steel with a fine satin finish that reduces glare.

The Dahlgren Cranial Rongeur offers a wide array of benefits. Its principal use is to debulk the desired skull bone during neurosurgical procedures that require intracranial access. For this purpose, the instrument features a hook-shaped tip that ensures precise and linear bone cuts. In addition, the tip attaches to an adjustable pin, which allows surgeons to manipulate the hook’s angle for engaging in multiple approaches. Moreover, the Dahlgren Cranial Rongeur features a plier grip style handle with horizontal ridges. As a result, surgeons obtain an exceptional grip that prevents finger strain during lengthy procedures. Also, one of the handle’s stems has a thumb horn for avoiding slippage. Manufactured in premium grade stainless steel to ensure the highest quality and product performance during surgical procedures.

The Bacon Cranial Rongeur offers a wide array of surgical advantages. Its principal use is to permit an efficient way of scooping out small pieces of skull bone to access the brain. For this purpose, the instrument features scoop-shaped, sharp-edged jaws, which ensure atraumatic bone gouging. In addition, the jaws have an angled design that allows for exceptional surgical approaches. Moreover, the Bacon Cranial Rongeur features a plier grip style handle, which promotes an excellent gripping. Also, the handle includes a double spring system, which permits smooth closure movements and prevents fatigue. Manufactured in premium grade stainless steel with a fine satin finish that reduces glare.

products.name: Adson Drill Guide and Dura Protector

detail.description: The Adson Drill Guide and Dura Protector offers a wide range of benefits. Its principal use is to provide an efficient way to navigate the drill in the desired direction and to grasp tissues if necessary. For this purpose, the instrument comes with a pair of angled, fenestrated jaws that allow surgeons to pass the drill. In addition, the internal surfaces of the jaws have serrations for grasping tissues without trauma. Moreover, the Adson Drill Guide and Dura Protector features a ratchet system for locking the jaws at certain widths. Furthermore, the finger rings provide exceptional gripping, which helps in avoiding fatigue and slippage. Manufactured in premium grade stainless steel to ensure the highest quality and product performance during surgical procedures.

The Skull Traction Tongs offers a wide array of benefits. Its principal use is to provide reliable support to the head during cervical fracture or dislocation surgery. For this purpose, the instrument features two curved arms attached at the base, forming a U-shaped profile. In addition, the arms include point holders at the tips for traversing the parietal bones and fixating the skull. Moreover, the Skull Traction Tongs features a fixation base that surgeons can attach to the operating table. Also, the screw-lock mechanism helps in closing the arms at the desired width. Manufactured in premium grade stainless steel to ensure the highest quality instruments in your operating rooms.

products.name: Guía para Sierra de Alambre de DeMartel

detail.description: La Guía para Sierra de Alambre de DeMartel es un instrumento de asistencia requerido en ciertas craneotomías. Desempeña la importante función de sujetar la Sierra de Gigli por un anillo y conducirla a través de orificios craneales. Para este fin, el instrumento cuenta con un diseño aerodinámico para atravesar canales estrechos. Además, su diseño maleable y plano permite curvar el instrumento como sea necesario para pasar la sierra de alambre. Nuestra Guía para Sierra de Alambre de DeMartel ostenta una punta diseñada para sujetar el anillo de la sierra. De tal modo, esta característica asegura un agarre firme y evita el desprendimiento accidental del anillo. Fabricado en acero inoxidable de primera calidad, que otorga una larga vida útil al instrumento.

The De Martel Wire Saw Guide offers a wide array of surgical benefits. Its principal use is to hold the wire saw by a ring and navigate it through the skull’s holes efficiently. For this purpose, the instrument features a slim design for easily traversing the small holes. In addition, its malleable and flat design allows surgeons to curve the device as necessary. Moreover, the tip of the De Martel Wire Saw Guide features a projection to hold the ring with comfort. This particular feature avoids instrument slippage during craniotomy procedures. Manufactured in premium grade stainless steel to ensure the highest quality and product performance during surgical procedures.

products.name: Infinex Maestro Diethrich-Salyer Cleft Palate Scissor

detail.description: The Surtex® Infinex Maestro Diethrich-Salyer Cleft Palate Scissor is a specialized instrument used for sharp dissection and cutting of difficult to reach tissues. It is commonly used in surgeries of the soft and hard palate to precisely access and dissect the tissues in the roof of the mouth.

The Surtex® Satinsky Thoracic Scissor is an S-shaped scissor that contorts to the dissection plane, increase accuracy and ease of access. Commonly used in cardio-thoracic surgeries for blunt dissection and cutting of delicate tissues.

The Surtex® Debakey Arteriotomy Scissor is used for dissecting delicate internal tissues and blood vessels. The special design of the instrument makes it an ideal candidate for creating and enlarging incisions during arteriotomies and general surgery.

The Surtex® Potts Dissecting Scissor is a specialized dissecting scissor used for sharp dissection through delicate and fibrous tissues alike. Commonly used for dissecting through adhesions and cutting through facial planes in general and cardio thoracic surgery.

The Surtex® Jameson-Werber Dissecting Scissor is a specialized instrument used for dissecting delicate internal tissues. It is especially crafted to access the deep tissues for accurate dissection during surgeries.

The Surtex® Jameson SuperEdge™ Dissecting Scissor is a specialized instrument used for blunt dissection and cutting of delicate internal tissue. It is commonly used in surgeries requiring high degree of precision including vascular grafting and cosmetic procedures.

The Surtex® Jameson Dissecting Scissor is a specialized instrument used for sharp dissection of delicate tissue. Commonly used to dissect oblique structures and plaque from vessel walls during vascular surgery.

The Surtex® Nerve Dissecting Scissor is a versatile instrument used for sharp dissection of delicate tissues during ENT, Plastic and General surgeries. The instrument is specifically designed to minimize user fatigue during long surgical procedures.
The Surtex® Shea Vein Graft Scissor is a specialized instrument used for dissection of delicate tissues. Commonly used during vessel grafts, tympanoplasty and other ENT surgeries.

The Surtex® Thorek Dissecting Scissor is a versatile instrument used for blunt dissection of soft tissues. It is commonly used for abdominal hysterectomies and can be employed in a number of other gynecological and general surgeries.
The Surtex® Fomon Nasal Scissor is specifically designed for the precise dissection of the dorsal and lateral nasal cartilages during rhinoplasty, ENT procedures and plastic surgeries.

The Surtex® Cinelli Dissecting Scissor is specially designed for dissecting tough tissues during ENT and Plastic Surgeries. Blunt tips make it ideal for blunt dissection as well as scissor cutting soft tissue.

The Surtex® Aston SuperEdge™ Facelift Scissor is a versatile instrument used for spread dissection of skin and muscle tissue during surgeries on the face and neck. Often used by cosmetic surgeons in platysma dissection and rhytidectomy.

The Surtex® Resano Cartilage Scissor is employed by plastic surgeons for precise dissection of soft tissues including cartilage thickness in rhinoplasty. Also used in spine and cardiovascular surgeries for accurate dissection of delicate tissues.

The Surtex® Weller Dissecting Scissor is a multipurpose scissor commonly used during oral surgeries to dissect excess soft tissues. It is also employed in spinal and cardiac surgeries for precise dissection of delicate tissues.

El Destornillador de Caspar ofrece una gama excepcional de ventajas operatorias. Desempeña la importante función de guiar y rotar los tornillos de distracción de Caspar dentro de los implantes vertebrales. Para este fin, el instrumento posee una estructura tubular que permite portar la base del tornillo con seguridad. Además, el tubo es recto para estabilizar la dirección de perforación durante el procedimiento. Nuestro Destornillador de Caspar ostenta un mango fabricado con fibra de Ferrozell. De tal modo, este material asegura el mínimo riesgo de deslizamiento y provee una sensación táctil agradable y segura. Fabricado en acero inoxidable de excelente calidad con un acabado mate que evita reflejos de luz.

Para lograrlo, el instrumento posee una parte activa helicoidal, con una punta aguda que facilita el inicio de la perforación. Además, su diseño cilíndrico es ideal para la inserción dentro de la guía. Nuestra Broca Perforadora de Caspar ostenta un diseño largo que optimiza el alcance a espacios profundos. Asimismo, el vástago delgado es perfecto para manipular el instrumento previo a la perforación. Fabricado en acero inoxidable de alta calidad, fácil de esterilizar, con un acabado mate que reduce los destellos de luz.

In addition, the slim, round design of the device offers comfortable access into the drill guide. Moreover, the Caspar Twist Drill features a thin shaft for optimal drill ensemble. This allows surgeons to avoid accidental slippage and/or injury. Manufactured in premium grade stainless steel to ensure the highest quality instruments in your operating rooms

This ergonomic design is ideal to retract the skin in fingers during specific hand procedures. The Sims Rectal Speculum offers a broad range of surgical advantages. Its principal use is to broaden the rectum’s diameter to observe and identify abnormalities, such as haemorrhoids. For this purpose, the instrument gas a pair of outwardly curved blades that enhance sightlines. In addition, the blades feature solid and fenestrated patterns that surgeons can choose according to their preferences. Also, a screw adjustment mechanism allows for controlling the blades’ degree of aperture. Moreover, the Sims Rectal Speculum features a plier grip style handle with horizontal ridges to prevent slippage. The Hirschman Anoscope offers a wide variety of surgical advantages. It is extremely important to localize anal and rectal pathologies, such as haemorrhoids, inflammation or tumours. For this purpose, the instrument features a tube-shaped design that easily conforms to the rectal anatomy. In addition, the device includes a removable bullet that facilitates insertion. Also, the tube is available in multiple diameters to treat patients of all ages and stenosed rectum. Moreover, the Hirschman Anoscope features a solid, fenestrated shaft that enhances gripping. In addition, the spring handle helps to close the tips against each other with controlled pressure. Also, the device features straight and curved patterns to reach narrow and deep spaces. The edge of the working is blunt to prevent endothelial trauma throughout the procedure. Moreover, the Payr Ligature Conductor features an ergonomically designed hollow handle that enhances gripping. This particular profile not only prevents accidental slippage but also offers surgical comfort to the operator. The Bridge Artery Forcep offers a wide range of surgical benefits. Its principal use is to provide an atraumatic way to achieve haemostasis during thoracic surgery. For this purpose, the instrument features a pair of tapered jaws, which help to reach narrow cavities with ease. Moreover, the Bridge Artery Forcep features ergonomically designed finger rings that provide an enhanced gripping. Home GBox Laser GBox Laser The BioSpectrum GBox Laser is a versatile, high-performance surgical laser platform designed to deliver precise and controlled energy for minimally invasive procedures. TULA® compatible , the GBox is designed for use with the 400 µm TULA® fibre, making it a suitable solution for TULA® procedures, including the treatment of non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC). With 980 nm and 1470 nm wavelengths, continuous wave and pulse modes, and compatibility with flexible, reusable and single-use cystoscopes, the GBox offers clinicians a flexible and efficient laser solution for outpatient procedures. Home S Curve Dilators Watch more videos S Curve Dilators Urethral Dilators are used for dilation of male urethral strictures and vesical neck contractures. The dilators are contoured to support the natural curvature of the male urethra, and are constructed to retain their shape during placement. Product Properties: Disposable. Soluble in water. Easy to use thanks to syringe and accordion tube. Eliminates the risk of damage to tissue. Contains antiseptic Chlorhexidine Gluconate to eliminate risk of infection. Lidocaine Hydrochloride is a local anesthetic to reduce pain. Painless catheterization. Lubricating feature provided by hydroxyethylcelluose, the patient relaxes and minimizes the spasticity and discomfort caused by liatrogenic injury. Usage: Remove syringe/accordion tube from sterile packaging. Remove the stopper at the end of the syringe/accordion tube. Pour a drop of gel to facilitate application. After placing the syringe on the area to be lubricated, gently squeeze some OneGel Lidocaine Lubricating Gel by pressing the plunger of the syringe/accordion tube. Composition: Pure water, propylene glycol, hydroxyethylcelluose (lubricant), lidocaine hydrochloride (local anesthetic), chlorhexidine gluconate – 20% concentration (antiseptic), methyl hydrobenzoate (preservative), propyl hydrobenzoate (preservative)

The Finger/Toe Goniometer is designed for accurately measuring the range of motion in finger and toe joints. Ideal for therapists, clinicians, and rehabilitation professionals, it provides a simple and reliable way to assess joint mobility and monitor patient progress. Featuring a 95 mm long arm for improved wrist clearance and a 19 mm short arm for precise DIP joint measurements, this goniometer offers a measurement range from 30° of hyperextension to 120° of flexion with an accuracy of ±2°. detail.description: CARINAnav Laser marking software controls movable lasers in DORADO and DORADOnova laser systems. The CARINAnav software is available with three options of PC platforms. The CARINAnav control system is used to position the movable lasers in DORADO and DORADOnova laser systems. CARINAnav transmits the exact spatial coordinates to the movable lasers, which projects the laser lines onto the patient with precision. To position the lasers, the spatial coordinates from the planning system are transmitted to the CARINAnav control system. If no connection to a planning system is available, the coordinates can be entered manually on the tablet. Lasers and control system are connected reliably via Bluetooth. CARINAnav has two modes: In Clinical Mode, patients are precisely aligned in the clinical workflow using the laser lines, and the reference point is marked. In Service Mode, the laser system is set up, and the lasers are aligned with the virtual isocenter. detail.description: We’re evolving, say hello to Nexus / HDC Discover more Vendor Neutral Archive Vendor Neutral Archive (VNA) is a comprehensive archive solution for all medical data in hospitals, regardless of data format. VNA can be hosted on-premise, securely in the cloud or as a fully managed service. detail.description: A unique device that allows the surgeon to dissect, grasp, coagulate and transect tissue with just one instrument. Eliminates the need for inconvenient and time consuming instrument exchanges. Utilises patented bipolar technology to ensure safe, effective and accurate tissue transection by means of a ‘blunt blade’. Features and benefits include: Precise, blood free, tissue transection due to the unique, patented bipolar cutting technology Wide jaw opening (8.5mm) allows effective large vessel (up to 6mm) coagulation and transection Firm, controlled, atraumatic tissue manipulation is achieved by means of the strong jaw closing pressure Fully insulated shaft provides safe current containment Ideal surgeon control due to light-weight, ergonomic construction Available in 5mm and 10mm options

Features and benefits include: Smooth, sequenced distal tip to clip apex closure, ensures tissue is guided to the apex of the U shaped clip Two-step firing action prevents inadvertent/premature clip firing Large jaw maximises clip aperture, tissue clearance and excellent visualisation before activation Super-strength flexible titanium minimises unwanted clip breakages
features: Smooth, sequenced distal tip to clip apex closure, ensures tissue is guided to the apex of the U shaped clip
Two-step firing action prevents inadvertent/premature clip firing
Large jaw maximises clip aperture, tissue clearance and excellent visualisation before activation
Super-strength flexible titanium minimises unwanted clip breakages

detail.description: The detachable Endo Retrieval Pouch is indicated for use as a device for the capture and removal of resected tissue during laparoscopic surgery. Features and benefits include: Self-opening and self sealing transparent pouch for simple tissue capture. Viral Barrier testing of the polyurethane pouch has qualified that that no viral penetration occurred over a 24 hour period of test. This performance mitigates against the risk of port site infection and carcinoma seeding during specimen containment and removal. Anatomy suitable for these devices includes: Code PS3442A (250ml volume) = Lymph Node, Gall Bladder, Appendix and Small Bowel resection Code PS3443A (580ml volume) = Gall Bladder, Ovary, Fibroids, Prostate Gland, Spleen, Kidney Code PS3444ULT (1150ml volume) = Uterus, Spleen, Lung, Large Colon, Omentum & Gastric Resection

detail.description: The Purple Surgical Secure Catch Tissue Retrieval Pouch has applications in laparoscopic procedures for the safe, convenient removal of tissue specimens such as the appendix, gallbladder, ovaries, fibroids, myomas, omentum, spleen, and bowel Features and benefits include: >20N pouch integrity performance of the 2 directional ‘rip-stop’ fabric construction is verified by Tear resistance testing in accordance with BS EN ISO 6383-1). Viral Barrier testing of the polyurethane lined Nylon pouch has qualified that that no viral penetration occurred over a 24 hour period of test. detail.description: The Purple Surgical Essential Skin Stapler is designed to make skin closure simple, fast, and reliable, giving surgical teams the control and consistency they need, procedure after procedure. Its straightforward, single-use design means it’s ready to go straight out of the pack, with no reprocessing, calibration, or maintenance required. Features and benefits include: Single-use, 35 wide – supplied sterile and ready for immediate use, helping reduce the risk of cross-contamination associated with reusable instruments. Consistent, secure staple formation – engineered to create the correct staple shape every time for effective, reliable wound closure. Clear staple visibility – an open, easy-to-read window lets the clinician see exactly how many staples remain, supporting confident, uninterrupted use throughout the procedure. Pre-loaded with 35 wide staples – ready to use straight away, removing the need for manual loading and helping keep procedures moving efficiently. Simple, intuitive operation – a straightforward firing mechanism supports ease of use for the whole surgical team, minimising training time. Consistent performance – built to perform reliably from the first staple to the last, supporting predictable outcomes in wound closure.

detail.description: The Purple Surgical Veress Needle has applications in laparoscopic procedures for the establishment of a pneumoperitoneum Features and benefits include: Sterile, Single use supply avoids the need for difficult, costly, time-consuming cleaning and reprocessing. Sharp bevelled Needle tip allows controlled insertion. A spring loaded inner stylet with visual and audible placement indicators provide surgeon assurance during the blind insertion and shields the needle tip once it passes through the abdominal wall and enters into the abdominal cavity. A female luer lock connector with gas tap stopcock allows for connectivity with the insufflation tubing accessories. The Veress needles are 14 gauge and are available in two working lengths 120mm or 150mm to suit patient anatomy.

detail.description: Safe and Efficient Gas Delivery for Laparoscopic Procedures. The Purple Surgical Insufflation Filter & Tubing Sets are designed to safely deliver carbon dioxide (CO₂) gas from the insufflator to the patient, enabling controlled intra-abdominal insufflation during laparoscopic surgeries. These sets not only ensure a smooth flow of gas but also provide critical protection against cross-contamination. Purple Surgical’s Insufflation Filter & Tubing Sets are a vital component in maintaining a sterile environment during laparoscopic surgery, supporting both patient safety and surgical performance. Key Features and Benefits: Sterile and Single-Use – Supplied sterile and intended for single-use, offering convenience while maximising patient safety and reducing the risk of infection. Exceptional Filtration Efficiency – Delivers 99.998% viral and bacterial filtration efficiency, providing outstanding protection against airborne contaminants. High Air Flow Performance – Achieves a minimum airflow rate of 73.6 litres per minute at 5 PSI, ensuring consistent and reliable insufflation during procedures. Wide Compatibility – Available with various machine-end connections to ensure compatibility with most standard insufflators, enhancing ease of integration into existing surgical setups.
